import truststore
truststore.inject_into_ssl()

import asyncio
import logging
from contextlib import asynccontextmanager

from fastapi import FastAPI
from fastapi.staticfiles import StaticFiles

import config  # noqa: F401
from routers import (
    webhook as webhook_router,
    webhook_vk as webhook_vk_router,
    mini_app as mini_app_router,
    admin_core as admin_core_router,
    admin_requests as admin_requests_router,
    admin_directories as admin_directories_router,
    admin_broadcasts as admin_broadcasts_router,
    admin_settings as admin_settings_router,
    admin_uploads as admin_uploads_router,
    admin_reviews as admin_reviews_router,
    admin_bots as admin_bots_router,
)
from storage.db import init_db

logging.basicConfig(
    level=logging.INFO,
    format="%(asctime)s [%(levelname)s] %(name)s: %(message)s",
)
log = logging.getLogger(__name__)


@asynccontextmanager
async def lifespan(app: FastAPI):
    init_db()
    await webhook_router.startup()

    from core.reminders import run_reminder_worker, run_supervised
    from core.broadcasts import run_broadcast_worker
    from core.waitlist import run_waitlist_worker

    worker_tasks = [
        asyncio.create_task(run_supervised("reminder", run_reminder_worker)),
        asyncio.create_task(run_supervised("broadcast", run_broadcast_worker)),
        asyncio.create_task(run_supervised("waitlist", run_waitlist_worker)),
    ]
    log.info("Workers started (reminder, broadcast, waitlist) via supervisor")

    yield

    for t in worker_tasks:
        t.cancel()
    for t in worker_tasks:
        try:
            await t
        except asyncio.CancelledError:
            pass


app = FastAPI(lifespan=lifespan)
app.mount("/static", StaticFiles(directory="static"), name="static")

app.include_router(webhook_router.router)
app.include_router(webhook_vk_router.router)
app.include_router(mini_app_router.router)
app.include_router(admin_core_router.router)
app.include_router(admin_requests_router.router)
app.include_router(admin_directories_router.router)
app.include_router(admin_broadcasts_router.router)
app.include_router(admin_settings_router.router)
app.include_router(admin_uploads_router.router)
app.include_router(admin_reviews_router.router)
app.include_router(admin_bots_router.router)

#!/bin/bash
# Бэкап SQLite через .backup + gzip + ротация 30 дней.
# Запуск: cron (см. ниже) или вручную: ./backup_db.sh

set -euo pipefail

PROJECT_DIR="/var/www/max_booking_bot"
DB_FILE="$PROJECT_DIR/booking.db"
BACKUP_DIR="$PROJECT_DIR/backups"
KEEP_DAYS=30

mkdir -p "$BACKUP_DIR"

TS=$(date +%Y-%m-%d_%H-%M)
OUT="$BACKUP_DIR/booking_${TS}.db"

# Консистентный снимок WAL-БД
sqlite3 "$DB_FILE" ".backup '$OUT'"

# Сжать
gzip -f "$OUT"

# Удалить старые
find "$BACKUP_DIR" -name "booking_*.db.gz" -mtime "+$KEEP_DAYS" -delete

echo "[$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')] backup OK: $OUT.gz"

ФАЙЛ: deploy.sh  (4953 байт)
============================================================
#!/bin/bash
# deploy.sh — развёртывание MAX Booking Bot.
#
# Использование:
#   ./deploy.sh              # пользователь maxbot, hardening (боевой сервер)
#   ./deploy.sh --root       # root, без hardening (тест/отладка)
#
# Что делает:
#   1. Ставит Python 3.12 в /opt/python3.12 (если ещё нет).
#      На Ubuntu 24.04 берёт системный python3.12 — сборка не нужна.
#   2. Создаёт venv, ставит зависимости.
#   3. Создаёт пользователя maxbot (если не --root), даёт права.
#   4. Пишет systemd-unit, запускает сервис.
#
# Запускать от root: sudo ./deploy.sh

set -euo pipefail

PROJECT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
PYTHON_VERSION="3.12.9"
PYTHON_PREFIX="/opt/python3.12"
SERVICE_USER="maxbot"
SERVICE_NAME="max-bot"

RUN_AS_ROOT=false
for arg in "$@"; do
    case "$arg" in
        --root) RUN_AS_ROOT=true ;;
        -h|--help) sed -n '2,20p' "$0"; exit 0 ;;
    esac
done

log() { echo ">>> $*"; }
fail() { echo "!!! $*" >&2; exit 1; }

[ "$EUID" -eq 0 ] || fail "Запускать от root: sudo ./deploy.sh"
[ -f "$PROJECT_DIR/.env" ] || fail "Нет .env — сначала: cp .env.example .env && nano .env"
[ -f "$PROJECT_DIR/requirements.txt" ] || fail "Нет requirements.txt"

# ---------- 1. Python 3.12 ----------
if [ -x "$PYTHON_PREFIX/bin/python3.12" ]; then
    log "Python уже есть: $($PYTHON_PREFIX/bin/python3.12 --version)"
elif [ -x /usr/bin/python3.12 ]; then
    log "Используем системный /usr/bin/python3.12"
    PYTHON_PREFIX=""
else
    log "Устанавливаем зависимости для сборки..."
    apt update -q
    apt install -y -q build-essential wget \
        libssl-dev zlib1g-dev libbz2-dev libreadline-dev libsqlite3-dev \
        libffi-dev liblzma-dev libncurses5-dev libgdbm-dev libnss3-dev \
        uuid-dev tk-dev

    log "Собираем Python $PYTHON_VERSION в $PYTHON_PREFIX..."
    cd /tmp
    [ -f "Python-$PYTHON_VERSION.tgz" ] || \
        wget -q "https://www.python.org/ftp/python/$PYTHON_VERSION/Python-$PYTHON_VERSION.tgz"
    tar -xzf "Python-$PYTHON_VERSION.tgz"
    cd "Python-$PYTHON_VERSION"
    ./configure --prefix="$PYTHON_PREFIX" --enable-optimizations --with-ensurepip=install
    make -j"$(nproc)"
    make install
    cd "$PROJECT_DIR"
fi

if [ -n "$PYTHON_PREFIX" ]; then
    PYTHON_BIN="$PYTHON_PREFIX/bin/python3.12"
else
    PYTHON_BIN="/usr/bin/python3.12"
fi
log "Python: $($PYTHON_BIN --version)"

# ---------- 2. venv ----------
log "Создаём venv..."
rm -rf "$PROJECT_DIR/venv"
"$PYTHON_BIN" -m venv "$PROJECT_DIR/venv"
"$PROJECT_DIR/venv/bin/pip" install -q --upgrade pip
"$PROJECT_DIR/venv/bin/pip" install -q -r "$PROJECT_DIR/requirements.txt"

# ---------- 3. Пользователь и права ----------
if ! $RUN_AS_ROOT; then
    log "Создаём пользователя $SERVICE_USER..."
    id "$SERVICE_USER" >/dev/null 2>&1 || \
        useradd -r -s /usr/sbin/nologin -d "$PROJECT_DIR" -M "$SERVICE_USER"

    log "Даём права на проект..."
    chown -R "$SERVICE_USER:$SERVICE_USER" "$PROJECT_DIR"
    chmod 750 "$PROJECT_DIR"
    chmod 600 "$PROJECT_DIR/.env"
    find "$PROJECT_DIR" -name "*.py" -exec chmod 644 {} \;
    find "$PROJECT_DIR" -name "*.db" -exec chmod 660 {} \;
    [ -d "$PROJECT_DIR/static" ] && {
        find "$PROJECT_DIR/static" -type f -exec chmod 644 {} \;
        find "$PROJECT_DIR/static" -type d -exec chmod 755 {} \;
    }
fi

# ---------- 4. Systemd unit ----------
log "Пишем unit..."
if $RUN_AS_ROOT; then
    USER_BLOCK=""
    HARDENING=""
else
    USER_BLOCK="User=$SERVICE_USER
Group=$SERVICE_USER"
    HARDENING="
# Hardening
NoNewPrivileges=yes
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=yes
PrivateTmp=yes
ReadWritePaths=$PROJECT_DIR
ProtectKernelTunables=yes
ProtectKernelModules=yes
ProtectControlGroups=yes
RestrictSUIDSGID=yes
LockPersonality=yes"
fi

cat > "/etc/systemd/system/$SERVICE_NAME.service" <<EOF
[Unit]
Description=MAX Booking Bot
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=simple
${USER_BLOCK}
WorkingDirectory=$PROJECT_DIR
EnvironmentFile=$PROJECT_DIR/.env
ExecStart=$PROJECT_DIR/venv/bin/uvicorn app:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8080
Restart=always
RestartSec=5
${HARDENING}

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
EOF

# ---------- 5. Запуск ----------
log "Запускаем $SERVICE_NAME..."
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable "$SERVICE_NAME" >/dev/null
systemctl restart "$SERVICE_NAME"
sleep 2
systemctl status "$SERVICE_NAME" --no-pager || true

echo
log "Готово. Полезное:"
echo "  systemctl status $SERVICE_NAME"
echo "  journalctl -u $SERVICE_NAME -f"
echo "  curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8080/max_booking/api/admin/me   # ожидаем {\"detail\":\"Invalid initData\"}"

# Changelog

## 2026-11-20
- E4.1: таблица `superadmins` (платформа + uid), миграция `SUPERADMIN_ID` из config в БД, функции `is_superadmin_db` и `get_admin_role_by_platform`, API роутер `routers/admin_bots.py` (GET/POST/PATCH/DELETE ботов), платформо-агностичная логика выбора организации в обоих ботах (MAX/VK).

from datetime import date as _date, timedelta

from storage.db import (
    init_db, db, list_orgs, create_org,
    create_branch, create_doctor, add_slot,
    list_branches, list_doctors,
)

init_db()

orgs = list_orgs()
if not orgs:
    oid = create_org("Тестовая организация")
    print(f"Создана организация #{oid} «Тестовая организация»")
else:
    oid = orgs[0]["id"]
    print(f"Использую существующую организацию #{oid} «{orgs[0]['name']}»")

# услуги
SERVICES = [
    ("eeg",  oid, "ЭЭГ",     1200, "Чистая голова, без лака/геля"),
    ("uzi",  oid, "УЗИ",     1000, "Натощак"),
    ("echo", oid, "ЭХО-КГ",  1500, "Подготовка не требуется"),
]
conn = db()
conn.execute("DELETE FROM services")
conn.executemany(
    "INSERT INTO services (id, org_id, name, price, prep) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
    SERVICES,
)
conn.commit()
conn.close()
print("OK, услуги добавлены:", len(SERVICES))

# филиал
branches = list_branches(oid)
if not branches:
    bid = create_branch(oid, "Главный офис", "ул. Ленина, 1", "+7 800 000-00-00")
    print(f"Создан филиал #{bid}")
else:
    bid = branches[0]["id"]
    print(f"Использую филиал #{bid} «{branches[0]['name']}»")

# врач
doctors = list_doctors(bid)
if not doctors:
    did = create_doctor(bid, "Иванова И.И.", "Врач функциональной диагностики")
    print(f"Создан врач #{did}")
else:
    did = doctors[0]["id"]
    print(f"Использую врача #{did} «{doctors[0]['name']}»")

# слоты на 14 дней
today = _date.today()
created = 0
for offset in range(14):
    d = today + timedelta(days=offset)
    wd = d.weekday()
    if wd == 6:
        continue
    if wd == 5:
        start, end = 9, 14
    else:
        start, end = 9, 18
    h, m = start, 0
    while h < end:
        add_slot(oid, bid, did, d.isoformat(), f"{h:02d}:{m:02d}")
        created += 1
        m += 30
        if m == 60:
            m = 0
            h += 1

print(f"OK, слотов создано: {created}")
print(f"\nИтого: org_id={oid}, branch_id={bid}, doctor_id={did}")

"""API управления ботами организации.
Эндпоинты для добавления, редактирования, удаления ботов (MAX, VK и т.д.).
"""

@router.get("")
async def list_org_bots(
    ctx: AdminCtx = Depends(org_ctx),
):
    """Список всех ботов организации."""
    if not ctx.org_id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="org_id required")
    
    bots = list_bots(org_id=ctx.org_id)
    return {
        "ok": True,
        "bots": [
            {
                "id": b["id"],
                "platform": b["platform"],
                "slug": b["slug"],
                "title": b["title"] or f"{b['platform'].upper()} Bot",
                "enabled": bool(b["enabled"]),
                "group_id": b["group_id"],
                "token": b["token"],  # полный токен для редактирования
                "confirmation_code": b["confirmation_code"],
                "created_at": b["created_at"],
                "updated_at": b["updated_at"],
            }
            for b in bots
        ],
    }


@router.get("/{bot_id}")
async def get_org_bot(bot_id: int, ctx: AdminCtx = Depends(org_ctx)):
    """Получить детали бота."""
    bot = get_bot(bot_id)
    if not bot:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Bot not found")
    
    # Проверить, принадлежит ли бот организации
    if ctx.role != "superadmin" and bot["org_id"] != ctx.org_id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Access denied")
    
    return {
        "ok": True,
        "bot": {
            "id": bot["id"],
            "platform": bot["platform"],
            "slug": bot["slug"],
            "title": bot["title"],
            "enabled": bool(bot["enabled"]),
            "group_id": bot["group_id"],
            "confirmation_code": bot["confirmation_code"],
            "token": "***" if bot["token"] else None,
            "webhook_secret": "***" if bot["webhook_secret"] else None,
            "created_at": bot["created_at"],
            "updated_at": bot["updated_at"],
        },
    }

@router.post("/vk/init")
async def init_vk_bot(
    group_id: int,
    ctx: AdminCtx = Depends(org_ctx),
):
    """Инициализировать новый VK-бота.
    
    Возвращает:
    - slug: автогенерированный
    - confirmation_code: для вставки в ВК
    - инструкцию
    """
    if not ctx.org_id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="org_id required")
    
    # Генерировать slug и confirmation_code
    slug = f"vk_{group_id}_{secrets.token_hex(4)}"
    confirmation_code = secrets.token_hex(4)  # 8 символов
    
    # Создать бота в БД (disabled)
    bot_id = upsert_bot(
        org_id=ctx.org_id,
        platform="vk",
        slug=slug,
        group_id=group_id,
        confirmation_code=confirmation_code,
        enabled=0,  # включим после подтверждения токена
        title=f"VK Community {group_id}",
    )
    
    return {
        "ok": True,
        "bot_id": bot_id,
        "slug": slug,
        "confirmation_code": confirmation_code,
        "instructions": (
            f"1. Перейди в https://vk.com/club{group_id}/settings?act=callback\n"
            f"2. В поле 'Строка подтверждения' вставь: {confirmation_code}\n"
            f"3. Нажми 'Сохранить' и дождись подтверждения\n"
            f"4. Создай ключ доступа с правами: messages, manage\n"
            f"5. Отправь нам токен для активации"
        ),
    }


@router.post("/{bot_id}/token")
async def set_bot_token(
    bot_id: int,
    token: str,
    ctx: AdminCtx = Depends(org_ctx),
):
    """Обновить токен бота и включить его.
    
    Минимальная проверка: убедиться, что токен не пуст.
    Полная проверка (запрос в API) — на фронте или в отдельном эндпоинте.
    """
    if not ctx.org_id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="org_id required")
    
    bot = get_bot(bot_id)
    if not bot:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Bot not found")
    
    # Проверить доступ
    if ctx.role != "superadmin" and bot["org_id"] != ctx.org_id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Access denied")
    
    if not token or len(token) < 10:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Invalid token")
    
    # Обновить токен и включить бота
    upsert_bot(
        org_id=bot["org_id"],
        platform=bot["platform"],
        slug=bot["slug"],
        token=token,
        enabled=1,
    )
    
    return {
        "ok": True,
        "message": "Bot activated with new token",
        "bot_id": bot_id,
    }

@router.patch("/{bot_id}")
async def update_bot(
    bot_id: int,
    enabled: Optional[bool] = None,
    title: Optional[str] = None,
    token: Optional[str] = None,
    group_id: Optional[str] = None,
    confirmation_code: Optional[str] = None,
    ctx: AdminCtx = Depends(org_ctx),
):
    """Обновить настройки бота (включить/выключить, изменить название, токен, confirmation_code)."""
    if not ctx.org_id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="org_id required")
    
    bot = get_bot(bot_id)
    if not bot:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Bot not found")
    
    # Проверить доступ
    if ctx.role != "superadmin" and bot["org_id"] != ctx.org_id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Access denied")
    
    if enabled is not None:
        set_bot_enabled(bot_id, enabled)
    
    # Собрать параметры для upsert
    update_kwargs = {
        "org_id": bot["org_id"],
        "platform": bot["platform"],
        "slug": bot["slug"],
    }
    
    if title is not None:
        update_kwargs["title"] = title
    if token is not None:
        update_kwargs["token"] = token
    if group_id is not None:
        update_kwargs["group_id"] = group_id
    if confirmation_code is not None:
        update_kwargs["confirmation_code"] = confirmation_code
    
    # Обновить, если есть что-то кроме базовых полей
    if len(update_kwargs) > 3:  # больше чем org_id, platform, slug
        upsert_bot(**update_kwargs)
    
    return {
        "ok": True,
        "message": "Bot updated",
        "bot_id": bot_id,
    }

class CheckTokenBody(BaseModel):
    platform: str
    token: str
    group_id: Optional[str] = None


VK_API_BASE = "https://api.vk.com/method/"


async def vk_api(token, group_id, method, params=None):
    """Вызов VK API от имени конкретного бота (токен из bots)."""
    p = dict(params or {})
    p["access_token"] = token
    p["v"] = "5.199"
    if group_id:
        p["group_id"] = group_id
    async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=20) as client:
        r = await client.post(VK_API_BASE + method, data=p)
    data = r.json()
    if isinstance(data, dict) and data.get("error"):
        err = data["error"]
        logging.getLogger(__name__).error(
            "VK API %s failed: code=%s msg=%s params=%s",
            method,
            err.get("error_code"),
            err.get("error_msg"),
            {k: v for k, v in p.items() if k != "access_token"},
        )
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=400,
            detail=f"VK API {err.get('error_code')}: {err.get('error_msg')}",
        )
    return data


@router.post("/ui/check_token")
async def ui_check_bot_token(
    body: CheckTokenBody,
    ctx: AdminCtx = Depends(org_ctx),
):
    """Проверить токен бота через API платформы."""
    if not ctx.org_id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="org_id required")

    if not body.token or len(body.token) < 10:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Invalid token format")

    async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=20) as client:
        if body.platform == "vk":
            if not body.group_id:
                raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="group_id required for VK")
            r = await client.get(VK_API_BASE + "groups.getById", params={
                "group_id": body.group_id,
                "fields": "name",
                "access_token": body.token,
                "v": "5.199",
            })
            data = r.json()
            if isinstance(data, dict) and data.get("error"):
                err = data["error"]
                raise HTTPException(
                    status_code=400,
                    detail=f"VK API {err.get('error_code')}: {err.get('error_msg')}",
                )
            resp = data.get("response") or {}
            groups = resp.get("groups") if isinstance(resp, dict) else resp
            if not groups:
                raise HTTPException(
                    status_code=400,
                    detail="VK: токен не привязан к сообществу",
                )
            g = groups[0]
            try:
                gid = int(str(body.group_id).lstrip("-"))
            except ValueError:
                gid = None
            if gid is not None and int(g.get("id") or 0) != gid:
                raise HTTPException(
                    status_code=400,
                    detail=(f"VK: токен относится к сообществу id={g.get('id')}, "
                            f"а не {body.group_id}"),
                )
            bot_name = g.get("name") or f"VK Community {body.group_id}"
        elif body.platform == "max":
            r = await client.get(
                "https://platform-api2.max.ru/me",
                params={"access_token": body.token},
            )
            data = r.json()
            if not data.get("is_bot"):
                raise HTTPException(
                    status_code=400,
                    detail="MAX: токен недействителен (is_bot=false)",
                )
            bot_name = data.get("name") or "MAX Bot"
        else:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Unknown platform")

    return {
        "message": f"Token valid for {body.platform}",
        "bot_name": bot_name,
    }


class AddBotBody(BaseModel):
    platform: str
    token: str
    title: Optional[str] = None
    group_id: Optional[str] = None


@router.post("/ui/add")
async def ui_add_bot(
    body: AddBotBody,
    ctx: AdminCtx = Depends(org_ctx),
):
    """Добавить новый бот (для админки)."""
    if not ctx.org_id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="org_id required")

    if not body.token or len(body.token) < 10:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Invalid token")

    webhook_secret = None
    if body.platform == "vk":
        if not body.group_id:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="group_id required for VK")
        slug = f"vk_{body.group_id}_{secrets.token_hex(4)}"
        webhook_secret = secrets.token_hex(16)
    elif body.platform == "max":
        slug = f"max_{secrets.token_hex(8)}"
    else:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Unknown platform")

    bot_id = upsert_bot(
        org_id=ctx.org_id,
        platform=body.platform,
        slug=slug,
        token=body.token,
        webhook_secret=webhook_secret,
        title=body.title or f"{body.platform.upper()} Bot",
        group_id=body.group_id if body.platform == "vk" else None,
        enabled=1,
    )

    return {
        "bot_id": bot_id,
        "webhook_secret": webhook_secret,
        "message": "Bot added successfully",
    }

@router.patch("/ui/{bot_id}")
async def ui_update_bot(
    bot_id: int,
    body: UpdateBotBody,
    ctx: AdminCtx = Depends(org_ctx),
):
    """Обновить бот (для админки)."""
    if not ctx.org_id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="org_id required")

    bot = get_bot(bot_id)
    if not bot:

    if ctx.role != "superadmin" and bot["org_id"] != ctx.org_id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Access denied")

    if body.enabled is not None:
        set_bot_enabled(bot_id, body.enabled)

    update_kwargs = {

        "slug": bot["slug"],
    }

    if body.token:
        update_kwargs["token"] = body.token
    if body.group_id:
        update_kwargs["group_id"] = body.group_id
    if body.confirmation_code is not None:
        update_kwargs["confirmation_code"] = body.confirmation_code

    if len(update_kwargs) > 3:
        upsert_bot(**update_kwargs)

    return {"message": "Bot updated"}


@router.post("/ui/{bot_id}/register_callback")
async def ui_register_callback(bot_id: int, ctx: AdminCtx = Depends(org_ctx)):
    """Зарегистрировать Callback-адрес бота в VK (setCallbackServer + события)."""
    if not ctx.org_id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="org_id required")

    bot = get_bot(bot_id)
    if not bot:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Bot not found")
    if ctx.role != "superadmin" and bot["org_id"] != ctx.org_id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Access denied")

    if bot["platform"] == "max":
        return {
            "ok": True,
            "message": "MAX-вебхук регистрируется автоматически при старте сервиса",
        }
    if bot["platform"] != "vk":
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Unsupported platform")

    token = bot["token"]
    group_id = bot["group_id"]
    if not token or not group_id:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=400,
            detail="Заполните токен и ID сообщества и сохраните их",
        )

    webhook_secret = bot["webhook_secret"]
    if not webhook_secret:
        webhook_secret = secrets.token_hex(16)
        upsert_bot(
            org_id=bot["org_id"],
            platform=bot["platform"],
            slug=bot["slug"],
            webhook_secret=webhook_secret,
            group_id=group_id,
        )

    vk_url = (config.WEBHOOK_BASE_URL + config.WEBHOOK_PATH).replace(
        "/api/webhooks", "/api/webhook/vk/" + bot["slug"]
    )

    servers = await vk_api(token, str(group_id), "groups.getCallbackServers")
    items = ((servers.get("response") or {}).get("items")) or []
    server_id = next((s["id"] for s in items if s.get("url") == vk_url), None)
    if server_id is None:
        created = await vk_api(token, str(group_id), "groups.setCallbackServer", {
            "url": vk_url,
            "title": "Booking Bot",
            "secret_key": webhook_secret,
        })
        server_id = created.get("response")
    else:
        # Сервер уже существует (адрес регистрировали вручную) — перезаписываем
        # его секрет, иначе VK продолжает слать старый секрет и вебхук отвечает 403.
        await vk_api(token, str(group_id), "groups.editCallbackServer", {
            "server_id": server_id,
            "url": vk_url,
            "title": "Booking Bot",
            "secret_key": webhook_secret,
        })

    await vk_api(token, str(group_id), "groups.setCallbackSettings", {
        "server_id": server_id,
        "api_version": "5.199",
        "message_new": 1,
        "message_reply": 1,
        "message_edit": 1,
        "message_allow": 1,
        "message_deny": 1,
        "message_event": 1,
        "wall_post_new": 0,
        "photo_new": 0,
        "video_new": 0,
        "audio_new": 0,
    })

    return {
        "ok": True,
        "message": "Callback зарегистрирован, события включены",
        "url": vk_url,
        "webhook_secret": webhook_secret,
    }


@router.delete("/ui/{bot_id}")
async def ui_delete_bot(bot_id: int, ctx: AdminCtx = Depends(org_ctx)):
    """Удалить бот (для админки)."""
    if not ctx.org_id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="org_id required")

    if not bot:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Bot not found")
    
    if ctx.role != "superadmin" and bot["org_id"] != ctx.org_id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Access denied")
    
    delete_bot(bot_id)
    
    return {"message": "Bot deleted"}

"""Админские ручки: uploads (загрузка картинок, отдача файлов) + публичная отдача."""
import logging
import uuid as _uuid
from pathlib import Path as _Path

import httpx
from fastapi import APIRouter, Request, HTTPException, Depends, UploadFile, File
from fastapi.responses import FileResponse

import config
from core.auth import AdminCtx, admin_ctx, org_ctx
from core.uploads import _process_upload_image
from storage.db import (
    save_uploaded_image_full,
    get_uploaded_image_by_id,
    get_uploaded_image_by_public_token,
    log_audit,
)

log = logging.getLogger(__name__)

router = APIRouter()


# ---------- Admin: uploads ----------

@router.post("/max_booking/api/admin/upload")
async def admin_upload(
    file: UploadFile = File(...),
    ctx: AdminCtx = Depends(org_ctx),
):
    import uuid as _uuid
    from pathlib import Path as _Path

    if not config.MAX_BOT_TOKEN:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail="Bot token not configured")

    if not file.content_type or file.content_type not in config.ALLOWED_UPLOAD_MIME:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=400,
            detail=f"Unsupported file type: {file.content_type}. "
                   f"Allowed: {', '.join(config.ALLOWED_UPLOAD_MIME)}",
        )

    raw_content = await file.read()
    if len(raw_content) > config.MAX_UPLOAD_SIZE:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=413,
            detail=f"File too large: {len(raw_content)} bytes (max {config.MAX_UPLOAD_SIZE})",
        )
    if not raw_content:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Empty file")

    content, mime_type, ext = _process_upload_image(raw_content, file.content_type)

    filename = f"{_uuid.uuid4().hex}.{ext}"
    rel_dir = str(ctx.org_id)
    abs_dir = _Path(config.UPLOADS_DIR) / rel_dir
    abs_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    abs_path = abs_dir / filename
    abs_path.write_bytes(content)
    rel_path = f"{rel_dir}/{filename}"

    try:
        async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=60.0) as client:
            r = await client.post(
                config.MAX_API + "/uploads",
                params={"type": "image"},
                headers={"Authorization": config.MAX_BOT_TOKEN},
            )
            if r.status_code != 200:
                raise Exception(f"MAX /uploads вернул {r.status_code}: {r.text}")
            data = r.json()
            if "url" not in data:
                raise Exception(f"Неожиданный ответ от MAX (нет url): {data}")
            upload_url = data["url"]

            files = {"data": (filename, content, mime_type)}
            r2 = await client.post(upload_url, files=files)
            if r2.status_code not in (200, 201):
                raise Exception(f"Загрузка в S3 вернула {r2.status_code}: {r2.text}")
            data2 = r2.json()
            photos = data2.get("photos", {})
            photo_key = next(iter(photos), None) if photos else None
            if not photo_key:
                raise Exception(f"В ответе нет объекта photos: {data2}")
            token = photos[photo_key].get("token")
            if not token:
                raise Exception(f"В ответе нет token: {data2}")

            uid, public_token = save_uploaded_image_full(
                token=token,
                file_path=rel_path,
                mime_type=mime_type,
                original_filename=file.filename or filename,
                file_size=len(content),
                org_id=ctx.org_id,
                uploaded_by=ctx.uid,
            )

            log_audit(
                org_id=ctx.org_id, user_id=ctx.uid, action="image_uploaded",
                entity_type="image", entity_id=str(uid),
                payload={"size": len(content), "mime": mime_type},
            )

            return {
                "upload_id": uid,
                "preview_url": f"/max_booking/api/upload/{public_token}",
            }

    except HTTPException:
        # Если MAX отверг — удаляем сохранённый файл, чтобы не мусорить
        try:
            abs_path.unlink(missing_ok=True)
        except Exception:
            pass
        raise
    except Exception as e:
        try:
            abs_path.unlink(missing_ok=True)
        except Exception:
            pass
        log.error("Ошибка при загрузке картинки: %s", str(e))
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=str(e))


@router.get("/max_booking/api/admin/upload/{upload_id}/file")
async def admin_upload_file(upload_id: int, request: Request, ctx: AdminCtx = Depends(admin_ctx)):
    from fastapi.responses import FileResponse
    from pathlib import Path as _Path

    img = get_uploaded_image_by_id(upload_id)
    if not img or (ctx.role != "superadmin" and img["org_id"] != ctx.org_id):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Not found")
    if not img["file_path"]:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="File not stored")
    abs_path = _Path(config.UPLOADS_DIR) / img["file_path"]
    if not abs_path.exists():
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="File not found on disk")
    return FileResponse(abs_path, media_type=img["mime_type"] or "image/jpeg")


@router.get("/max_booking/api/upload/{public_token}")
async def public_upload_file(public_token: str):
    """Публичная отдача картинки для <img src="...">.
    Без auth: токен неподбираемый (uuid4 hex), файлы и так идут в чаты клиентов.
    """
    from fastapi.responses import FileResponse
    from pathlib import Path as _Path

    if not public_token or len(public_token) < 8:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Not found")

    img = get_uploaded_image_by_public_token(public_token)
    if not img:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Not found")
    if not img["file_path"]:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="File not stored")
    abs_path = _Path(config.UPLOADS_DIR) / img["file_path"]
    if not abs_path.exists():
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="File not found on disk")
    return FileResponse(
        abs_path,
        media_type=img["mime_type"] or "image/jpeg",
        headers={"Cache-Control": "public, max-age=86400"},
    )

"""Mini App endpoints (клиентская запись в MAX)."""
import json
import logging
from datetime import datetime

from fastapi import APIRouter, Request, HTTPException, Depends

from core.auth import require_user, get_uid_from_user
from core.booking import BookingContext, create_booking_unified

    get_services, get_service,
    list_dates_with_slots, list_free_slots, get_slot,
    get_branch, get_doctor, get_client, upsert_client,
    list_orgs, get_org_settings,
    set_favorite_doctor,
    doctor_makes_service_batch,
    slots_needed_for_service,
    filter_slots_by_duration,
    now_for_org,
    is_user_blocked,
    list_doctors_by_org,
    get_uploaded_image_by_id,
    list_active_waitlist_for_user,

@router.get("/max_booking/api/mini/me")
async def mini_me(user: dict = Depends(require_user)):
    uid = get_uid_from_user(user)
    user_info = user.get("user") or {}
    if isinstance(user_info, str):
        try:
            user_info = json.loads(user_info)
        except Exception:
            user_info = {}
    first_name = user_info.get("first_name") or ""
    last_name = user_info.get("last_name") or ""

    start_param = (user.get("start_param") or "").strip()
    start_org_id = None
    if start_param.startswith("org_"):
        try:
            start_org_id = int(start_param[4:])
        except ValueError:
            pass
    if not start_org_id:
        orgs = list_orgs()
        if len(orgs) == 1:
            start_org_id = orgs[0]["id"]

    client = get_client(uid)
    phone = ""
    middle_name = ""
    gender = ""
    birth_date = ""
    if client:
        first_name = client["first_name"] or first_name
        last_name = client["last_name"] or last_name
        middle_name = client["middle_name"] or ""
        phone = client["phone"] or ""
        gender = client["gender"] or ""
        birth_date = client["birth_date"] or ""
        if client["org_id"] is None and start_org_id:
            upsert_client(uid, org_id=start_org_id)
    else:
        upsert_client(uid, org_id=start_org_id, first_name=first_name, last_name=last_name)

    return {
        "user_id": uid,
        "first_name": first_name,
        "last_name": last_name,
        "middle_name": middle_name,
        "phone": phone,
        "gender": gender,
        "birth_date": birth_date,
        "favorite_doctor_id": client["favorite_doctor_id"] if client else None,
        "consent_152fz": bool(client["consent_152fz"]) if client else False,
    }


@router.put("/max_booking/api/mini/favorite_doctor")
async def mini_set_favorite_doctor(request: Request, user: dict = Depends(require_user)):
    uid = get_uid_from_user(user)
    if not uid:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Invalid user")

    try:
        body = await request.json()
        if not isinstance(body, dict):
            body = {}
    except Exception:
        body = {}

    doctor_id_raw = body.get("doctor_id")
    if doctor_id_raw is None:
        set_favorite_doctor(uid, None)
        return {"ok": True, "favorite_doctor_id": None}

    try:
        doctor_id = int(doctor_id_raw)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Invalid doctor_id")

    d = get_doctor(doctor_id)
    if not d:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Doctor not found")

    set_favorite_doctor(uid, doctor_id)
    return {"ok": True, "favorite_doctor_id": doctor_id}


@router.get("/max_booking/api/mini/services")
async def mini_services(user: dict = Depends(require_user)):
    start_param = (user.get("start_param") or "").strip()
    org_id = None
    if start_param.startswith("org_"):
        try:
            org_id = int(start_param[4:])
        except ValueError:
            pass
    if not org_id:
        orgs = list_orgs()
        if len(orgs) == 1:
            org_id = orgs[0]["id"]
    if not org_id:
        return {"services": []}
    rows = get_services(org_id)
    return {
        "services": [
            {"id": r["id"], "name": r["name"], "price": r["price"], "prep": r["prep"],
             "category_id": r["category_id"],
             "category_name": r["category_name"],
             "category_sort_order": r["category_sort_order"]}
            for r in rows
        ]
    }


@router.get("/max_booking/api/mini/dates")
async def mini_dates(service_id: str, user: dict = Depends(require_user)):
    svc = get_service(service_id)
    if not svc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Service not found")
    org_id = svc["org_id"]
    dates = list_dates_with_slots(org_id, limit_days=14)
    return {"dates": dates}


@router.get("/max_booking/api/mini/slots")
async def mini_slots(service_id: str, date: str, user: dict = Depends(require_user)):
    svc = get_service(service_id)
    if not svc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Service not found")
    org_id = svc["org_id"]

    settings = get_org_settings(org_id)
    step_min = int(settings.get("slot_step_min", 30) or 30)
    slots_needed = slots_needed_for_service(service_id, step_min)

    rows = list_free_slots(org_id, date, service_id=service_id)

    doctor_ids = list({r["doctor_id"] for r in rows if r["doctor_id"]})
    makes_map = doctor_makes_service_batch(doctor_ids, service_id) if doctor_ids else {}

    if slots_needed > 1:
        rows = filter_slots_by_duration(org_id, date, rows, slots_needed, step_min)

    branch_cache = {}
    doctor_cache = {}
    result = []
    for r in rows:
        doctor_id = r["doctor_id"]

        if doctor_id and not makes_map.get(doctor_id, True):
            continue

        doctor_name = None
        if doctor_id:
            if doctor_id in doctor_cache:
                d = doctor_cache[doctor_id]
            else:
                d = get_doctor(doctor_id)
                doctor_cache[doctor_id] = d
            if d:
                doctor_name = d["name"]

        branch_id = r["branch_id"]
        branch_name = None
        branch_address = None
        if branch_id:
            if branch_id in branch_cache:
                br = branch_cache[branch_id]
            else:
                br = get_branch(branch_id)
                branch_cache[branch_id] = br
            if br:
                branch_name = br["name"]
                branch_address = br["address"]

        result.append({
            "id": r["id"],
            "time": r["time"],
            "branch_id": branch_id,
            "branch_name": branch_name,
            "branch_address": branch_address,
            "doctor_id": doctor_id,
            "service_id": r["service_id"],
            "doctor_name": doctor_name,
        })
    return {
        "slots": result,
        "slots_needed": slots_needed,
        "duration_min": (svc["duration_min"] or 30),
        "buffer_min": (svc["buffer_min"] or 0),
    }


@router.get("/max_booking/api/mini/doctors")
async def mini_doctors(user: dict = Depends(require_user)):
    """Список специалистов организации для клиентского Mini App."""
    start_param = (user.get("start_param") or "").strip()
    org_id = None
    if start_param.startswith("org_"):
        try:
            org_id = int(start_param[4:])
        except ValueError:
            pass
    if not org_id:
        orgs = list_orgs()
        if len(orgs) == 1:
            org_id = orgs[0]["id"]
    if not org_id:
        return {"doctors": []}

    rows = list_doctors_by_org(org_id)
    result = []
    for r in rows:
        photo_url = None
        pid = r["photo_upload_id"] if "photo_upload_id" in r.keys() else None
        if pid:
            img = get_uploaded_image_by_id(pid)
            if img and img["public_token"]:
                photo_url = f"/max_booking/api/upload/{img['public_token']}"
        result.append({
            "id": r["id"],
            "name": r["name"],
            "specialty": r["specialty"] or "",
            "photo_url": photo_url,
        })
    return {"doctors": result}


@router.get("/max_booking/api/mini/history/{request_id}")
async def mini_history(request_id: int, user: dict = Depends(require_user)):
    """Данные прошлой заявки — для кнопки «Повторить» в Mini App."""

    req = get_request(request_id)

        "service_id": req["service_id"],
        "service_name": req["service_name"],

        "doctor_id": req["doctor_id"],
        "status": req["status"],
    }


@router.post("/max_booking/api/mini/book")
async def mini_book(request: Request, user: dict = Depends(require_user)):
    uid = get_uid_from_user(user)
    if not uid:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Invalid user")

    try:
        body = await request.json()
        if not isinstance(body, dict):
            raise ValueError
    except Exception:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Invalid JSON")

    service_id = body.get("service_id")
    slot_id_raw = body.get("slot_id")
    phone = str(body.get("phone") or "").strip()
    first_name = str(body.get("first_name") or "").strip()[:100]
    last_name = str(body.get("last_name") or "").strip()[:100]
    middle_name = str(body.get("middle_name") or "").strip()[:100]
    gender = str(body.get("gender") or "").strip()
    birth_date = body.get("birth_date")
    consent_in_body = bool(body.get("consent_152fz"))

    if not service_id or not slot_id_raw or not phone:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Missing required fields")

    phone = normalize_phone(phone)
    if not phone:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Invalid phone")
    if not first_name or not last_name:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="First and last name are required")
    if gender not in ("male", "female"):
        gender = None
    service_id = str(service_id)
    try:
        slot_id = int(slot_id_raw)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Invalid slot_id")

    slot_pre = get_slot(slot_id)
    if not slot_pre:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Slot not found")
    org_id = slot_pre["org_id"]

    ctx_b = BookingContext(
        org_id=org_id,
        user_id=str(uid),
        slot_id=slot_id,
        service_id=service_id,
        phone=phone,
        first_name=first_name,
        last_name=last_name,
        middle_name=middle_name,
        gender=gender,
        birth_date=birth_date,
        via="mini_app",
        skip_consent_check=False,
        set_consent_152fz=consent_in_body,
    )

    result = await create_booking_unified(ctx_b)

    if not result.ok:
        status_map = {
            "blocked": (403, "Ваш аккаунт заблокирован. Обратитесь в клинику по телефону."),
            "slot_not_found": (404, "Slot not found"),
            "slot_org_mismatch": (400, "Slot belongs to another organization"),
            "slot_taken": (409, "Slot already booked"),
            "service_inactive": (404, "Service not found"),
            "service_org_mismatch": (400, "Service does not belong to this slot"),
            "slot_service_mismatch": (400, "Slot is reserved for another service"),
            "no_consent": (400, "Требуется согласие на обработку персональных данных"),
            "no_phone": (400, "Invalid phone"),
            "no_slots_for_duration": (409, "Недостаточно свободного времени подряд для этой услуги. Выберите другое время."),
            "slot_in_past": (400, "Slot is in the past"),
            "already_at_time": (409, "У вас уже есть активная запись на это время. Отмените её или выберите другое."),
            "daily_limit_exceeded": (409, result.error_msg or "Превышен лимит активных записей на день."),
            "too_many_active": (409, "Too many active bookings"),
            "doctor_skill": (400, "Специалист не оказывает эту услугу. Выберите другого специалиста."),
            "invalid_slots_count": (400, "Invalid slots_count"),
        }
        code, msg = status_map.get(
            result.error_code, (400, result.error_msg or "Не удалось создать запись")
        )
        raise HTTPException(status_code=code, detail=msg)

    return {"ok": True, "id": result.request_id, "status": result.status}


@router.get("/max_booking/api/mini/slot/{slot_id}")
async def mini_slot_details(slot_id: int, user: dict = Depends(require_user)):
    uid = get_uid_from_user(user)
    if not uid:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Invalid user")

    slot = get_slot(slot_id)
    if not slot:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Slot not found")
    if slot["is_booked"]:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="Slot already booked")

    if not slot["service_id"]:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Slot is universal")

    svc = get_service(slot["service_id"])
    if not svc or not svc["active"]:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Service not found")

    doctor_name = None
    if slot["doctor_id"]:
        d = get_doctor(slot["doctor_id"])
        if d:
            doctor_name = d["name"]

    branch_name = None
    branch_address = None
    if slot["branch_id"]:
        br = get_branch(slot["branch_id"])
        if br:
            branch_name = br["name"]
            branch_address = br["address"]

    return {
        "service": {
            "id": svc["id"], "name": svc["name"], "price": svc["price"],
            "duration_min": svc["duration_min"], "buffer_min": svc["buffer_min"],
            "prep": svc["prep"],
        },
        "slot": {
            "id": slot["id"], "date": slot["date"], "time": slot["time"],
            "doctor_id": slot["doctor_id"], "doctor_name": doctor_name,
            "branch_id": slot["branch_id"], "branch_name": branch_name,
            "branch_address": branch_address, "service_id": slot["service_id"],
        },
    }


@router.post("/max_booking/api/mini/waitlist")
async def mini_waitlist_create(request: Request, user: dict = Depends(require_user)):
    uid = get_uid_from_user(user)
    if not uid:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Invalid user")

    start_param = (user.get("start_param") or "").strip()
    org_id = None
    if start_param.startswith("org_"):
        try:
            org_id = int(start_param[4:])
        except ValueError:
            pass
    if not org_id:
        client = get_client(uid)
        if client and client["org_id"]:
            org_id = client["org_id"]
    if not org_id:
        orgs = list_orgs()
        if len(orgs) == 1:
            org_id = orgs[0]["id"]
    if not org_id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Organization not determined")

    if is_user_blocked(uid):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Аккаунт заблокирован")

    try:
        body = await request.json()
        if not isinstance(body, dict):
            body = {}
    except Exception:
        body = {}

    service_id = str(body.get("service_id") or "").strip()
    date_from = str(body.get("date_from") or "").strip()
    date_to = str(body.get("date_to") or "").strip()
    preferred_time = (body.get("preferred_time") or "").strip() or None
    doctor_id_raw = body.get("doctor_id")
    branch_id_raw = body.get("branch_id")

    if not date_from or not date_to:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="date_from, date_to обязательны")

    svc = None
    if service_id:
        svc = get_service(service_id)
        if not svc or not svc["active"] or svc["org_id"] != org_id:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Услуга не найдена")
    else:
        service_id = None

    try:
        d_from = datetime.strptime(date_from, "%Y-%m-%d").date()
        d_to = datetime.strptime(date_to, "%Y-%m-%d").date()
    except ValueError:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Неверный формат даты (YYYY-MM-DD)")

    today = now_for_org(org_id).date()
    if d_to < d_from:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="date_from должен быть ≤ date_to")
    if d_to < today:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Период уже в прошлом")
    if (d_to - d_from).days > 90:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Слишком длинный период (макс. 90 дней)")

    doctor_id = None
    if doctor_id_raw not in (None, "", 0):
        try:
            doctor_id = int(doctor_id_raw)
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Invalid doctor_id")
        d = get_doctor(doctor_id)
        if not d:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Специалист не найден")

    branch_id = None
    if branch_id_raw not in (None, "", 0):
        try:
            branch_id = int(branch_id_raw)
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Invalid branch_id")
        br = get_branch(branch_id)
        if not br or br["org_id"] != org_id:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Invalid branch_id")

    if preferred_time not in (None, "morning", "afternoon", "evening", "any"):
        preferred_time = None

    if not service_id and not doctor_id:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=400,
            detail="Укажите услугу и/или специалиста",
        )

    wid = create_waitlist_entry(
        org_id, uid, service_id, date_from, date_to,
        doctor_id=doctor_id, branch_id=branch_id,
        preferred_time=preferred_time, created_by=None,
    )

    try:
        from core.waitlist import _notify_waitlist_entry_for_free_slots
        n = await _notify_waitlist_entry_for_free_slots(wid)
        if n:
            log.info("mini_waitlist_create: %d free slots matched for entry %s", n, wid)
    except Exception as e:
        log.warning("mini_waitlist_create: notify-on-create failed: %s", e)

    log_audit(
        org_id=org_id, user_id=uid, action="waitlist_created",
        entity_type="waitlist", entity_id=wid,
        payload={"service_id": service_id, "date_from": date_from,
                 "date_to": date_to, "via": "mini_app"},
    )

    return {"ok": True, "id": wid}


@router.get("/max_booking/api/mini/waitlist")
async def mini_waitlist_list(user: dict = Depends(require_user)):
    uid = get_uid_from_user(user)
    if not uid:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Invalid user")

    client = get_client(uid)
    org_id = client["org_id"] if client else None
    if not org_id:
        orgs = list_orgs()
        if len(orgs) == 1:
            org_id = orgs[0]["id"]
    if not org_id:
        return {"entries": []}

    rows = list_active_waitlist_for_user(org_id, uid)
    return {"entries": [
        {"id": r["id"], "service_id": r["service_id"],
         "service_name": r["service_name"],
         "doctor_id": r["doctor_id"], "doctor_name": r["doctor_name"],
         "branch_id": r["branch_id"], "branch_name": r["branch_name"],
         "date_from": r["date_from"], "date_to": r["date_to"],
         "preferred_time": r["preferred_time"],
         "created_at": r["created_at"]}
        for r in rows
    ]}


@router.delete("/max_booking/api/mini/waitlist/{wid}")
async def mini_waitlist_cancel(wid: int, user: dict = Depends(require_user)):
    uid = get_uid_from_user(user)
    if not uid:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Invalid user")

    entry = get_waitlist_entry(wid)
    if not entry:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Заявка не найдена")
    if str(entry["user_id"]) != str(uid):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Нет доступа")
    if entry["status"] != "active":
        return {"ok": True, "note": "already not active"}

    cancel_waitlist_entry(wid)

    log_audit(
        org_id=entry["org_id"], user_id=uid, action="waitlist_cancelled",
        entity_type="waitlist", entity_id=wid, payload={"via": "mini_app"},
    )

    return {"ok": True}

"""Админские ручки: broadcasts (Manual + Auto)."""

    duplicate_broadcast, update_broadcast_draft,

# ---------- Admin: broadcasts (Manual) ----------

def _check_image_id(ctx: AdminCtx, image_id):
    if image_id is None or image_id == "":
        return None
    try:
        uid_int = int(image_id)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Invalid image_id")
    img = get_uploaded_image_by_id(uid_int)
    if not img or (ctx.role != "superadmin" and img["org_id"] != ctx.org_id):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Image not found")
    return uid_int


@router.get("/max_booking/api/admin/broadcasts")
async def admin_broadcasts(ctx: AdminCtx = Depends(admin_ctx)):
    if not ctx.org_id:
        return {"broadcasts": []}
    rows = list_broadcasts(ctx.org_id)

    image_previews = {}
    for r in rows:
        iid = r["image_id"]
        if iid and iid not in image_previews:
            img = get_uploaded_image_by_id(iid)
            if img and img["public_token"]:
                image_previews[iid] = f"/max_booking/api/upload/{img['public_token']}"
            else:
                image_previews[iid] = None

    return {"broadcasts": [
        {"id": r["id"], "text": r["text"], "status": r["status"],
         "total_recipients": r["total_recipients"], "sent_count": r["sent_count"],
         "failed_count": r["failed_count"], "created_at": r["created_at"],
         "started_at": r["started_at"], "finished_at": r["finished_at"],
         "scheduled_at": r["scheduled_at"],
         "image_id": r["image_id"],
         "has_image": bool(r["image_id"]),
         "preview_url": image_previews.get(r["image_id"]) if r["image_id"] else None}
        for r in rows
    ]}

    return {"count": len(user_ids), "sample": user_ids[:5]}


@router.post("/max_booking/api/admin/broadcasts")
async def admin_broadcast_create(request: Request, ctx: AdminCtx = Depends(org_ctx)):
    body = await request.json()
    text = (body.get("text") or "").strip()
    segment = body.get("segment", {})
    image_id = _check_image_id(ctx, body.get("image_id"))
    start_now = bool(body.get("start_now", True))
    scheduled_at = (body.get("scheduled_at") or "").strip() or None

    if not text:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="text required")

    status = "draft"
    if start_now:
        status = "draft"  # потом переведём в sending через start_draft_broadcast
    elif scheduled_at:
        status = "scheduled"

    bid = create_broadcast(
        ctx.org_id, text, segment, created_by=ctx.uid,
        image_id=image_id, scheduled_at=scheduled_at, status=status,
    )

    if start_now:
        user_ids = await asyncio.to_thread(get_clients_for_segment, ctx.org_id, segment)
        if not user_ids:
            return {"ok": False, "id": bid, "note": "Нет получателей в этом сегменте"}
        prepare_broadcast_sends(bid, user_ids)
        start_broadcast(bid, len(user_ids))

    log_audit(
        org_id=ctx.org_id, user_id=ctx.uid, action="broadcast_created",
        entity_type="broadcast", entity_id=bid,
        payload={"start_now": start_now, "scheduled_at": scheduled_at,
                 "has_image": bool(image_id)},
    )

    return {"ok": True, "id": bid, "status": status if not start_now else "sending"}


@router.put("/max_booking/api/admin/broadcasts/{bid}")
async def admin_broadcast_update(request: Request, bid: int, ctx: AdminCtx = Depends(admin_ctx)):
    b = get_broadcast(bid)
    if not b:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Broadcast not found")
    if ctx.role != "superadmin" and b["org_id"] != ctx.org_id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Access denied")
    if b["status"] not in ("draft", "scheduled"):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Only draft or scheduled can be edited")

    body = await request.json()
    text = (body.get("text") or "").strip()
    segment = body.get("segment", {})
    image_id = _check_image_id(ctx, body.get("image_id"))
    if not text:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="text required")

    update_broadcast_draft(bid, text, segment, image_id=image_id)

    # Если была запланирована — позволяем обновить дату
    if "scheduled_at" in body and b["status"] == "scheduled":
        new_sched = (body.get("scheduled_at") or "").strip()
        if new_sched:
            from storage.db import db as _db
            conn = _db()
            conn.execute("UPDATE broadcasts SET scheduled_at=? WHERE id=?", (new_sched, bid))
            conn.commit()
            conn.close()

    return {"ok": True}

    return {"ok": True, "count": result}

        org_id=ctx.org_id, user_id=ctx.uid, action="auto_broadcast_created",

@router.post("/max_booking/api/admin/auto_broadcasts/{aid}/test")
async def admin_auto_broadcast_test(aid: int, ctx: AdminCtx = Depends(admin_ctx)):
    """Отправляет админу тестовое сообщение с подставленными фиктивными данными."""
    from core.broadcasts import _send_with_refresh, UNSUB_BUTTONS

    a = get_auto_broadcast(aid)
    if not a:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Auto broadcast not found")
    if ctx.role != "superadmin" and a["org_id"] != ctx.org_id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Access denied")

    text = a["text"] or ""
    text = text.replace("{name}", "Иван")
    text = text.replace("{service}", "Тестовая услуга")
    text = text.replace("{scheduled_at}", "2026-11-15 15:00")
    text = text.replace("{address}", "ул. Ленина, 1")
    text = text.replace("{prep}", "Натощак, не есть 6 часов")
    text = text.replace("{last_visit}", "2026-08-15")
    text = text.replace("{days_inactive}", "92")
    text = text.replace("{days_since_visit}", "92")

    header = "🧪 **ТЕСТ** · данные для примера\n\n"
    full_text = header + text

    image_id = a["image_id"]
    try:
        if image_id:
            await _send_with_refresh(
                int(ctx.uid), full_text, image_id,
                buttons=UNSUB_BUTTONS, fmt="markdown",
            )
        else:
            await send_to_client_raw(
                int(ctx.uid), full_text, buttons=UNSUB_BUTTONS, fmt="markdown",
            )
    except UserBlocked:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="Вы заблокировали бота — тест не отправится")
    except Exception as e:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=f"Ошибка отправки: {e}")

    return {"ok": True}

"""Webhook-эндпоинт и регистрация webhook/команд бота в MAX."""
import hmac
import logging

import httpx
from fastapi import APIRouter, Request
from fastapi.responses import JSONResponse

import config
from core import max_client as mx
from core.dispatcher import route
from core.webhook_adapters.max import parse as parse_max_update

log = logging.getLogger(__name__)

router = APIRouter()


async def ensure_webhook_subscribed():
    if not config.MAX_BOT_TOKEN:
        log.warning("MAX_BOT_TOKEN не задан")
        return
    url = config.WEBHOOK_BASE_URL + config.WEBHOOK_PATH
    headers = {"Authorization": config.MAX_BOT_TOKEN}
    try:
        async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=15.0) as client:
            r = await client.get(config.MAX_API + "/subscriptions", headers=headers)
            subs = []
            if r.status_code == 200:
                data = r.json()
                subs = data.get("subscriptions", []) if isinstance(data, dict) else data
            urls = [s.get("url") for s in subs if isinstance(s, dict)]
            if url in urls:
                log.info("Webhook уже зарегистрирован: %s", url)
                return
            body = {
                "url": url,
                "update_types": ["message_created", "message_callback", "bot_started"],
            }
            if config.WEBHOOK_SECRET:
                body["secret"] = config.WEBHOOK_SECRET
            r2 = await client.post(
                config.MAX_API + "/subscriptions",
                headers={**headers, "Content-Type": "application/json"},
                json=body,
            )
            log.info("Регистрация webhook: %s %s", r2.status_code, r2.text[:300])
    except Exception as e:
        log.error("Ошибка регистрации webhook: %s", e)


async def register_bot_commands():
    if not config.MAX_BOT_TOKEN:
        return
    try:
        await mx.set_commands([
            {"name": "start", "description": "Начать запись"},
            {"name": "myid",  "description": "Показать мой ID"},
            {"name": "iam",   "description": "Подать заявку на роль администратора"},
            {"name": "today", "description": "Записи на сегодня (для админа)"},
            {"name": "help",  "description": "Справка"},
        ])
        log.info("Команды бота зарегистрированы")
    except Exception as e:
        log.error("Ошибка регистрации команд: %s", e)


async def startup():
    """Вызывается из lifespan приложения после init_db()."""
    if not config.WEBHOOK_SECRET:
        log.error(
            "⚠ WEBHOOK_SECRET не задан — вебхук НЕ ЗАЩИЩЁН! "
            "Любой может слать поддельные апдейты. Установите секрет в .env."
        )
    log.info("DB_PATH = %s", config.DB_PATH)
    await ensure_webhook_subscribed()
    await register_bot_commands()


@router.post(config.WEBHOOK_PATH)
async def webhook(request: Request):
    if config.WEBHOOK_SECRET:
        got = request.headers.get("X-Max-Bot-Api-Secret", "")
        if not hmac.compare_digest(got, config.WEBHOOK_SECRET):
            log.warning("Webhook 403: secret mismatch (got len=%s, expected len=%s)",
                        len(got or ""), len(config.WEBHOOK_SECRET or ""))
            return JSONResponse({"ok": False}, status_code=403)
    try:
        data = await request.json()
    except Exception:
        log.warning("Webhook: invalid JSON")
        return JSONResponse({"ok": False}, status_code=400)
    log.info("Webhook IN: type=%s", data.get("type") or data.get("update_type"))
    try:
        update = parse_max_update(data)
        if update:
            await route(update)
    except Exception:
        log.exception("route failed")
    return {"ok": True}

@router.get("/max_booking/api/admin/requests")
async def admin_requests(
    date_from: str | None = None,
    date_to: str | None = None,
    status: str | None = None,
    auto_done: str | None = None,
    page: int = 1,
    per_page: int = 20,
    ctx: AdminCtx = Depends(org_ctx),
):
    rows, total = await asyncio.to_thread(
        list_requests_for_org,
        ctx.org_id, date_from=date_from, date_to=date_to,
        status=status, page=page, per_page=per_page,
        auto_done_only=(auto_done == "1"),
    )
    user_ids = list({r["user_id"] for r in rows if r["user_id"]})
    opt_out_map = get_marketing_opt_out_batch(user_ids)
    blocked_map = is_user_blocked_batch(user_ids)
    total_pages = max(1, (total + per_page - 1) // per_page)
    return {
        "requests": [
            {"id": r["id"], "user_id": r["user_id"], "service_id": r["service_id"],
             "service_name": r["service_name"],
             "scheduled_at": r["scheduled_at"], "phone": r["phone"], "status": r["status"],
             "address": r["address"], "doctor": r["doctor"],
             "doctor_id": r["doctor_id"], "slot_id": r["slot_id"],
             "created_at": r["created_at"],
             "actual_amount": r["actual_amount"], "payment_method": r["payment_method"],
             "done_auto": bool(r["done_auto"]),
             "slots_count": r["slots_count"] or 1,
             "marketing_opt_out": opt_out_map.get(r["user_id"], False),
             "blocked": bool(blocked_map.get(r["user_id"]))}
            for r in rows
        ],
        "total": total, "page": page, "per_page": per_page, "total_pages": total_pages,
    }

@router.delete("/max_booking/api/admin/client/{user_id}")
async def admin_client_delete(user_id: str, ctx: AdminCtx = Depends(org_ctx)):
    """Удаление данных клиента (152-ФЗ, право на забвение).

    PII удаляется полностью. History обезличивается — остаётся для
    финансовой отчётности, но идентифицировать клиента по ней нельзя.
    Активные записи отменяются, слоты освобождаются.
    """
    client = get_client(user_id)
    if not client:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Client not found")
    if ctx.role != "superadmin" and client["org_id"] not in (None, ctx.org_id):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Access denied")

    cancelled = delete_client_data(user_id, ctx.org_id)

    log_audit(
        org_id=ctx.org_id, user_id=ctx.uid, action="client_data_deleted",
        entity_type="client", entity_id=user_id,
        payload={"reason": "152-fz request", "cancelled_requests": cancelled},
    )

    return {"ok": True, "cancelled_requests": cancelled}

    )

    return {"ok": True}

@router.put("/max_booking/api/admin/client/{user_id}/card")
async def admin_client_card_update(request: Request, user_id: str, ctx: AdminCtx = Depends(org_ctx)):
    """Обновляет заметки и теги клиента."""
    client = get_client(user_id)
    if not client:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Client not found")
    if ctx.role != "superadmin" and client["org_id"] not in (None, ctx.org_id):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Access denied")

    try:
        body = await request.json()
        if not isinstance(body, dict):
            body = {}
    except Exception:
        body = {}

    notes = (body.get("notes") or "").strip()[:5000]
    tags = body.get("tags") or []
    if not isinstance(tags, list):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="tags must be a list")
    clean_tags = []
    for t in tags:
        if not isinstance(t, str):
            continue
        t = t.strip()[:50]
        if t and t not in clean_tags:
            clean_tags.append(t)
    if len(clean_tags) > 20:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Не больше 20 тегов")

    update_client_notes_tags(user_id, notes, clean_tags)

    log_audit(
        org_id=ctx.org_id, user_id=ctx.uid, action="client_card_updated",
        entity_type="client", entity_id=user_id,
        payload={"tags_count": len(clean_tags), "notes_len": len(notes)},
    )

    return {"ok": True, "notes": notes, "tags": clean_tags}

@router.post("/max_booking/api/admin/client/{user_id}/photo")
async def admin_client_upload_photo(
    user_id: str,
    file: UploadFile = File(...),
    ctx: AdminCtx = Depends(org_ctx),
):
    """Загружает фото клиента. Сжимает, хранит локально, отдаёт через public_token."""
    client = get_client(user_id)
    if not client:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Client not found")
    if ctx.role != "superadmin" and client["org_id"] not in (None, ctx.org_id):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Access denied")

    if not file.content_type or file.content_type not in (
        "image/jpeg", "image/jpg", "image/png", "image/webp", "image/gif",
    ):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Только JPEG/PNG/WebP/GIF")

    raw = await file.read()
    if len(raw) > config.MAX_UPLOAD_SIZE:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=413,
            detail=f"Файл больше {config.MAX_UPLOAD_SIZE // (1024 * 1024)} МБ",
        )
    if not raw:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Пустой файл")

    content, mime, ext = _process_upload_image(raw, file.content_type)

    filename = f"{_uuid.uuid4().hex}.{ext}"
    rel_dir = str(ctx.org_id)
    abs_dir = _Path(config.UPLOADS_DIR) / rel_dir
    abs_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    abs_path = abs_dir / filename
    abs_path.write_bytes(content)
    rel_path = f"{rel_dir}/{filename}"

    upload_id, public_token = save_uploaded_image_full(
        token=None,
        file_path=rel_path,
        mime_type=mime,
        original_filename=file.filename or filename,
        file_size=len(content),
        org_id=ctx.org_id,
        uploaded_by=ctx.uid,
    )

    set_client_photo(user_id, upload_id)

    log_audit(
        org_id=ctx.org_id, user_id=ctx.uid, action="client_photo_uploaded",
        entity_type="client", entity_id=user_id,
        payload={"upload_id": upload_id, "size": len(content), "mime": mime},
    )

    return {
        "ok": True,
        "photo_upload_id": upload_id,
        "photo_url": f"/max_booking/api/upload/{public_token}",
    }


@router.delete("/max_booking/api/admin/client/{user_id}/photo")
