@router.post("/max_booking/api/admin/client/{user_id}/message-with-file")
async def admin_client_send_message_with_file(
    user_id: str,
    file: UploadFile = File(None),
    text: str = Form(""),
    ctx: AdminCtx = Depends(org_ctx),
):
    """Отправляет клиенту сообщение с файлом. Фото сжимаются.
    При ошибке отправки возвращает ссылку для скачивания."""
    client = get_client(user_id)
    if not client:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Client not found")
    if ctx.role != "superadmin" and client["org_id"] not in (None, ctx.org_id):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Access denied")

    clean_text = (text or "").strip()
    if len(clean_text) > 4000:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Текст не длиннее 4000 символов")
    if not clean_text and not file:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Введите текст или прикрепите файл")

    if not file:
        status, err = await send_to_client(user_id, clean_text, fmt="markdown")
        log_audit(
            org_id=ctx.org_id, user_id=ctx.uid, action="client_message_sent",
            entity_type="client", entity_id=user_id,
            payload={"status": status, "text_len": len(clean_text), "has_file": False},
        )
        return {"ok": status == "sent", "status": status, "error": err, "url": None}

    allowed_mimes = (
        "image/jpeg", "image/jpg", "image/png", "image/webp", "image/gif",
        "application/pdf", "text/plain", "text/csv",
        "application/msword",
        "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document",
        "application/vnd.ms-excel",
        "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet",
    )
    if file.content_type not in allowed_mimes:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=400,
            detail=f"Формат {file.content_type} не поддерживается. "
                   f"Разрешены: изображения, PDF, TXT, CSV, DOC/DOCX, XLS/XLSX.",
        )

    raw = await file.read()
    if len(raw) > config.MAX_UPLOAD_SIZE:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=413,
            detail=f"Файл больше {config.MAX_UPLOAD_SIZE // (1024 * 1024)} МБ",
        )
    if not raw:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Пустой файл")

    is_image = file.content_type in ("image/jpeg", "image/jpg", "image/png", "image/webp", "image/gif")
    if is_image:
        content, mime, ext = _process_upload_image(raw, file.content_type)
    else:
        content = raw
        mime = file.content_type
        ext = "bin"
        if mime == "application/pdf": ext = "pdf"
        elif mime == "text/plain": ext = "txt"
        elif mime == "text/csv": ext = "csv"
        elif mime == "application/msword": ext = "doc"
        elif "wordprocessingml" in mime: ext = "docx"
        elif mime == "application/vnd.ms-excel": ext = "xls"
        elif "spreadsheetml" in mime: ext = "xlsx"

    orig_name = file.filename or f"attachment.{ext}"
    safe_name = "".join(c for c in orig_name if c.isalnum() or c in "._- ").strip() or f"attachment.{ext}"
    caption = clean_text or "📎 Файл"

    status = "error"
    err = None
    try:
        token = await upload_file_for_client(
            user_id, content, filename=safe_name, mime=mime,
            upload_type="image" if is_image else "file",
        )
        if is_image:
            await send_to_client_with_image_raw(user_id, caption, token, fmt="markdown")
        else:
            await send_to_client_with_file_raw(user_id, caption, token, fmt="markdown")
        status = "sent"
    except UserBlocked:
        status = "blocked"
    except Exception as e:
        log.warning("send file to client %s failed: %s", user_id, e)
        err = str(e)[:200]

    public_url = None
    full_url = None
    if status != "sent":
        rel_dir = str(ctx.org_id)
        abs_dir = _Path(config.UPLOADS_DIR) / rel_dir
        abs_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        local_name = f"{_uuid.uuid4().hex}.{ext}"
        abs_path = abs_dir / local_name
        abs_path.write_bytes(content)
        rel_path = f"{rel_dir}/{local_name}"
        uid_img, public_token = save_uploaded_image_full(
            token=None, file_path=rel_path, mime_type=mime,
            original_filename=safe_name, file_size=len(content),
            org_id=ctx.org_id, uploaded_by=ctx.uid,
        )
        public_url = f"/max_booking/api/upload/{public_token}"
        full_url = config.WEBHOOK_BASE_URL.rstrip("/") + public_url

    log_audit(
        org_id=ctx.org_id, user_id=ctx.uid, action="client_message_sent",
        entity_type="client", entity_id=user_id,
        payload={"status": status, "text_len": len(clean_text),
                 "has_file": True, "mime": mime, "size": len(content)},
    )

    return {
        "ok": status == "sent",
        "status": status,
        "error": err,
        "url": public_url,
        "full_url": full_url,
        "filename": safe_name,
    }


@router.post("/max_booking/api/admin/client/{user_id}/message")
async def admin_client_send_message(request: Request, user_id: str, ctx: AdminCtx = Depends(org_ctx)):
    """Отправить произвольное сообщение клиенту (пока только через MAX)."""
    client = get_client(user_id)
    if not client:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Client not found")
    if ctx.role != "superadmin" and client["org_id"] not in (None, ctx.org_id):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Access denied")

    try:
        body = await request.json()
        if not isinstance(body, dict):
            body = {}
    except Exception:
        body = {}

    text = (body.get("text") or "").strip()
    if not text:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Текст сообщения обязателен")
    if len(text) > 4000:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Текст не длиннее 4000 символов")

    status, err = await send_to_client(user_id, text, fmt="markdown")

    log_audit(
        org_id=ctx.org_id, user_id=ctx.uid, action="client_message_sent",
        entity_type="client", entity_id=user_id,
        payload={"status": status, "text_len": len(text)},
    )

    return {"ok": status == "sent", "status": status, "error": err}


@router.get("/max_booking/api/admin/client/{user_id}/export")
async def admin_client_export_file(
    user_id: str,
    format: str = "csv",
    target: str = "admin",
    ctx: AdminCtx = Depends(org_ctx),
):
    """Генерирует CSV/XLSX/PDF и отправляет файл:
    - target=admin (по умолчанию): в чат админу, который запросил.
    - target=client: в чат клиенту через MAX, если у него есть MAX и он не заблокировал бота.
    """
    from datetime import datetime as _dt

    data = await asyncio.to_thread(get_client_full, user_id, ctx.org_id)
    if not data:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Client not found")
    client = data["client"]
    if ctx.role != "superadmin" and client["org_id"] not in (None, ctx.org_id):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Access denied")

    org = get_org(ctx.org_id)
    data["org_name"] = org["name"] if org else ""

    fmt = (format or "csv").lower().strip()
    tgt = (target or "admin").lower().strip()
    if tgt not in ("admin", "client"):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="target must be admin or client")

    if tgt == "client":
        if fmt == "csv":
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=400,
                detail="Клиенту доступны только PDF и XLSX",
            )
        if str(user_id).startswith("phone:"):
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=400,
                detail="У клиента нет MAX-профиля — отправить файл невозможно",
            )
        if is_user_blocked(user_id):
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=400,
                detail="Клиент заблокирован",
            )

    ts = _dt.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
    fio = " ".join(p for p in [client["last_name"], client["first_name"], client["middle_name"]] if p).strip() or user_id
    for_client = (tgt == "client")

    try:
        if fmt == "csv":
            content = build_client_export_csv(data, client)
            filename = f"client_{user_id}_{ts}.csv"
            mime = "text/csv"
            ext = "csv"
        elif fmt == "xlsx":
            content = await asyncio.to_thread(
                build_client_export_xlsx, data, client, for_client,
            )
            prefix = "my_visits" if for_client else "client"
            filename = f"{prefix}_{user_id}_{ts}.xlsx"
            mime = "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet"
            ext = "xlsx"
        elif fmt == "pdf":
            content = await asyncio.to_thread(
                build_client_export_pdf, data, client, for_client,
            )
            prefix = "my_visits" if for_client else "client"
            filename = f"{prefix}_{user_id}_{ts}.pdf"
            mime = "application/pdf"
            ext = "pdf"
        else:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="format must be csv, xlsx or pdf")
    except HTTPException:
        raise
    except Exception as e:
        log.error("export build error: %s", e)
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=f"Ошибка формирования файла: {e}")

    rel_dir = str(ctx.org_id)
    abs_dir = _Path(config.UPLOADS_DIR) / rel_dir
    abs_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    local_name = f"{_uuid.uuid4().hex}.{ext}"
    abs_path = abs_dir / local_name
    abs_path.write_bytes(content)
    rel_path = f"{rel_dir}/{local_name}"

    uid_int, public_token = save_uploaded_image_full(
        token=None, file_path=rel_path, mime_type=mime,
        original_filename=filename, file_size=len(content),
        org_id=ctx.org_id, uploaded_by=ctx.uid,
    )
    public_url = f"/max_booking/api/upload/{public_token}"
    full_url = config.WEBHOOK_BASE_URL.rstrip("/") + public_url

    if tgt == "client":
        send_caption = (
            f"📄 **Ваши визиты**\n\n"
            f"Файл: {filename}\n"
            f"Если нужно сохранить на телефон — откройте файл и нажмите «Скачать»."
        )
        recipient_id = int(user_id)
    else:
        send_caption = (
            f"📥 **Экспорт данных клиента**\n\n"
            f"👤 {fio}\n"
            f"📄 {filename} ({len(content) // 1024} KB)"
        )
        recipient_id = int(ctx.uid)

    sent_ok = False
    send_err = None
    try:
        token = await upload_file_for_client(
            recipient_id, content, filename=filename, mime=mime, upload_type="file",
        )
        await send_to_client_with_file_raw(recipient_id, send_caption, token, fmt="markdown")
        sent_ok = True
    except UserBlocked:
        send_err = "blocked"
    except Exception as e:
        log.error("export send to %s failed: %s", recipient_id, e)
        send_err = str(e)[:200]

    if sent_ok:
        try:
            delete_uploaded_image_file(uid_int)
            public_url = None
            full_url = None
        except Exception as e:
            log.warning("export cleanup failed for upload_id=%s: %s", uid_int, e)

    log_audit(
        org_id=ctx.org_id, user_id=ctx.uid,
        action=f"client_export_{fmt}_to_{tgt}",
        entity_type="client", entity_id=user_id,
        payload={"filename": filename, "size": len(content), "sent_to_chat": sent_ok},
    )

    return {
        "ok": True,
        "filename": filename,
        "format": fmt,
        "target": tgt,
        "url": public_url,
        "full_url": full_url,
        "sent_to_chat": sent_ok,
        "send_error": send_err,
    }


@router.get("/max_booking/api/admin/request/{request_id}/slot_options")
async def admin_request_slot_options(request_id: int, ctx: AdminCtx = Depends(org_ctx)):
    """Сколько подряд идущих слотов доступно для этой записи.

    Идём по РЕАЛЬНОМУ списку слотов специалиста/филиала/даты (ORDER BY time),
    а не по вычисленному времени с шагом step_min. Так не ломаемся,
    если шаг сетки в настройках не совпадает с шагом реальных слотов.

    «Наши» слоты (is_booked=1, request_id=current) считаем доступными —
    их можно как оставить, так и уменьшить.
    """
    req = get_request(request_id)
    if not req:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Request not found")
    if ctx.role != "superadmin" and req["org_id"] != ctx.org_id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Access denied")

    first_slot_id = req["slot_id"]
    if not first_slot_id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="У записи нет первого слота")

    slot = get_slot(first_slot_id)
    if not slot:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="Первый слот не найден")

    settings = get_org_settings(ctx.org_id)
    step_min = int(settings.get("slot_step_min", 30) or 30)

    with db_ctx() as conn:
        all_slots = conn.execute(
            "SELECT id, time, is_booked, request_id FROM slots "
            "WHERE date=? AND doctor_id IS ? AND branch_id IS ? "
            "ORDER BY time",
            (slot["date"], slot["doctor_id"], slot["branch_id"]),
        ).fetchall()

    first_idx = None
    for i, s in enumerate(all_slots):
        if s["id"] == first_slot_id:
            first_idx = i
            break
    if first_idx is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="Первый слот не найден в списке")

    max_consecutive = 0
    slots_list = []
    limit_reason = None
    break_from = None
    break_until = None
    conflict_at = None
    prev_min = None

    for i in range(first_idx, len(all_slots)):
        s = all_slots[i]

        if prev_min is not None:
            expected_min = prev_min + step_min
            if expected_min >= 24 * 60:
                limit_reason = "end_of_day"
                break
            expected_time = f"{expected_min // 60:02d}:{expected_min % 60:02d}"

            try:
                ch, cm = map(int, s["time"].split(":"))
                cur_min = ch * 60 + cm
            except Exception:
                limit_reason = "bad_time"
                break

            if cur_min != expected_min:
                if cur_min > expected_min:
                    limit_reason = "break"
                    break_from = expected_time
                    break_until = s["time"]
                else:
                    limit_reason = "out_of_order"
                break

        is_ours = (s["request_id"] == request_id)
        is_free = (s["is_booked"] == 0)

        if not (is_ours or is_free):
            if prev_min is None:
                limit_reason = "first_not_ours"
            else:
                limit_reason = "busy"
                conflict_at = s["time"]
            break

        max_consecutive += 1
        slots_list.append({
            "slot_id": s["id"], "time": s["time"],
            "is_current": is_ours, "is_free": is_free,
        })
        h, m = map(int, s["time"].split(":"))
        prev_min = h * 60 + m
    else:
        if prev_min is not None and limit_reason is None:
            limit_reason = "end_of_slots"

    suggested = (
        slots_needed_for_service(req["service_id"], step_min)
        if req["service_id"] else 1
    )

    return {
        "request_id": request_id,
        "max_consecutive": max_consecutive,
        "current_slots_count": req["slots_count"] or 1,
        "suggested_by_service": suggested,
        "step_min": step_min,
        "limit_reason": limit_reason,
        "break_from": break_from,
        "break_until": break_until,
        "conflict_at": conflict_at,
        "first_slot": {
            "date": slot["date"], "time": slot["time"],
            "doctor_id": slot["doctor_id"], "branch_id": slot["branch_id"],
        },
        "slots": slots_list,
    }


@router.put("/max_booking/api/admin/request/{request_id}/edit")
async def admin_request_edit(request: Request, request_id: int, ctx: AdminCtx = Depends(org_ctx)):
    """Редактирование услуги и/или количества слотов существующей записи."""
    req = get_request(request_id)
    if not req:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Request not found")
    if ctx.role != "superadmin" and req["org_id"] != ctx.org_id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Access denied")
    if req["status"] not in ("pending", "confirmed"):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="Можно редактировать только активную запись")

    try:
        body = await request.json()
        if not isinstance(body, dict):
            body = {}
    except Exception:
        body = {}

    if "service_id" in body:
        raw_sid = body.get("service_id")
        if raw_sid in (None, "", 0):
            new_service_id = None
            new_service_name = "Приём (услуга не указана)"
        else:
            new_service_id = str(raw_sid).strip()
            svc = get_service(new_service_id)
            if not svc or svc["org_id"] != ctx.org_id:
                raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Услуга не найдена")
            new_service_name = svc["name"]
            if req["doctor_id"] and not doctor_makes_service(req["doctor_id"], new_service_id):
                raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Специалист не оказывает эту услугу")
    else:
        new_service_id = req["service_id"]
        new_service_name = req["service_name"]

    settings = get_org_settings(ctx.org_id)
    step_min = int(settings.get("slot_step_min", 30) or 30)

    if "slots_count" in body:
        try:
            new_slots_count = int(body["slots_count"])
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Invalid slots_count")
        if new_slots_count < 1 or new_slots_count > 20:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="slots_count must be 1..20")
    else:
        new_slots_count = req["slots_count"] or 1

    ok, err, msg, _payload = update_booking_extended(
        request_id, new_service_id, new_service_name, new_slots_count, step_min,
    )
    if not ok:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail=msg or err or "Не удалось обновить")

    log_audit(
        org_id=ctx.org_id, user_id=ctx.uid, action="request_edited",
        entity_type="request", entity_id=request_id,
        payload={"service_id": new_service_id, "service_name": new_service_name,
                 "slots_count": new_slots_count},
    )

    if (req["service_id"] != new_service_id) or ((req["slots_count"] or 1) != new_slots_count):
        if not str(req["user_id"]).startswith("phone:"):
            try:
                svc = get_service(new_service_id) if new_service_id else None
                service_duration = (svc["duration_min"] if svc else None) or None
                booked_min = new_slots_count * step_min
                default_slots = (
                    slots_needed_for_service(new_service_id, step_min)
                    if new_service_id else 1
                )
                overridden = new_slots_count != default_slots

                text = (
                    f"🔄 **Ваша запись обновлена**\n\n"
                    f"**{new_service_name}**\n"
                    f"📅 {req['scheduled_at']}\n"
                )
                if service_duration:
                    text += f"⏱ Услуга: {service_duration} мин\n"
                if overridden:
                    text += f"🗓 Забронировано: {new_slots_count} слота ({booked_min} мин)\n"
                if new_service_id is None:
                    text += "\n⚠️ Услуга не указана. Свяжитесь с администратором для уточнения."
                await send_to_client(req["user_id"], text, fmt="markdown")
            except Exception as e:
                log.warning("edit request notify failed: %s", e)

    return {
        "ok": True,
        "id": request_id,
        "service_id": new_service_id,
        "service_name": new_service_name,
        "slots_count": new_slots_count,
    }


@router.post("/max_booking/api/admin/request/{request_id}/move")
async def admin_request_move(request: Request, request_id: int, ctx: AdminCtx = Depends(org_ctx)):
    """Перенос записи на новый слот. Освобождает старые, занимает новые."""
    req = get_request(request_id)
    if not req:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Request not found")
    if ctx.role != "superadmin" and req["org_id"] != ctx.org_id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Access denied")

    try:
        body = await request.json()
        if not isinstance(body, dict):
            body = {}
    except Exception:
        body = {}

    try:
        new_slot_id = int(body.get("new_slot_id"))
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="new_slot_id обязателен")

    result = await move_booking_unified(request_id, new_slot_id, via="admin")

    if not result.ok:
        status_map = {
            "request_not_found": 404,
            "request_not_active": 409,
            "slot_not_found": 404,
            "slot_org_mismatch": 403,
            "slot_taken": 409,
            "slot_in_past": 400,
            "already_at_time": 409,
            "no_slots_for_duration": 409,
            "doctor_skill": 400,
            "move_failed": 409,
        }
        code = status_map.get(result.error_code, 400)
        raise HTTPException(status_code=code, detail=result.error_msg or "Не удалось перенести")

    log_audit(
        org_id=ctx.org_id, user_id=ctx.uid, action="request_moved",
        entity_type="request", entity_id=request_id,
        payload={"from": req["scheduled_at"], "to": result.scheduled_at},
    )

    return {"ok": True, "id": request_id, "scheduled_at": result.scheduled_at}


@router.post("/max_booking/api/admin/request/create")
async def admin_request_create(request: Request, ctx: AdminCtx = Depends(org_ctx)):
    body = await request.json()
    service_id = str(body.get("service_id") or "").strip() or None
    slot_id_raw = body.get("slot_id")
    phone = str(body.get("phone") or "").strip()
    first_name = str(body.get("first_name") or "").strip()[:100]
    last_name = str(body.get("last_name") or "").strip()[:100]
    middle_name = str(body.get("middle_name") or "").strip()[:100]
    user_id_hint = (body.get("user_id") or "").strip()

    if not slot_id_raw or not phone:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="slot_id и phone обязательны")

    phone = normalize_phone(phone)
    if not phone:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Некорректный телефон")

    try:
        slot_id = int(slot_id_raw)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Invalid slot_id")

    slot = get_slot(slot_id)
    if not slot:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Slot not found")
    if slot["org_id"] != ctx.org_id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Slot belongs to another organization")

    if slot["is_booked"]:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="Slot already booked")

    if user_id_hint:
        user_id = user_id_hint
        existing = get_client(user_id)
        if existing and existing["org_id"] not in (None, ctx.org_id):
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Client belongs to another organization")
        if existing and existing["org_id"] is None:
            upsert_client(user_id, org_id=ctx.org_id)
    else:
        user_id = get_or_create_client_by_phone(
            ctx.org_id, first_name, last_name, middle_name, phone,
        )

    ctx_b = BookingContext(
        org_id=ctx.org_id,
        user_id=str(user_id),
        slot_id=slot_id,
        service_id=service_id,
        phone=phone,
        first_name=first_name,
        last_name=last_name,
        middle_name=middle_name,
        slots_count_override=body.get("slots_count_override") if body.get("slots_count_override") is not None else None,
        via="admin",
        skip_consent_check=True,
        confirm_over_daily_limit=bool(body.get("confirm_over_daily_limit")),
    )

    result = await create_booking_unified(ctx_b)

    if not result.ok:
        if result.error_code == "daily_limit_exceeded":
            booking_settings = get_org_settings(ctx.org_id)
            max_per_day = int(booking_settings.get("max_bookings_per_day", 2) or 0)
            date_str = slot["date"]
            day_count = count_active_bookings_on_date(user_id, ctx.org_id, date_str)
            existing = list_active_bookings_on_date(user_id, ctx.org_id, date_str)
            return {
                "ok": False,
                "error_code": "daily_limit_exceeded",
                "message": (
                    f"У клиента уже {day_count} активных записей на этот день "
                    f"(лимит {max_per_day}). Всё равно создать новую?"
                ),
                "existing_count": day_count,
                "max_per_day": max_per_day,
                "existing_bookings": [
                    {
                        "id": r["id"],
                        "service_name": r["service_name"],
                        "scheduled_at": r["scheduled_at"],
                        "doctor": r["doctor"],
                    }
                    for r in existing
                ],
            }
        status_map = {
            "slot_not_found": 404,
            "slot_org_mismatch": 403,
            "slot_taken": 409,
            "slot_service_mismatch": 400,
            "service_inactive": 404,
            "service_org_mismatch": 400,
            "no_phone": 400,
            "invalid_slots_count": 400,
            "no_slots_for_duration": 409,
            "already_at_time": 409,
            "too_many_active": 409,
            "doctor_skill": 400,
            "blocked": 403,
            "slot_in_past": 400,
        }
        code = status_map.get(result.error_code, 400)
        raise HTTPException(status_code=code, detail=result.error_msg or "Не удалось создать запись")

    return {
        "ok": True,
        "id": result.request_id,
        "status": result.status,
        "user_id": user_id,
        "notified": result.notify_status == "sent",
        "notify_status": result.notify_status,
        "notify_error": None,
        "slots_count": result.slots_count,
    }

async def _mark_visit(ctx: AdminCtx, request_id: int, new_status: str, body: dict | None = None):
    body = body or {}
    req = get_request(request_id)
    if not req:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Request not found")
    r_org_id = req["org_id"]
    status = req["status"]

    if ctx.role != "superadmin" and r_org_id != ctx.org_id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Access denied")

    actual_amount = None
    payment_method = None
    if new_status == "done":
        raw_amount = body.get("actual_amount")
        if raw_amount is not None and raw_amount != "":
            try:
                actual_amount = int(raw_amount)
                if actual_amount < 0:
                    raise ValueError
            except (TypeError, ValueError):
                raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="actual_amount must be non-negative integer")
        pm = body.get("payment_method")
        if pm:
            pm = str(pm).strip()
            if pm not in ("cash", "card", "transfer", "other"):
                raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Invalid payment_method")
            payment_method = pm

    if status == new_status:
        if new_status == "done" and (actual_amount is not None or payment_method is not None):
            set_request_payment(request_id, actual_amount, payment_method)
            log_audit(
                org_id=ctx.org_id, user_id=ctx.uid, action="payment_updated",
                entity_type="request", entity_id=request_id,
                payload={"actual_amount": actual_amount, "payment_method": payment_method},
            )
            return {
                "ok": True,
                "status": new_status,
                "note": "already marked, payment updated",
                "actual_amount": actual_amount,
                "payment_method": payment_method,
            }
        return {"ok": True, "status": new_status, "note": "already marked"}

    if not update_request_status(request_id, new_status, admin_id=ctx.uid):
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=409,
            detail=(
                f"Нельзя отметить заявку #{request_id} как «{new_status}»: "
                f"текущий статус «{status}»."
            ),
        )

    if new_status == "done" and (actual_amount is not None or payment_method is not None):
        set_request_payment(request_id, actual_amount, payment_method)

    log_audit(
        org_id=ctx.org_id, user_id=ctx.uid,
        action=f"status_changed_to_{new_status}",
        entity_type="request", entity_id=request_id,
        payload={"from": status, "to": new_status,
                 "actual_amount": actual_amount, "payment_method": payment_method},
    )

    return {
        "ok": True,
        "status": new_status,
        "actual_amount": actual_amount,
        "payment_method": payment_method,
    }


@router.put("/max_booking/api/admin/request/{request_id}/payment")
async def admin_update_payment(request: Request, request_id: int, ctx: AdminCtx = Depends(admin_ctx)):
    req = get_request(request_id)
    if not req:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Request not found")
    r_org_id = req["org_id"]
    if ctx.role != "superadmin" and r_org_id != ctx.org_id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Access denied")

    try:
        body = await request.json()
        if not isinstance(body, dict):
            body = {}
    except Exception:
        body = {}

    raw_amount = body.get("actual_amount")
    actual_amount = None
    if raw_amount is not None and raw_amount != "":
        try:
            actual_amount = int(raw_amount)
            if actual_amount < 0:
                raise ValueError
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="actual_amount must be non-negative integer")

    pm = body.get("payment_method")
    payment_method = None
    if pm:
        pm = str(pm).strip()
        if pm not in ("cash", "card", "transfer", "other"):
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Invalid payment_method")
        payment_method = pm

    if not set_request_payment(request_id, actual_amount, payment_method):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="Payment can be edited only for done/no_show requests")

    log_audit(
        org_id=ctx.org_id, user_id=ctx.uid, action="payment_updated",
        entity_type="request", entity_id=request_id,
        payload={"actual_amount": actual_amount, "payment_method": payment_method},
    )

    return {"ok": True, "actual_amount": actual_amount, "payment_method": payment_method}


@router.post("/max_booking/api/admin/request/{request_id}/confirm")
async def admin_confirm(request_id: int, ctx: AdminCtx = Depends(admin_ctx)):
    req = get_request(request_id)
    if not req:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Request not found")

    r_org_id = req["org_id"]
    client_uid = req["user_id"]
    service_name = req["service_name"]
    scheduled_at = req["scheduled_at"]
    status = req["status"]
    address = req["address"]
    doctor = req["doctor"]

    if ctx.role != "superadmin" and r_org_id != ctx.org_id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Access denied")
    if status == "confirmed":
        return {"ok": True, "status": "confirmed", "note": "already confirmed"}

    if not update_request_status(request_id, "confirmed", admin_id=ctx.uid):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="Request is not pending (already cancelled?)")
    text = (
        f"✅ **Ваша запись подтверждена!**\n\n"
        f"**{service_name}**\n📅 {scheduled_at}\n"
    )
    if address:
        text += route_lines(address, org_id=r_org_id)
    if doctor:
        text += f"👨‍⚕️ {doctor}\n"
    text += "\nЖдём вас!"
    if not str(client_uid).startswith("phone:"):
        status_ics, err = await send_confirmation_with_ics(
            client_uid, text, request_id, r_org_id, req["service_id"],
            service_name, scheduled_at, address or "", doctor or "",
        )
        if status_ics == "error":
            log.warning("notify failed for #%s: %s", request_id, err)

    log_audit(
        org_id=ctx.org_id, user_id=ctx.uid, action="request_confirmed",
        entity_type="request", entity_id=request_id,
        payload={"service": service_name, "scheduled_at": scheduled_at},
    )

    return {"ok": True, "status": "confirmed"}


@router.post("/max_booking/api/admin/request/{request_id}/reject")
async def admin_reject(request_id: int, ctx: AdminCtx = Depends(admin_ctx)):
    req = get_request(request_id)
    if not req:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Request not found")

    r_org_id = req["org_id"]
    client_uid = req["user_id"]
    service_name = req["service_name"]
    scheduled_at = req["scheduled_at"]
    status = req["status"]
    slot_id = req["slot_id"]

    if ctx.role != "superadmin" and r_org_id != ctx.org_id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Access denied")
    if status == "cancelled":
        return {"ok": True, "status": "cancelled", "note": "already cancelled"}

    was_confirmed = (status == "confirmed")
    if not update_request_status(request_id, "cancelled", admin_id=ctx.uid):
        return {"ok": True, "status": "cancelled", "note": "already cancelled"}
    if slot_id:
        release_slot(slot_id, request_id)

    text = (
        f"❌ **Запись #{request_id} {'отменена администратором' if was_confirmed else 'отклонена'}.**\n\n"
        f"**{service_name}**\n📅 {scheduled_at}\n\n"
        f"Администратор свяжется с вами для уточнения деталей."
    )
    if not str(client_uid).startswith("phone:"):
        try:
            await send_to_client_raw(client_uid, text, fmt="markdown")
        except Exception as e:
            log.warning("notify failed: %s", e)

    log_audit(
        org_id=ctx.org_id, user_id=ctx.uid,
        action="request_cancelled_by_admin" if was_confirmed else "request_rejected",
        entity_type="request", entity_id=request_id,
        payload={"service": service_name, "scheduled_at": scheduled_at},
    )

    return {"ok": True, "status": "cancelled", "was_confirmed": was_confirmed}

@router.post("/max_booking/api/admin/waitlist")
async def admin_waitlist_create(request: Request, ctx: AdminCtx = Depends(org_ctx)):
    try:
        body = await request.json()
        if not isinstance(body, dict):
            body = {}
    except Exception:
        body = {}

    user_id = str(body.get("user_id") or "").strip()
    phone = str(body.get("phone") or "").strip()
    first_name = str(body.get("first_name") or "").strip()[:100]
    last_name = str(body.get("last_name") or "").strip()[:100]
    middle_name = str(body.get("middle_name") or "").strip()[:100]
    service_id = str(body.get("service_id") or "").strip()
    date_from = str(body.get("date_from") or "").strip()
    date_to = str(body.get("date_to") or "").strip()
    preferred_time = (body.get("preferred_time") or "").strip() or None
    notes = (body.get("notes") or "").strip()[:500]
    doctor_id_raw = body.get("doctor_id")
    branch_id_raw = body.get("branch_id")

    if not date_from or not date_to:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="date_from, date_to обязательны")
    if not user_id and not phone:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Нужен user_id или phone")

    svc = None
    if service_id:
        svc = get_service(service_id)
        if not svc or svc["org_id"] != ctx.org_id:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Услуга не найдена")
    else:
        service_id = None

    try:
        from datetime import datetime as _dt
        d_from = _dt.strptime(date_from, "%Y-%m-%d").date()
        d_to = _dt.strptime(date_to, "%Y-%m-%d").date()
    except ValueError:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Неверный формат даты")
    if d_to < d_from:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="date_from должен быть ≤ date_to")

    if not user_id:
        phone_norm = normalize_phone(phone)
        if not phone_norm:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Invalid phone")
        user_id = get_or_create_client_by_phone(
            ctx.org_id, first_name, last_name, middle_name, phone_norm,
        )

    doctor_id = None
    if doctor_id_raw not in (None, "", 0):
        try:
            doctor_id = int(doctor_id_raw)
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Invalid doctor_id")
        d = get_doctor(doctor_id)
        if not d:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Специалист не найден")

    if not service_id and not doctor_id:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=400,
            detail="Укажите услугу и/или специалиста",
        )

    branch_id = None
    if branch_id_raw not in (None, "", 0):
        try:
            branch_id = int(branch_id_raw)
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Invalid branch_id")

    if preferred_time not in (None, "morning", "afternoon", "evening", "any"):
        preferred_time = None

    wid = create_waitlist_entry(
        ctx.org_id, user_id, service_id, date_from, date_to,
        doctor_id=doctor_id, branch_id=branch_id,
        preferred_time=preferred_time, notes=notes,
        created_by=ctx.uid,
    )

    try:
        from core.waitlist import _notify_waitlist_entry_for_free_slots
        n = await _notify_waitlist_entry_for_free_slots(wid)
        if n:
            log.info("admin_waitlist_create: %d free slots matched for entry %s", n, wid)
    except Exception as e:
        log.warning("admin_waitlist_create: notify-on-create failed: %s", e)

    log_audit(
        org_id=ctx.org_id, user_id=ctx.uid, action="waitlist_created",
        entity_type="waitlist", entity_id=wid,
        payload={"service_id": service_id, "date_from": date_from,
                 "date_to": date_to, "via": "admin"},
    )

    return {"ok": True, "id": wid, "user_id": user_id}


@router.put("/max_booking/api/admin/waitlist/{wid}")
async def admin_waitlist_update(wid: int, request: Request, ctx: AdminCtx = Depends(org_ctx)):
    entry = get_waitlist_entry(wid)
    if not entry:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Заявка не найдена")
    if entry["org_id"] != ctx.org_id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Access denied")

    try:
        body = await request.json()
        if not isinstance(body, dict):
            body = {}
    except Exception:
        body = {}

    fields = {}
    if "service_id" in body:
        raw_sid = body["service_id"]
        if raw_sid in (None, "", 0):
            fields["service_id"] = None
        else:
            sid = str(raw_sid).strip()
            svc = get_service(sid)
            if not svc or svc["org_id"] != ctx.org_id:
                raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Invalid service_id")
            fields["service_id"] = sid
    if "date_from" in body:
        fields["date_from"] = str(body["date_from"]).strip()
    if "date_to" in body:
        fields["date_to"] = str(body["date_to"]).strip()
    if "doctor_id" in body:
        d = body["doctor_id"]
        fields["doctor_id"] = int(d) if d not in (None, "", 0) else None
    if "branch_id" in body:
        b = body["branch_id"]
        fields["branch_id"] = int(b) if b not in (None, "", 0) else None
    if "preferred_time" in body:
        pt = (body["preferred_time"] or "").strip() or None
        if pt not in (None, "morning", "afternoon", "evening", "any"):
            pt = None
        fields["preferred_time"] = pt
    if "notes" in body:
        fields["notes"] = (body["notes"] or "").strip()[:500]

    try:
        from datetime import datetime as _dt
        new_from = fields.get("date_from", entry["date_from"])
        new_to = fields.get("date_to", entry["date_to"])
        _dt.strptime(new_from, "%Y-%m-%d")
        _dt.strptime(new_to, "%Y-%m-%d")
        if new_to < new_from:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="date_from должен быть ≤ date_to")
    except ValueError:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Неверный формат даты")

    if fields:
        update_waitlist_entry(wid, **fields)

    log_audit(
        org_id=ctx.org_id, user_id=ctx.uid, action="waitlist_updated",
        entity_type="waitlist", entity_id=wid,
        payload={"fields": list(fields.keys())},
    )

    return {"ok": True}


@router.delete("/max_booking/api/admin/waitlist/{wid}")
async def admin_waitlist_cancel(wid: int, ctx: AdminCtx = Depends(org_ctx)):
    entry = get_waitlist_entry(wid)

        entity_type="waitlist", entity_id=wid, payload={"via": "admin"},
    )

    return {"ok": True}


@router.post("/max_booking/api/admin/waitlist/{wid}/notify")
async def admin_waitlist_notify(wid: int, ctx: AdminCtx = Depends(org_ctx)):
    entry = get_waitlist_entry(wid)
    if not entry:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Заявка не найдена")
    if entry["org_id"] != ctx.org_id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Access denied")

    result, info = await wl_notify_single(wid)
    if result == "sent":
        log_audit(
            org_id=ctx.org_id, user_id=ctx.uid, action="waitlist_notified",
            entity_type="waitlist", entity_id=wid,
            payload={"slot_id": info, "via": "admin"},
        )
        return {"ok": True, "slot_id": info}
    if result == "no_slot":
        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="Нет свободных слотов по этой заявке")
    if result == "blocked":
        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="Клиент заблокировал бота")
    if result == "error":
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=info or "Не удалось отправить")
    raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail="Unknown result")


@router.post("/max_booking/api/admin/waitlist/{wid}/fulfill")
async def admin_waitlist_fulfill(
    wid: int, request: Request, ctx: AdminCtx = Depends(org_ctx),
):
    entry = get_waitlist_entry(wid)
    if not entry:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Заявка не найдена")
    if entry["org_id"] != ctx.org_id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Access denied")
    if entry["status"] != "active":
        return {"ok": True, "note": "already not active"}

    try:
        body = await request.json()
        if not isinstance(body, dict):
            body = {}
    except Exception:
        body = {}

    request_id = body.get("request_id")
    if request_id is not None:
        try:
            request_id = int(request_id)
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Invalid request_id")
        req = get_request(request_id)
        if not req or req["org_id"] != ctx.org_id:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Request not found")
    else:
        request_id = None

    fulfill_waitlist_entry(wid, request_id)

    log_audit(
        org_id=ctx.org_id, user_id=ctx.uid, action="waitlist_fulfilled",
        entity_type="waitlist", entity_id=wid,
        payload={"request_id": request_id},
    )

    return {"ok": True}

# ---------- Admin: slots ----------

@router.get("/max_booking/api/admin/slots")
async def admin_slots(
    date_from: str, date_to: str,
    branch_id: int | None = None, doctor_id: int | None = None,
    ctx: AdminCtx = Depends(org_ctx),
):
    rows = await asyncio.to_thread(
        list_slots_range, ctx.org_id, date_from, date_to, branch_id, doctor_id,
    )
    slots = []
    for r in rows:
        fio_parts = [r["last_name"], r["first_name"], r["middle_name"]]
        fio = " ".join(p for p in fio_parts if p).strip()
        slot_service_display = None
        if r["service_id"]:
            svc = get_service(r["service_id"])
            if svc:
                slot_service_display = svc["name"]
        slots.append({
            "id": r["id"], "date": r["date"], "time": r["time"],
            "is_booked": bool(r["is_booked"]), "request_id": r["request_id"],
            "branch_id": r["branch_id"], "branch_name": r["branch_name"],
            "doctor_id": r["doctor_id"], "doctor_name": r["doctor_name"],
            "service_name": r["service_name"], "phone": r["phone"],
            "status": r["status"], "client_fio": fio,
            "slot_service_id": r["service_id"],
            "slot_service_name": slot_service_display,
        })
    return {"slots": slots}


@router.get("/max_booking/api/admin/slots/available")
async def admin_slots_available(
    date_from: str, date_to: str,
    service_id: str | None = None,
    branch_id: int | None = None, doctor_id: int | None = None,
    slots_count: int | None = None,
    ctx: AdminCtx = Depends(org_ctx),
):
    """Свободные слоты для форм «Создать запись» и «Перенести запись».

    - Услуга указана → только слоты под эту услугу (или универсальные),
      с проверкой длительности.
    - Услуга НЕ указана, специалист указан → все свободные слоты этого
      специалиста, занимаем 1 слот (или slots_count).
    - Услуга и специалист НЕ указаны, есть branch_id → все свободные
      слоты филиала.
    - Ничего не указано → 400.
    - slots_count явно передан → используем его вместо вычисления по услуге.
    """
    if not service_id and not doctor_id and not branch_id:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=400,
            detail="Укажите услугу, специалиста или филиал",
        )

    settings = get_org_settings(ctx.org_id)
    step_min = int(settings.get("slot_step_min", 30) or 30)

    if service_id:
        svc = get_service(service_id)
        if not svc or (ctx.role != "superadmin" and svc["org_id"] != ctx.org_id):
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Invalid service_id")
        slots_needed = slots_needed_for_service(service_id, step_min)
    else:
        service_id = None
        slots_needed = 1

    if slots_count is not None:
        try:
            slots_count = int(slots_count)
            if 1 <= slots_count <= 20:
                slots_needed = slots_count
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            pass

    rows = await asyncio.to_thread(
        list_slots_range, ctx.org_id, date_from, date_to, branch_id, doctor_id,
    )
    result = []
    for r in rows:
        if r["is_booked"]:
            continue
        if service_id and r["service_id"] and r["service_id"] != service_id:
            continue

        consecutive = find_consecutive_slots(r["id"], slots_needed, step_min)
        if not consecutive:
            continue

        result.append({
            "id": r["id"], "date": r["date"], "time": r["time"],
            "branch_id": r["branch_id"], "branch_name": r["branch_name"],
            "doctor_id": r["doctor_id"], "doctor_name": r["doctor_name"],
            "slot_service_id": r["service_id"],
        })
    return {"slots": result, "slots_needed": slots_needed}


@router.post("/max_booking/api/admin/slots")
async def admin_create_slot(request: Request, ctx: AdminCtx = Depends(org_ctx)):
    body = await request.json()
    date_str = body.get("date")
    time_str = body.get("time")
    if not date_str or not time_str:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="date and time required")

    branch_id_val = body.get("branch_id")
    if not branch_id_val:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="branch_id required — слоты без филиала запрещены")
    br = get_branch(branch_id_val)
    if not br or (ctx.role != "superadmin" and br["org_id"] != ctx.org_id):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Invalid branch_id")

    doctor_id_val = body.get("doctor_id")
    if doctor_id_val:
        doc = get_doctor(doctor_id_val)
        if not doc:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Invalid doctor_id")
        doc_br = get_branch(doc["branch_id"])
        if not doc_br or (ctx.role != "superadmin" and doc_br["org_id"] != ctx.org_id):
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Invalid doctor_id")

    # Двухфазный режим: если специалист не делает услугу — сначала спрашиваем фронт.
    # Фронт показывает confirm, при «Да» отправляет confirm_skill_mismatch=true,
    # и мы создаём слот + автоматически привязываем услугу специалисту.
    svc_id_val = body.get("service_id")
    if doctor_id_val and svc_id_val and not doctor_makes_service(doctor_id_val, svc_id_val):
        if not bool(body.get("confirm_skill_mismatch")):
            return {
                "ok": False,
                "error_code": "skill_mismatch",
                "message": "За этим специалистом не числится эта услуга. Всё равно создать слот?",
            }
        # Подтверждено — привязываем услугу специалисту
        existing = get_doctor_services(doctor_id_val)
        if svc_id_val not in existing:
            existing.append(svc_id_val)
            set_doctor_services(doctor_id_val, existing)
            log_audit(
                org_id=ctx.org_id, user_id=ctx.uid, action="doctor_service_added",
                entity_type="doctor", entity_id=doctor_id_val,
                payload={"service_id": svc_id_val, "reason": "slot_creation_confirm"},
            )

    if body.get("service_id"):
        svc = get_service(body["service_id"])
        if not svc or (ctx.role != "superadmin" and svc["org_id"] != ctx.org_id):
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Invalid service_id")
    slot_id = create_slot(ctx.org_id, body.get("branch_id"), body.get("doctor_id"),
                          date_str, time_str, body.get("service_id"))
    if not slot_id:
        if body.get("doctor_id"):
            return {
                "ok": False,
                "note": "У выбранного специалиста уже есть слот на это время — "
                        "в этом филиале или в другом. Один специалист не может вести "
                        "два приёма одновременно. Выберите другое время или "
                        "другого специалиста.",
            }
        return {
            "ok": False,
            "note": "На это время уже открыт универсальный слот (без специалиста). "
                    "Укажите специалиста — так можно создать параллельный слот "
                    "для другого специалиста.",
        }

    log_audit(
        org_id=ctx.org_id, user_id=ctx.uid, action="slot_created",
        entity_type="slot", entity_id=slot_id,
        payload={"date": date_str, "time": time_str,
                 "doctor_id": body.get("doctor_id")},
    )

    return {"ok": True, "id": slot_id}


@router.delete("/max_booking/api/admin/slots/{slot_id}")
async def admin_delete_slot(slot_id: int, ctx: AdminCtx = Depends(admin_ctx)):
    slot = get_slot(slot_id)

        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Slot not found")

        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Access denied")

    if not ok:
        return {"ok": False, "note": "slot is booked, cannot delete"}

    log_audit(
        org_id=ctx.org_id, user_id=ctx.uid, action="slot_deleted",
        entity_type="slot", entity_id=slot_id,
        payload={"date": slot["date"], "time": slot["time"]},
    )

    return {"ok": True}


@router.post("/max_booking/api/admin/slots/generate")
async def admin_generate_slots(request: Request, ctx: AdminCtx = Depends(org_ctx)):
    body = await request.json()
    branch_id = body.get("branch_id")
    doctor_id = body.get("doctor_id")
    service_id = body.get("service_id")
    date_from = body.get("date_from")
    if not date_from:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="date_from is required")
    if not branch_id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="branch_id required — слоты без филиала запрещены")

    br = get_branch(branch_id)
    if not br or (ctx.role != "superadmin" and br["org_id"] != ctx.org_id):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Invalid branch_id")
    if doctor_id:
        doc = get_doctor(doctor_id)
        if not doc:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Invalid doctor_id")
        doc_br = get_branch(doc["branch_id"])
        if not doc_br or (ctx.role != "superadmin" and doc_br["org_id"] != ctx.org_id):
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Invalid doctor_id")
    if service_id:
        svc = get_service(service_id)
        if not svc or (ctx.role != "superadmin" and svc["org_id"] != ctx.org_id):
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Invalid service_id")

    if doctor_id and service_id and not doctor_makes_service(doctor_id, service_id):
        if not bool(body.get("confirm_skill_mismatch")):
            return {
                "ok": False,
                "error_code": "skill_mismatch",
                "message": "За этим специалистом не числится эта услуга. Всё равно создать слоты?",
            }
        existing = get_doctor_services(doctor_id)
        if service_id not in existing:
            existing.append(service_id)
            set_doctor_services(doctor_id, existing)
            log_audit(
                org_id=ctx.org_id, user_id=ctx.uid, action="doctor_service_added",
                entity_type="doctor", entity_id=doctor_id,
                payload={"service_id": service_id, "reason": "slot_generation_confirm"},
            )

    created = generate_slots_range(
        ctx.org_id, body.get("branch_id"), body.get("doctor_id"),
        date_from, int(body.get("days", 7)),
        body.get("days_of_week", [0, 1, 2, 3, 4]),
        body.get("time_start", "09:00"), body.get("time_end", "18:00"),
        int(body.get("step_min", 30)), service_id=body.get("service_id"),
    )

    log_audit(
        org_id=ctx.org_id, user_id=ctx.uid, action="slots_generated",
        entity_type="slot", entity_id=None,
        payload={"created": created, "date_from": date_from,
                 "doctor_id": doctor_id, "branch_id": branch_id},
    )

    return {"ok": True, "created": created}


# ---------- Admin: doctor schedule ----------

def _valid_hhmm(t):
    if not t or not isinstance(t, str):
        return False
    try:
        h, m = map(int, t.split(":"))
        return 0 <= h <= 23 and 0 <= m <= 59
    except (ValueError, TypeError):
        return False


def _times_overlap(a_start, a_end, b_start, b_end):
    """Пересекаются ли интервалы 'HH:MM' (без учёта перерыва, только основное время)."""
    return not (a_end <= b_start or b_end <= a_start)

@router.put("/max_booking/api/admin/doctors/{doctor_id}/schedule")
async def admin_set_doctor_schedule(request: Request, doctor_id: int, ctx: AdminCtx = Depends(admin_ctx)):
    require_doctor(ctx, doctor_id)

    body = await request.json()
    shifts = body.get("shifts") or []
    if not isinstance(shifts, list):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="shifts must be a list")

    normalized = []
    seen_sig = set()

    for idx, sh in enumerate(shifts):
        if not isinstance(sh, dict):
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Each shift must be an object")

        try:
            bid = int(sh.get("branch_id"))
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=f"Invalid branch_id in shift #{idx}")
        br = get_branch(bid)
        if not br or (ctx.role != "superadmin" and br["org_id"] != ctx.org_id):
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=f"Invalid branch_id in shift #{idx}")

        try:
            wd = int(sh.get("weekday"))
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=f"Invalid weekday in shift #{idx}")
        if wd < 0 or wd > 6:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="weekday must be 0..6")

        start = (sh.get("start_time") or "").strip()
        end = (sh.get("end_time") or "").strip()
        if not _valid_hhmm(start) or not _valid_hhmm(end):
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=f"Invalid time format in shift #{idx}")
        if start >= end:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=f"start_time must be < end_time in shift #{idx}")

        bs = (sh.get("break_start") or "").strip() or None
        be = (sh.get("break_end") or "").strip() or None
        if (bs is None) != (be is None):
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=f"break_start and break_end must both be set or both empty in shift #{idx}")
        if bs and be:
            if not _valid_hhmm(bs) or not _valid_hhmm(be):
                raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=f"Invalid break time format in shift #{idx}")
            if bs >= be:
                raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=f"break_start must be < break_end in shift #{idx}")
            if bs < start or be > end:
                raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=f"Break must be inside working hours in shift #{idx}")

        sig = (bid, wd, start)
        if sig in seen_sig:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=f"Duplicate shift: branch {bid}, weekday {wd}, start {start}")
        seen_sig.add(sig)

        normalized.append({
            "branch_id": bid,
            "weekday": wd,
            "start_time": start,
            "end_time": end,
            "break_start": bs,
            "break_end": be,
        })

    # Проверка пересечений смен в один день (у специалиста не может быть двух смен одновременно)
    by_day = {}
    for sh in normalized:
        by_day.setdefault(sh["weekday"], []).append(sh)
    for wd, day_shifts in by_day.items():
        day_shifts.sort(key=lambda x: x["start_time"])
        for i in range(len(day_shifts) - 1):
            a, b = day_shifts[i], day_shifts[i + 1]
            if _times_overlap(a["start_time"], a["end_time"], b["start_time"], b["end_time"]):
                raise HTTPException(
                    status_code=400,
                    detail=f"Смены специалиста в день {wd} пересекаются: "
                           f"{a['start_time']}–{a['end_time']} и {b['start_time']}–{b['end_time']}",
                )

    set_doctor_shifts(doctor_id, normalized)

    log_audit(
        org_id=ctx.org_id, user_id=ctx.uid, action="doctor_schedule_updated",
        entity_type="doctor", entity_id=doctor_id,
        payload={"shifts_count": len(normalized)},
    )

    rows = get_doctor_shifts(doctor_id)
    return {
        "ok": True,
        "shifts": [
            {"id": r["id"], "branch_id": r["branch_id"], "weekday": r["weekday"],
             "start_time": r["start_time"], "end_time": r["end_time"],
             "break_start": r["break_start"], "break_end": r["break_end"]}
            for r in rows
        ],
    }

@router.put("/max_booking/api/admin/doctors/{doctor_id}/services")
async def admin_set_doctor_services(request: Request, doctor_id: int, ctx: AdminCtx = Depends(admin_ctx)):
    require_doctor(ctx, doctor_id)

    body = await request.json()
    service_ids = body.get("service_ids")
    if not isinstance(service_ids, list):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="service_ids must be a list")

    # Валидация: все услуги существуют и принадлежат этой org
    seen = set()
    clean_ids = []
    for sid in service_ids:
        sid_str = str(sid).strip()
        if not sid_str or sid_str in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(sid_str)
        svc = get_service(sid_str)
        if not svc:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=f"Unknown service_id: {sid_str}")
        if ctx.role != "superadmin" and svc["org_id"] != ctx.org_id:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=f"Service {sid_str} belongs to another organization")
        clean_ids.append(sid_str)

    set_doctor_services(doctor_id, clean_ids)

    log_audit(
        org_id=ctx.org_id, user_id=ctx.uid, action="doctor_services_updated",
        entity_type="doctor", entity_id=doctor_id,
        payload={"services_count": len(clean_ids)},
    )

    return {"ok": True, "service_ids": clean_ids}

@router.post("/max_booking/api/admin/doctors/{doctor_id}/schedule_exceptions")
async def admin_create_schedule_exception(request: Request, doctor_id: int, ctx: AdminCtx = Depends(admin_ctx)):
    require_doctor(ctx, doctor_id)

    body = await request.json()
    date_from = (body.get("date_from") or "").strip()
    date_to = (body.get("date_to") or "").strip() or date_from
    reason = (body.get("reason") or "").strip()[:200]

    if not date_from:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="date_from is required")

    try:
        d_from = datetime.strptime(date_from, "%Y-%m-%d").date()
        d_to = datetime.strptime(date_to, "%Y-%m-%d").date()
    except ValueError:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Invalid date format (YYYY-MM-DD expected)")
    if d_from > d_to:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="date_from must be <= date_to")

    eid = create_schedule_exception(doctor_id, date_from, date_to, reason)

    log_audit(
        org_id=ctx.org_id, user_id=ctx.uid, action="schedule_exception_created",
        entity_type="doctor", entity_id=doctor_id,
        payload={"date_from": date_from, "date_to": date_to, "reason": reason},
    )

    return {"ok": True, "id": eid}

@router.post("/max_booking/api/admin/doctors/{doctor_id}/schedule/regenerate")
async def admin_regenerate_doctor_slots(
    doctor_id: int,
    request: Request,
    ctx: AdminCtx = Depends(admin_ctx),
):
    require_doctor(ctx, doctor_id)

    try:
        body = await request.json()
        if not isinstance(body, dict):
            body = {}
    except Exception:
        body = {}

    horizon_raw = body.get("horizon_days")
    horizon_days = None
    if horizon_raw is not None:
        try:
            horizon_days = int(horizon_raw)
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Invalid horizon_days")
        if horizon_days < 1 or horizon_days > 365:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="horizon_days must be in [1..365]")

    r = await asyncio.to_thread(regenerate_doctor_slots, doctor_id, horizon_days)
    if "error" in r:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=r["error"])

    log_audit(
        org_id=ctx.org_id, user_id=ctx.uid, action="slots_regenerated",
        entity_type="doctor", entity_id=doctor_id,
        payload={"created": r["created"], "deleted": r["deleted"],
                 "skipped_booked": r["skipped_booked"], "horizon_days": r["horizon_days"]},
    )
    return {"ok": True, **r}

# ---------- Admin: doctors ----------

def _doctor_photo_url(photo_upload_id):
    if not photo_upload_id:
        return None
    img = get_uploaded_image_by_id(photo_upload_id)
    if img and img["public_token"]:
        return f"/max_booking/api/upload/{img['public_token']}"
    return None


@router.get("/max_booking/api/admin/doctors")
async def admin_doctors(branch_id: int | None = None, ctx: AdminCtx = Depends(admin_ctx)):
    if branch_id:
        require_branch(ctx, branch_id)
        rows = list_doctors(branch_id)
        result = []
        for r in rows:
            d = get_doctor(r["id"])
            branches_list = get_doctor_branches(r["id"])
            services_list = get_doctor_services(r["id"])
            result.append({
                "id": r["id"], "name": r["name"], "specialty": r["specialty"],
                "branch_id": d["branch_id"] if d else None,
                "branch_name": "",
                "branch_ids": [b["id"] for b in branches_list],
                "schedule_stop_date": d["schedule_stop_date"] if d else None,
                "services_count": len(services_list),
                "photo_url": _doctor_photo_url(d["photo_upload_id"]) if d else None,
                "education": (d["education"] if d else None) or "",
                "courses": (d["courses"] if d else None) or "",
                "about": (d["about"] if d else None) or "",
            })
        _attach_review_stats(result, ctx.org_id)
        return {"doctors": result}
    if not ctx.org_id:
        return {"doctors": []}
    rows = list_doctors_by_org(ctx.org_id)
    result = []
    for r in rows:
        d = get_doctor(r["id"])
        branches_list = get_doctor_branches(r["id"])
        result.append({
            "id": r["id"], "name": r["name"], "specialty": r["specialty"],
            "branch_id": r["branch_id"], "branch_name": r["branch_name"],
            "branch_ids": [b["id"] for b in branches_list],
            "schedule_stop_date": d["schedule_stop_date"] if d else None,
            "services_count": r["services_count"],
            "photo_url": _doctor_photo_url(d["photo_upload_id"]) if d else None,
            "education": (d["education"] if d else None) or "",
            "courses": (d["courses"] if d else None) or "",
            "about": (d["about"] if d else None) or "",
        })
    _attach_review_stats(result, ctx.org_id)
    return {"doctors": result}


def _attach_review_stats(doctors: list, org_id: int):
    """Батч-добавление avg_rating и reviews_count в каждый dict."""
    if not doctors or not org_id:
        return
    ids = [d["id"] for d in doctors if d.get("id")]
    stats = get_doctors_review_stats_batch(ids, org_id)
    for d in doctors:
        s = stats.get(d["id"]) or {}
        d["avg_rating"] = s.get("avg_rating", 0)
        d["reviews_count"] = s.get("total", 0)

        (body.get("specialty") or "").strip(),
        new_branch_id,
        education=(body.get("education") or "").strip(),
        courses=(body.get("courses") or "").strip(),
        about=(body.get("about") or "").strip(),
    )

    log_audit(
        org_id=ctx.org_id, user_id=ctx.uid, action="doctor_updated",
        entity_type="doctor", entity_id=doctor_id,
        payload={"name": body.get("name", "")},
    )

    return {"ok": True}

@router.post("/max_booking/api/admin/doctors/{doctor_id}/photo")
async def admin_doctor_upload_photo(
    doctor_id: int,
    file: UploadFile = File(...),
    ctx: AdminCtx = Depends(admin_ctx),
):
    """Загружает фото специалиста. Сжимает, хранит локально."""
    import uuid as _uuid
    from pathlib import Path as _Path

    require_doctor(ctx, doctor_id)

    if not file.content_type or file.content_type not in (
        "image/jpeg", "image/jpg", "image/png", "image/webp", "image/gif",
    ):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Только JPEG/PNG/WebP/GIF")

    raw = await file.read()
    if len(raw) > config.MAX_UPLOAD_SIZE:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=413,
            detail=f"Файл больше {config.MAX_UPLOAD_SIZE // (1024 * 1024)} МБ",
        )
    if not raw:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Пустой файл")

    content, mime, ext = _process_upload_image(raw, file.content_type)

    filename = f"{_uuid.uuid4().hex}.{ext}"
    rel_dir = str(ctx.org_id)
    abs_dir = _Path(config.UPLOADS_DIR) / rel_dir
    abs_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    abs_path = abs_dir / filename
    abs_path.write_bytes(content)
    rel_path = f"{rel_dir}/{filename}"

    upload_id, public_token = save_uploaded_image_full(
        token=None,
        file_path=rel_path,
        mime_type=mime,
        original_filename=file.filename or filename,
        file_size=len(content),
        org_id=ctx.org_id,
        uploaded_by=ctx.uid,
    )

    set_doctor_photo(doctor_id, upload_id)

    log_audit(
        org_id=ctx.org_id, user_id=ctx.uid, action="doctor_photo_uploaded",
        entity_type="doctor", entity_id=doctor_id,
        payload={"upload_id": upload_id, "size": len(content), "mime": mime},
    )

    return {
        "ok": True,
        "photo_upload_id": upload_id,
        "photo_url": f"/max_booking/api/upload/{public_token}",
    }

@router.put("/max_booking/api/admin/doctors/{doctor_id}/schedule_stop")
async def admin_set_doctor_schedule_stop(
    doctor_id: int, request: Request, ctx: AdminCtx = Depends(admin_ctx)
):
    """Устанавливает дату, до которой генерируются слоты из графика.
    stop_date=null — бессрочно. stop_date=сегодня — слоты на будущее удаляются.
    Сразу после сохранения вызывается regenerate, чтобы применить ограничение немедленно."""
    require_doctor(ctx, doctor_id)

    try:
        body = await request.json()
        if not isinstance(body, dict):
            body = {}
    except Exception:
        body = {}

    stop_date_raw = body.get("stop_date")
    stop_date = None
    if stop_date_raw is not None and str(stop_date_raw).strip() != "":
        try:
            stop_date = datetime.strptime(str(stop_date_raw).strip(), "%Y-%m-%d").date().isoformat()
        except ValueError:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Invalid stop_date (YYYY-MM-DD expected)")

    set_doctor_schedule_stop_date(doctor_id, stop_date)

    r = await asyncio.to_thread(regenerate_doctor_slots, doctor_id)
    if "error" in r:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=r["error"])

    log_audit(
        org_id=ctx.org_id, user_id=ctx.uid,
        action="doctor_schedule_stop_set" if stop_date else "doctor_schedule_stop_cleared",
        entity_type="doctor", entity_id=doctor_id,
        payload={"stop_date": stop_date,
                 "created": r.get("created"), "deleted": r.get("deleted")},
    )

    return {"ok": True, "stop_date": stop_date, "regenerate": r}

@router.post("/max_booking/api/admin/services")
async def admin_create_service(request: Request, ctx: AdminCtx = Depends(org_ctx)):
    import secrets

    body = await request.json()
    sid = (body.get("id") or "").strip()
    name = (body.get("name") or "").strip()
    if not name:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Название услуги обязательно")

    # ID генерируется автоматически, если не передан (UI его не передаёт).
    # Старые услуги с осмысленными ID (uzi, eeg) продолжают работать.
    if not sid:
        for _ in range(20):
            candidate = "svc-" + secrets.token_hex(4)
            if not get_service(candidate):
                sid = candidate
                break
        if not sid:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail="Не удалось сгенерировать ID услуги")

    category_id = body.get("category_id")
    if category_id is not None and category_id != "":
        try:
            category_id = int(category_id)
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Invalid category_id")
        cat = get_service_category(category_id)
        if not cat or (ctx.role != "superadmin" and cat["org_id"] != ctx.org_id):
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Invalid category_id")
    else:
        category_id = None

    buffer_min = int(body.get("buffer_min") or 0)
    if buffer_min < 0 or buffer_min > 240:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="buffer_min must be in [0..240]")

    revisit = int(body.get("revisit_interval_days") or 0)
    if revisit < 0 or revisit > 3650:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="revisit_interval_days must be in [0..3650]")

    ok = create_service(ctx.org_id, sid, name, int(body.get("price") or 0),
                        body.get("prep") or "", int(body.get("duration_min") or 30),
                        category_id=category_id, buffer_min=buffer_min,
                        revisit_interval_days=revisit)
    if not ok:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="Услуга с таким ID уже существует")

    log_audit(
        org_id=ctx.org_id, user_id=ctx.uid, action="service_created",
        entity_type="service", entity_id=sid, payload={"name": name},
    )

    return {"ok": True, "id": sid}


@router.put("/max_booking/api/admin/services/{service_id}")
async def admin_update_service(request: Request, service_id: str, ctx: AdminCtx = Depends(admin_ctx)):
    svc = get_service(service_id)
    if not svc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Service not found")
    if ctx.role != "superadmin" and svc["org_id"] != ctx.org_id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Access denied")

    body = await request.json()

    category_id = body.get("category_id")
    if category_id is not None and category_id != "":
        try:
            category_id = int(category_id)
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Invalid category_id")
        cat = get_service_category(category_id)
        if not cat or (ctx.role != "superadmin" and cat["org_id"] != ctx.org_id):
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Invalid category_id")
    else:
        category_id = None

    buffer_min = int(body.get("buffer_min") or 0)
    if buffer_min < 0 or buffer_min > 240:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="buffer_min must be in [0..240]")

    revisit = int(body.get("revisit_interval_days") or 0)
    if revisit < 0 or revisit > 3650:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="revisit_interval_days must be in [0..3650]")

    update_service(service_id, body.get("name", svc["name"]),
                   int(body.get("price") or 0), body.get("prep") or "",
                   int(body.get("duration_min") or 30), int(body.get("active", 1)),
                   category_id=category_id, buffer_min=buffer_min,
                   revisit_interval_days=revisit)

    log_audit(
        org_id=ctx.org_id, user_id=ctx.uid, action="service_updated",
        entity_type="service", entity_id=service_id,
        payload={"name": body.get("name", svc["name"])},
    )

    return {"ok": True}

        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Название не может быть пустым")

@router.get("/max_booking/api/admin/analytics/summary")
async def admin_analytics_summary(
    date_from: str,
    date_to: str,
    branch_id: int | None = None,
    doctor_id: int | None = None,
    ctx: AdminCtx = Depends(org_ctx),
):
    try:
        d_from = datetime.strptime(date_from, "%Y-%m-%d").date()
        d_to = datetime.strptime(date_to, "%Y-%m-%d").date()
    except ValueError:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Invalid date format (YYYY-MM-DD expected)")

    if d_to < d_from:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="date_to must be >= date_from")
    if (d_to - d_from).days > 730:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Период не должен превышать 2 года")

    if branch_id is not None:
        br = get_branch(branch_id)
        if not br or (ctx.role != "superadmin" and br["org_id"] != ctx.org_id):
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Invalid branch_id")

    if doctor_id is not None:
        d = get_doctor(doctor_id)
        if not d:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Invalid doctor_id")

    result = await asyncio.to_thread(
        get_analytics_summary,
        ctx.org_id, date_from, date_to, branch_id, doctor_id,
    )
    return result


@router.get("/max_booking/api/admin/analytics/doctor/{doctor_id}")
async def admin_analytics_doctor(
    doctor_id: int,
    date_from: str,
    date_to: str,
    ctx: AdminCtx = Depends(org_ctx),
):
    """Сводка по одному специалисту за период. Для модалки в аналитике."""
    try:
        d_from = datetime.strptime(date_from, "%Y-%m-%d").date()
        d_to = datetime.strptime(date_to, "%Y-%m-%d").date()
    except ValueError:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Invalid date format")

    if d_to < d_from:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="date_to must be >= date_from")
    if (d_to - d_from).days > 730:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Период не должен превышать 2 года")

    doc = get_doctor(doctor_id)
    if not doc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Doctor not found")

    br = get_branch(doc["branch_id"]) if doc["branch_id"] else None
    if ctx.role != "superadmin" and (not br or br["org_id"] != ctx.org_id):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Access denied")

    data = await asyncio.to_thread(
        get_analytics_doctor_summary, ctx.org_id, doctor_id, date_from, date_to,
    )
    data["doctor"] = {
        "id": doc["id"], "name": doc["name"], "specialty": doc["specialty"] or "",
    }

    # Рейтинг специалиста (все отзывы, не за период)
    try:
        from storage.db import get_doctor_review_stats
        review_stats = await asyncio.to_thread(
            get_doctor_review_stats, doctor_id, ctx.org_id,
        )
        data["review_stats"] = review_stats
    except Exception as e:
        log.warning("doctor review stats failed for #%s: %s", doctor_id, e)
        data["review_stats"] = {"total": 0, "avg_rating": 0,
                                "distribution": {}, "recent": []}

    return data


@router.get("/max_booking/api/admin/analytics/export")
async def admin_analytics_export(
    date_from: str,
    date_to: str,
    format: str = "xlsx",
    branch_id: int | None = None,
    doctor_id: int | None = None,
    ctx: AdminCtx = Depends(org_ctx),
):
    """Экспорт аналитики в CSV/XLSX/PDF. Отправляет файл в чат админу."""
    try:
        d_from = datetime.strptime(date_from, "%Y-%m-%d").date()
        d_to = datetime.strptime(date_to, "%Y-%m-%d").date()
    except ValueError:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Invalid date format")

    if d_to < d_from:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="date_to must be >= date_from")
    if (d_to - d_from).days > 730:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Период не должен превышать 2 года")

    if branch_id is not None:
        br = get_branch(branch_id)
        if not br or (ctx.role != "superadmin" and br["org_id"] != ctx.org_id):
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Invalid branch_id")
    if doctor_id is not None:
        d = get_doctor(doctor_id)
        if not d:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Invalid doctor_id")

    fmt = (format or "xlsx").lower().strip()
    if fmt not in ("csv", "xlsx", "pdf"):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="format must be csv, xlsx or pdf")

    try:
        return await generate_and_send_analytics(
            org_id=ctx.org_id, admin_uid=ctx.uid,
            date_from=date_from, date_to=date_to, fmt=fmt,
            branch_id=branch_id, doctor_id=doctor_id,
        )
    except Exception as e:
        log.error("analytics export failed: %s", e)
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=f"Ошибка формирования файла: {e}")
