    ok: bool
    request_id: Optional[int] = None
    status: Optional[str] = None
    mode: Optional[str] = None
    notify_status: Optional[str] = None
    error_code: Optional[str] = None
    error_msg: Optional[str] = None
    slots_count: int = 1


def _valid_birth_date(value):
    if not value:
        return None
    try:
        d = datetime.strptime(str(value).strip(), "%Y-%m-%d")
    except ValueError:
        return None
    if d.year < 1900 or d > datetime.now():
        return None
    return d.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")


async def _try_send_welcome_first(ctx: BookingContext, request_id: int):
    """Если это первая запись клиента в org — отправить сценарий welcome_first.

    Никогда не бросает исключений — всё логируется.
    """
    try:
        if str(ctx.user_id).startswith("phone:"):
            return

        prior = count_bookings_for_client_before(ctx.user_id, ctx.org_id, request_id)
        if prior > 0:
            return

        scen = get_active_auto_broadcast_by_type(ctx.org_id, "welcome_first")
        if not scen:
            return

        event_ref = f"welcome:{request_id}"
        if check_auto_log_after_visit(scen["id"], event_ref):
            return

        client = get_client(ctx.user_id)
        if client and client["marketing_opt_out"]:
            log.info("welcome_first skipped for %s: marketing opt-out", ctx.user_id)
            return

        text = format_auto_broadcast_text(
            scen["text"], ctx.user_id, ctx.org_id, request_id=request_id,
        )
        image_id = scen["image_id"]

        try:
            if image_id:
                await _send_with_refresh(
                    int(ctx.user_id), text, image_id,
                    buttons=UNSUB_BUTTONS, fmt="markdown",
                )
            else:
                await send_to_client_raw(
                    int(ctx.user_id), text, buttons=UNSUB_BUTTONS, fmt="markdown",
                )
            log_auto_broadcast(scen["id"], ctx.user_id, event_ref=event_ref)
            log.info("welcome_first sent to %s (request #%s)", ctx.user_id, request_id)
        except UserBlocked:
            log_auto_broadcast(scen["id"], ctx.user_id, event_ref=event_ref)
            log.info("welcome_first skipped for %s: user blocked bot", ctx.user_id)
        except Exception as e:
            log.warning("welcome_first send failed for %s: %s", ctx.user_id, e)
    except Exception as e:
        log.warning("welcome_first outer error for #%s: %s", request_id, e)


def validate_booking(ctx: BookingContext):
    """Все проверки. Возвращает (ok, error_code, error_msg, info).

    info — dict с подготовленными данными (slot, svc, slots_needed, slot_ids,
    settings, step_min, effective_service_id, service_name, phone, mode,
    initial_status, human_sched). Используется в create_booking_unified,
    чтобы не перезагружать данные.
    """
    if is_user_blocked(ctx.user_id):
        return False, "blocked", "Аккаунт заблокирован", None

    slot = get_slot(ctx.slot_id)
    if not slot:
        return False, "slot_not_found", "Слот не найден", None
    if slot["org_id"] != ctx.org_id:
        return False, "slot_org_mismatch", "Слот другой организации", None
    if slot["is_booked"]:
        return False, "slot_taken", "Слот уже занят", None

    effective_service_id = ctx.service_id or slot["service_id"]
    svc = None
    if effective_service_id:
        svc = get_service(effective_service_id)
        if not svc or not svc["active"]:
            return False, "service_inactive", "Услуга удалена или скрыта", None
        if svc["org_id"] != ctx.org_id:
            return False, "service_org_mismatch", "Услуга другой организации", None
        if slot["service_id"] and slot["service_id"] != effective_service_id:
            return (
                False,
                "slot_service_mismatch",
                "Слот зарезервирован под другую услугу",
                None,
            )

    client = get_client(ctx.user_id)
    if not ctx.skip_consent_check:
        has_consent = bool(client and client["consent_152fz"]) or ctx.set_consent_152fz
        if not has_consent:
            return (
                False,
                "no_consent",
                "Требуется согласие на обработку персональных данных",
                None,
            )

    if not ctx.phone:
        if client and client["phone"]:
            phone = client["phone"]
        else:
            return False, "no_phone", "Не указан телефон", None
    else:
        phone = ctx.phone

    # Запись в прошлое невозможна ни в одном канале (Mini App, админ,
    # лист ожидания, API). Граница — 30 минут от текущего времени
    # по часовому поясу организации (чтобы не записывать на «сейчас»
    # и «5 минут назад»).
    try:
        slot_dt = datetime.strptime(
            f"{slot['date']} {slot['time']}", "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"
        )
    except ValueError:
        slot_dt = None
    if slot_dt is not None:
        from storage.db import now_for_org
        now_local = now_for_org(ctx.org_id)
        if slot_dt < now_local:
            return (
                False,
                "slot_in_past",
                "Слот уже в прошлом. Выберите другое время.",
                None,
            )

    settings = get_org_settings(ctx.org_id)
    step_min = int(settings.get("slot_step_min", 30) or 30)

    if ctx.slots_count_override is not None:
        if ctx.slots_count_override < 1 or ctx.slots_count_override > 20:
            return (
                False,
                "invalid_slots_count",
                "Количество слотов должно быть от 1 до 20",
                None,
            )
        slots_needed = ctx.slots_count_override
    elif effective_service_id:
        slots_needed = slots_needed_for_service(effective_service_id, step_min)
    else:
        slots_needed = 1

    slot_ids = find_consecutive_slots(ctx.slot_id, slots_needed, step_min)
    if not slot_ids:
        return (
            False,
            "no_slots_for_duration",
            f"Недостаточно свободного времени подряд (нужно {slots_needed} слотов)",
            None,
        )

    human_sched = f"{slot['date']} {slot['time']}"

    if has_active_request_at_time(ctx.user_id, ctx.org_id, human_sched, phone=phone):
        return (
            False,
            "already_at_time",
            "У вас уже есть активная запись на это время",
            None,
        )

    max_per_day = int(settings.get("max_bookings_per_day", 2) or 0)
    if max_per_day > 0 and not ctx.confirm_over_daily_limit:
        day_count = count_active_bookings_on_date(ctx.user_id, ctx.org_id, slot["date"])
        if day_count >= max_per_day:
            return (
                False,
                "daily_limit_exceeded",
                (
                    f"Не более {max_per_day} активных записей на один день. "
                    f"Отмените существующую запись, чтобы создать новую."
                ),
                None,
            )

    if count_active_future_requests(ctx.user_id, ctx.org_id) >= MAX_ACTIVE_BOOKINGS:
        return False, "too_many_active", "Слишком много активных записей", None

    if effective_service_id and slot["doctor_id"]:
        if not doctor_makes_service(slot["doctor_id"], effective_service_id):
            return False, "doctor_skill", "Специалист не оказывает эту услугу", None

    mode = settings.get("confirmation_mode", "manual")
    initial_status = "confirmed" if mode == "auto" else "pending"

    no_show_threshold = int(settings.get("auto_manual_no_show_threshold", 0) or 0)
    if no_show_threshold > 0 and initial_status == "confirmed":
        if get_client_no_show_count(ctx.user_id) >= no_show_threshold:
            initial_status = "pending"
            mode = "manual"

    service_name = svc["name"] if svc else "Приём (услуга не указана)"

    info = {
        "slot": slot,
        "svc": svc,
        "slots_needed": slots_needed,
        "slot_ids": slot_ids,
        "settings": settings,
        "step_min": step_min,
        "effective_service_id": effective_service_id,
        "service_name": service_name,
        "phone": phone,
        "mode": mode,
        "initial_status": initial_status,
        "human_sched": human_sched,
    }
    return True, None, None, info


async def create_booking_unified(ctx: BookingContext) -> BookingResult:
    ok, err_code, err_msg, info = validate_booking(ctx)
    if not ok:
        return BookingResult(ok=False, error_code=err_code, error_msg=err_msg)

    slot = info["slot"]
    svc = info["svc"]
    effective_service_id = info["effective_service_id"]
    service_name = info["service_name"]
    slot_ids = info["slot_ids"]
    human_sched = info["human_sched"]
    phone = info["phone"]
    mode = info["mode"]
    initial_status = info["initial_status"]
    slots_needed = info["slots_needed"]
    step_min = info["step_min"]

    if ctx.via == "mini_app":
        birth_date = _valid_birth_date(ctx.birth_date)
        upsert_client(
            ctx.user_id,
            org_id=ctx.org_id,
            first_name=ctx.first_name or None,
            last_name=ctx.last_name or None,
            middle_name=ctx.middle_name or None,
            phone=phone,
            gender=ctx.gender if ctx.gender in ("male", "female") else None,
            birth_date=birth_date,
        )
        if ctx.set_consent_152fz:
            set_consent_152fz(ctx.user_id, True)

    addr = ""
    if slot["branch_id"]:
        br = get_branch(slot["branch_id"])
        if br:
            addr = br["address"] or ""
    doc = ""
    if slot["doctor_id"]:
        d = get_doctor(slot["doctor_id"])
        if d:
            doc = d["name"] or ""

    rid = create_booking(
        ctx.org_id, ctx.user_id, service_name, human_sched, phone, addr, doc,
        slot["branch_id"], slot["doctor_id"], slot_ids, initial_status,
        effective_service_id,
    )
    if rid is None:
        return BookingResult(
            ok=False,
            error_code="slot_taken",
            error_msg="Слот уже занят",
        )

    fio_parts = [ctx.last_name, ctx.first_name, ctx.middle_name]
    fio = " ".join(p for p in fio_parts if p).strip() or "—"

    notify_status = "no_max"
    if not str(ctx.user_id).startswith("phone:"):
        if initial_status == "confirmed":
            client_text = (
                f"✅ **Ваша запись подтверждена!**\n\n"
                f"**{service_name}**\n"
                f"📅 {human_sched}\n"
            )
            if addr:
                client_text += route_lines(addr, org_id=ctx.org_id)
            if doc:
                client_text += f"👤 {doc}\n"
            if svc and svc["prep"]:
                client_text += f"\n_{svc['prep']}_\n"
            if svc:
                client_text += "\nЖдём вас!"
            else:
                client_text += (
                    f"\n\n⚠️ Услуга не указана — записали вас на стандартные "
                    f"{slots_needed * step_min} минут. Пожалуйста, свяжитесь "
                    f"с администратором для уточнения услуги и длительности."
                )

            if svc:
                try:
                    status_ics, _ = await send_confirmation_with_ics(
                        ctx.user_id, client_text, rid, ctx.org_id,
                        effective_service_id, service_name, human_sched,
                        addr, doc, svc["prep"] or "",
                    )
                    notify_status = status_ics
                except Exception as e:
                    log.warning("create_booking: ics failed for #%s: %s", rid, e)
                    notify_status = "error"
            else:
                try:
                    await send_to_client_raw(int(ctx.user_id), client_text, fmt="markdown")
                    notify_status = "sent"
                except UserBlocked:
                    notify_status = "blocked"
                except Exception as e:
                    log.warning("create_booking: notify failed for #%s: %s", rid, e)
                    notify_status = "error"
        elif mode == "client":
            client_text = (
                f"✅ Заявка #{rid} принята!\n\n"
                f"**{service_name}**\n"
                f"📅 {human_sched}\n"
            )
            if addr:
                client_text += f"📍 {addr}\n"
            if doc:
                client_text += f"👤 {doc}\n"
            if not svc:
                client_text += (
                    f"\n⚠️ Услуга не указана — записали на стандартные "
                    f"{slots_needed * step_min} мин. Свяжитесь с администратором."
                )
            client_text += "\nДля подтверждения записи позже пришлём вам запрос, ожидайте."
            try:
                await send_to_client_raw(int(ctx.user_id), client_text, fmt="markdown")
                notify_status = "sent"
            except UserBlocked:
                notify_status = "blocked"
            except Exception as e:
                log.warning("create_booking: notify failed for #%s: %s", rid, e)
                notify_status = "error"
        else:
            client_text = (
                f"✅ Заявка #{rid} принята!\n\n"
                f"**{service_name}**\n"
                f"📅 {human_sched}\n"
            )
            if addr:
                client_text += f"📍 {addr}\n"
            if doc:
                client_text += f"👤 {doc}\n"
            if svc and svc["prep"]:
                client_text += f"\n_{svc['prep']}_\n"
            if not svc:
                client_text += (
                    f"\n⚠️ Услуга не указана — записали на стандартные "
                    f"{slots_needed * step_min} мин. Свяжитесь с администратором."
                )
            client_text += "\nСтатус: ожидает подтверждения администратором."
            try:
                await send_to_client_raw(int(ctx.user_id), client_text, fmt="markdown")
                notify_status = "sent"
            except UserBlocked:
                notify_status = "blocked"
            except Exception as e:
                log.warning("create_booking: notify failed for #%s: %s", rid, e)
                notify_status = "error"

    # welcome_first — fire-and-forget, не блокирует основной поток
    try:
        asyncio.create_task(_try_send_welcome_first(ctx, rid))
    except Exception as e:
        log.warning("welcome_first task schedule failed for #%s: %s", rid, e)

    no_service_note = (
        (
            f"\n\n⚠️ _Услуга не указана — уточните у клиента и при необходимости "
            f"скорректируйте длительность (сейчас {slots_needed * step_min} мин)._"
        )
        if not svc else ""
    )

    via_labels = {
        "mini_app": "Mini App",
        "admin": "администратором",
        "waitlist": "из листа ожидания",
        "api": "API",
    }
    via_label = via_labels.get(ctx.via, ctx.via)

    if mode == "manual":
        admin_text = (
            f"🆕 **Новая заявка #{rid}** ({via_label}, ожидает подтверждения)\n\n"
            f"**{service_name}**\n📅 {human_sched}\n"
            f"Клиент: {fio}\nТелефон: {phone}\n"
        )
        if addr:
            admin_text += f"📍 {addr}\n"
        if doc:
            admin_text += f"👤 {doc}\n"
        admin_text += no_service_note
        admin_buttons = [[
            {"type": "callback", "text": "✅ Подтвердить", "payload": f"req:confirm:{rid}"},
            {"type": "callback", "text": "❌ Отклонить", "payload": f"req:reject:{rid}"},
        ]]
        await notify_admins(admin_text, org_id=ctx.org_id, buttons=admin_buttons)
    elif mode == "client":
        admin_text = (
            f"🆕 **Новая заявка #{rid}** ({via_label}, клиент подтверждает сам)\n\n"
            f"**{service_name}**\n📅 {human_sched}\n"
            f"Клиент: {fio}\nТелефон: {phone}\n"
        )
        admin_text += no_service_note
        await notify_admins(admin_text, org_id=ctx.org_id, buttons=None)
    else:
        admin_text = (
            f"🆕 **Новая заявка #{rid}** ({via_label}, авто-подтверждена)\n\n"
            f"**{service_name}**\n📅 {human_sched}\n"
            f"Клиент: {fio}\nТелефон: {phone}\n"
        )
        admin_text += no_service_note
        await notify_admins(admin_text, org_id=ctx.org_id, buttons=None)

    log_audit(
        org_id=ctx.org_id, user_id=ctx.user_id, action="booking_created",
        entity_type="request", entity_id=rid,
        payload={
            "service": service_name,
            "scheduled_at": human_sched,
            "via": ctx.via,
            "slots_count": len(slot_ids),
        },
    )

    return BookingResult(
        ok=True,
        request_id=rid,
        status=initial_status,
        mode=mode,
        notify_status=notify_status,
        slots_count=len(slot_ids),
    )


@dataclass
class MoveResult:
    ok: bool
    request_id: Optional[int] = None
    scheduled_at: Optional[str] = None
    notify_status: Optional[str] = None
    error_code: Optional[str] = None
    error_msg: Optional[str] = None


async def move_booking_unified(request_id: int, new_slot_id: int, via: str = "admin") -> MoveResult:
    """Атомарный перенос активной записи на новый слот.

    Проверки:
    - запись существует и активна (pending/confirmed);
    - новый слот существует, свободен, в той же org;
    - новый слот не в прошлом;
    - у клиента нет другой активной записи на новое время;
    - под длительность услуги хватает подряд идущих слотов;
    - специалист оказывает услугу (если применимо).

    После переноса клиенту уходит уведомление «Запись перенесена».
    """
    req = get_request(request_id)
    if not req:
        return MoveResult(ok=False, error_code="request_not_found",
                          error_msg="Заявка не найдена")
    if req["status"] not in ("pending", "confirmed"):
        return MoveResult(ok=False, error_code="request_not_active",
                          error_msg="Можно перенести только активную запись")

    new_slot = get_slot(new_slot_id)
    if not new_slot:
        return MoveResult(ok=False, error_code="slot_not_found",
                          error_msg="Слот не найден")
    if new_slot["org_id"] != req["org_id"]:
        return MoveResult(ok=False, error_code="slot_org_mismatch",
                          error_msg="Слот принадлежит другой организации")
    if new_slot["is_booked"]:
        return MoveResult(ok=False, error_code="slot_taken",
                          error_msg="Слот уже занят")

    try:
        slot_dt = datetime.strptime(
            f"{new_slot['date']} {new_slot['time']}", "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"
        )
    except ValueError:
        slot_dt = None
    if slot_dt is not None:
        from storage.db import now_for_org
        if slot_dt < now_for_org(req["org_id"]):
            return MoveResult(ok=False, error_code="slot_in_past",
                              error_msg="Слот уже в прошлом")

    human_sched = f"{new_slot['date']} {new_slot['time']}"
    user_id = req["user_id"]

    if has_active_request_at_time(user_id, req["org_id"], human_sched, phone=req["phone"]):
        return MoveResult(ok=False, error_code="already_at_time",
                          error_msg="У клиента уже есть другая активная запись на это время")

    settings = get_org_settings(req["org_id"])
    step_min = int(settings.get("slot_step_min", 30) or 30)

    # При переносе сохраняем текущее количество слотов записи — длительность
    # приёма не меняется. Для записей без услуги (service_id=NULL) это
    # критично: slots_needed_for_service(None)=1, а запись могла занимать N
    # слотов (override админа).
    current_slots_count = int(req["slots_count"] or 0)
    if current_slots_count > 0:
        slots_needed = current_slots_count
    else:
        slots_needed = slots_needed_for_service(req["service_id"], step_min)

    slot_ids_list = find_consecutive_slots(new_slot_id, slots_needed, step_min)
    if not slot_ids_list:
        return MoveResult(ok=False, error_code="no_slots_for_duration",
                          error_msg="Недостаточно свободного времени подряд для этой услуги")

    doctor_id = new_slot["doctor_id"]
    if doctor_id and req["service_id"] and not doctor_makes_service(doctor_id, req["service_id"]):
        return MoveResult(ok=False, error_code="doctor_skill",
                          error_msg="Специалист не оказывает эту услугу")

    ok, err, _payload = move_booking(request_id, new_slot_id)
    if not ok:
        return MoveResult(ok=False, error_code="move_failed",
                          error_msg=err or "Не удалось перенести")

    branch_id = new_slot["branch_id"]
    addr = ""
    if branch_id:
        br = get_branch(branch_id)
        if br:
            addr = br["address"] or ""
    doc_name = ""
    if doctor_id:
        d = get_doctor(doctor_id)
        if d:
            doc_name = d["name"] or ""

    finalize_move_booking(
        request_id, slot_ids_list, human_sched,
        branch_id, doctor_id, addr, doc_name,
    )

    notify_status = "no_max"
    if user_id and not str(user_id).startswith("phone:"):
        notify_text = (
            f"🔄 **Запись перенесена**\n\n"
            f"**{req['service_name']}**\n"
            f"Было: {req['scheduled_at']}\n"
            f"Стало: {human_sched}\n"
        )
        if addr:
            notify_text += route_lines(addr, org_id=req["org_id"])
        if doc_name:
            notify_text += f"👤 {doc_name}\n"
        notify_text += "\n📅 Добавьте новое время в календарь — файл ниже."

        prep = ""
        if req["service_id"]:
            svc_obj = get_service(req["service_id"])
            if svc_obj and svc_obj["prep"]:
                prep = svc_obj["prep"]

        notify_status, _err = await send_confirmation_with_ics(
            user_id, notify_text, request_id, req["org_id"], req["service_id"],
            req["service_name"], human_sched, addr, doc_name, prep,
        )

    log.info(
        "move_booking_unified: #%s %s -> %s (via=%s, notify=%s)",
        request_id, req["scheduled_at"], human_sched, via, notify_status,
    )

    return MoveResult(
        ok=True,
        request_id=request_id,
        scheduled_at=human_sched,
        notify_status=notify_status,
    )

"""Аутентификация и авторизация для Mini App и админки.
Зависимости FastAPI + хелперы проверки принадлежности организации."""
import hashlib
import hmac
import json
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import datetime
from typing import Optional
from urllib.parse import parse_qsl

from fastapi import Depends, HTTPException, Request

import config
from storage.db import (
    get_admin_role,
    get_branch,
    get_doctor,
    get_service,
    is_superadmin_db,
)


@dataclass
class AdminCtx:
    uid: int
    role: str
    org_id: Optional[int]
    platform: str = "max"  # платформа (max/vk)


# ==================== Парсинг WebAppData ====================

def validate_webapp_data(init_data: str, max_age_seconds: int = 86400):
    if not init_data or not config.MAX_BOT_TOKEN:
        return None
    try:
        params = dict(parse_qsl(init_data, keep_blank_values=True))
    except Exception:
        return None
    if "hash" not in params:
        return None
    received_hash = params.pop("hash")

    auth_date_str = params.get("auth_date")
    if auth_date_str:
        try:
            auth_date = int(auth_date_str)
            now = int(datetime.now().timestamp())
            if now - auth_date > max_age_seconds:
                return None
        except ValueError:
            return None

    items = sorted(params.items())
    launch_params = "\n".join(f"{k}={v}" for k, v in items)
    secret_key = hmac.new(b"WebAppData", config.MAX_BOT_TOKEN.encode(), hashlib.sha256).digest()
    calc_hash = hmac.new(secret_key, launch_params.encode(), hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
    if not hmac.compare_digest(calc_hash, received_hash):
        return None

    if "user" in params:
        try:
            params["user"] = json.loads(params["user"])
        except Exception:
            pass
    return params


def get_user_from_request(request: Request):
    init_data = request.headers.get("X-Max-Init-Data", "")
    return validate_webapp_data(init_data)


def get_uid_from_user(user):
    user_info = user.get("user") or {}
    if isinstance(user_info, str):
        try:
            user_info = json.loads(user_info)
        except Exception:
            user_info = {}
    return user_info.get("id") or user_info.get("user_id") or 0


# ==================== Зависимости FastAPI ====================

async def require_user(request: Request) -> dict:
    user = get_user_from_request(request)
    if not user:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Invalid initData")
    return user


async def admin_ctx(request: Request) -> AdminCtx:
    # Тестовый режим: test_uid в query-параметре (только для локального тестирования)
    test_uid = request.query_params.get("test_uid")
    if test_uid and test_uid.isdigit():
        test_uid = int(test_uid)
        platform = "max"
        if is_superadmin_db(platform, test_uid):
            q_org = request.query_params.get("org_id")
            if q_org and q_org.isdigit():
                return AdminCtx(uid=test_uid, role="superadmin", org_id=int(q_org), platform=platform)
            return AdminCtx(uid=test_uid, role="superadmin", org_id=None, platform=platform)
        conn_row = get_admin_role(test_uid)
        role, org_id_from_db, _name = conn_row
        if role is None:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Not an admin")
        return AdminCtx(uid=test_uid, role=role, org_id=org_id_from_db, platform=platform)
    
    # Обычный режим: проверка WebAppData
    user = get_user_from_request(request)
    if not user:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Invalid initData")
    uid = get_uid_from_user(user)
    if not uid:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Invalid user")

    # Платформа всегда MAX для WebAppData
    platform = "max"
    
    # Проверить суперадмина через новую схему БД
    if is_superadmin_db(platform, uid):
        q_org = request.query_params.get("org_id")
        if q_org and q_org.isdigit():
            return AdminCtx(uid=uid, role="superadmin", org_id=int(q_org), platform=platform)
        return AdminCtx(uid=uid, role="superadmin", org_id=None, platform=platform)
    
    # Иначе проверить обычного админа
    conn_row = get_admin_role(uid)
    role, org_id_from_db, _name = conn_row
    if role is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Not an admin")

    return AdminCtx(uid=uid, role=role, org_id=org_id_from_db, platform=platform)


async def superadmin_ctx(ctx: AdminCtx = Depends(admin_ctx)) -> AdminCtx:
    if ctx.role != "superadmin":
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Only superadmin")
    return ctx


async def org_ctx(ctx: AdminCtx = Depends(admin_ctx)) -> AdminCtx:
    if not ctx.org_id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="org_id is required")
    return ctx


# ==================== Проверки принадлежности ====================

def require_branch(ctx: AdminCtx, branch_id: int):
    br = get_branch(branch_id)
    if not br:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Branch not found")
    if ctx.role != "superadmin" and br["org_id"] != ctx.org_id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Access denied")
    return br


def require_doctor(ctx: AdminCtx, doctor_id: int):
    d = get_doctor(doctor_id)
    if not d:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Doctor not found")
    br = get_branch(d["branch_id"])
    if ctx.role != "superadmin" and (not br or br["org_id"] != ctx.org_id):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Access denied")
    return d


def require_service(ctx: AdminCtx, service_id: str):
    svc = get_service(service_id)
    if not svc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Service not found")
    if ctx.role != "superadmin" and svc["org_id"] != ctx.org_id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Access denied")
    return svc

"""Клиент MAX API с обработкой ошибок и retry."""
import asyncio
import logging

import httpx
import truststore

truststore.inject_into_ssl()

import config

log = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class MaxUserBlocked(Exception):
    """Клиент заблокировал бота (403/404). Воркеры ловят это исключение
    и не считают попытку провальной — просто помечают отправленным."""
    pass


async def send_message(user_id: int, text: str, buttons: list = None, fmt: str = None, max_retries: int = 3):
    """
    Отправляет сообщение через MAX API.
    Возвращает dict с ответом или бросает исключение при ошибке.
    Автоматически повторяет при 429.
    """
    if not config.MAX_BOT_TOKEN:
        raise Exception("MAX_BOT_TOKEN не задан")

    headers = {
        "Authorization": config.MAX_BOT_TOKEN,
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
    }
    payload = {"text": text}
    if fmt:
        payload["format"] = fmt
    if buttons:
        payload["attachments"] = [{
            "type": "inline_keyboard",
            "payload": {"buttons": buttons},
        }]

    last_error = None
    for attempt in range(max_retries):
        try:
            async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=30.0) as client:
                r = await client.post(
                    config.MAX_API + "/messages",
                    params={"user_id": user_id},
                    json=payload,
                    headers=headers,
                )

                if r.status_code == 429:
                    retry_after = int(r.headers.get("Retry-After", 1))
                    log.warning("Rate limit for user %s, retry after %ss", user_id, retry_after)
                    await asyncio.sleep(retry_after)
                    continue

                if r.status_code in (403, 404):
                    log.info("User %s blocked bot or chat not found (HTTP %s)", user_id, r.status_code)
                    raise MaxUserBlocked(f"User {user_id} blocked bot")

                if 200 <= r.status_code < 300:
                    result = r.json()
                    log.info("Message sent to %s: %s", user_id, r.status_code)
                    return result

                last_error = Exception(f"MAX API returned {r.status_code}: {r.text[:200]}")
                log.error("send_message to %s failed: %s %s", user_id, r.status_code, r.text[:200])
                break

        except MaxUserBlocked:
            raise
        except (httpx.TimeoutException, httpx.ConnectError) as e:
            last_error = Exception(f"Network error: {e}")
            if attempt < max_retries - 1:
                await asyncio.sleep(1)
                continue
            break
        except Exception as e:
            last_error = e
            break

    if last_error:
        raise last_error
    raise Exception("Unknown error")


async def send_message_with_image(user_id: int, text: str, image_token: str, buttons: list = None, fmt: str = None, max_retries: int = 3):
    """Отправляет сообщение с картинкой."""
    if not config.MAX_BOT_TOKEN:
        raise Exception("MAX_BOT_TOKEN не задан")

    headers = {
        "Authorization": config.MAX_BOT_TOKEN,
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
    }
    payload = {
        "text": text,
        "attachments": [
            {
                "type": "image",
                "payload": {"token": image_token},
            }
        ],
    }
    if fmt:
        payload["format"] = fmt
    if buttons:
        payload["attachments"].append({
            "type": "inline_keyboard",
            "payload": {"buttons": buttons},
        })

    last_error = None
    for attempt in range(max_retries):
        try:
            async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=30.0) as client:
                r = await client.post(
                    config.MAX_API + "/messages",
                    params={"user_id": user_id},
                    json=payload,
                    headers=headers,
                )

                if r.status_code == 429:
                    retry_after = int(r.headers.get("Retry-After", 1))
                    await asyncio.sleep(retry_after)
                    continue

                if r.status_code in (403, 404):
                    log.info("User %s blocked bot", user_id)
                    raise MaxUserBlocked(f"User {user_id} blocked bot")

                if 200 <= r.status_code < 300:
                    result = r.json()
                    log.info("Message with image sent to %s", user_id)
                    return result

                if r.status_code >= 400:
                    try:
                        err_data = r.json()
                        code = err_data.get("code", "")
                        if "attachment.not.ready" in code or "attachment.file.not_processed" in code:
                            if attempt < max_retries - 1:
                                wait = 2 ** attempt
                                log.warning("Image not ready for user %s, retry in %ss", user_id, wait)
                                await asyncio.sleep(wait)
                                continue
                    except ValueError:
                        pass

                last_error = Exception(f"MAX API returned {r.status_code}: {r.text[:200]}")
                log.error("send_message_with_image to %s failed: %s", user_id, r.status_code)
                break

        except MaxUserBlocked:
            raise
        except (httpx.TimeoutException, httpx.ConnectError) as e:
            last_error = Exception(f"Network error: {e}")
            if attempt < max_retries - 1:
                await asyncio.sleep(1)
                continue
            break
        except Exception as e:
            last_error = e
            break

    if last_error:
        raise last_error
    raise Exception("Unknown error")


def _extract_token(data: dict) -> str | None:
    """Устойчивый парсер ответа MAX при загрузке файла.
    Поддерживает варианты:
      {"token": "..."}
      {"file": {"token": "..."}}
      {"file": {"<key>": {"token": "..."}}}
      {"files": {...}}
      {"photos": {...}}
    """
    if not isinstance(data, dict):
        return None
    if isinstance(data.get("token"), str) and data["token"]:
        return data["token"]
    for key in ("file", "files", "photos", "data"):
        block = data.get(key)
        if not block:
            continue
        if isinstance(block, dict):
            if isinstance(block.get("token"), str) and block["token"]:
                return block["token"]
            first = next(iter(block.values()), None)
            if isinstance(first, dict) and isinstance(first.get("token"), str) and first["token"]:
                return first["token"]
    return None


async def upload_file(content, filename: str, mime: str = "text/calendar",
                     upload_type: str = "file", max_retries: int = 2) -> str:
    """Загружает файл в MAX, возвращает token для использования в attachment.

    upload_type: "file" (по умолчанию) или "image".
    content может быть str (будет UTF-8) или bytes.
    """
    if not config.MAX_BOT_TOKEN:
        raise Exception("MAX_BOT_TOKEN не задан")

    data_bytes = content.encode("utf-8") if isinstance(content, str) else content
    headers = {"Authorization": config.MAX_BOT_TOKEN}

    last_error = None
    for attempt in range(max_retries):
        try:
            async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=60.0) as client:
                # 1) Получить upload URL
                r = await client.post(
                    config.MAX_API + "/uploads",
                    params={"type": upload_type},
                    headers=headers,
                )
                if r.status_code != 200:
                    raise Exception(f"MAX /uploads вернул {r.status_code}: {r.text[:200]}")
                data = r.json()
                upload_url = data.get("url")
                if not upload_url:
                    raise Exception(f"В ответе /uploads нет url: {data}")

                # 2) Загрузить файл
                files = {"data": (filename, data_bytes, mime)}
                r2 = await client.post(upload_url, files=files)
                if r2.status_code not in (200, 201):
                    raise Exception(f"Загрузка в S3 вернула {r2.status_code}: {r2.text[:200]}")

                data2 = r2.json()
                log.info("upload_file response: %s", data2)

                token = _extract_token(data2)
                if not token:
                    raise Exception(f"Не удалось извлечь token: {data2}")
                return token
        except Exception as e:
            last_error = e
            if attempt < max_retries - 1:
                await asyncio.sleep(1)
                continue
            break

    raise last_error or Exception("upload_file failed")


async def send_message_with_file(user_id: int, text: str, file_token: str,
                                  buttons: list = None, fmt: str = None,
                                  max_retries: int = 5):
    """Отправляет сообщение с файлом-вложением (attachment type=file).
    Обрабатывает attachment.not.ready — retry с нарастающей задержкой."""
    if not config.MAX_BOT_TOKEN:
        raise Exception("MAX_BOT_TOKEN не задан")

    headers = {
        "Authorization": config.MAX_BOT_TOKEN,
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
    }
    payload = {
        "text": text,
        "attachments": [
            {"type": "file", "payload": {"token": file_token}},
        ],
    }
    if fmt:
        payload["format"] = fmt
    if buttons:
        payload["attachments"].append({
            "type": "inline_keyboard",
            "payload": {"buttons": buttons},
        })

    last_error = None
    for attempt in range(max_retries):
        try:
            async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=30.0) as client:
                r = await client.post(
                    config.MAX_API + "/messages",
                    params={"user_id": user_id},
                    json=payload,
                    headers=headers,
                )

                if r.status_code == 429:
                    retry_after = int(r.headers.get("Retry-After", 1))
                    await asyncio.sleep(retry_after)
                    continue

                if r.status_code in (403, 404):
                    log.info("User %s blocked bot", user_id)
                    raise MaxUserBlocked(f"User {user_id} blocked bot")

                if 200 <= r.status_code < 300:
                    log.info("Message with file sent to %s", user_id)
                    return r.json()

                # attachment.not.ready — файл ещё обрабатывается на сервере MAX
                if r.status_code >= 400:
                    try:
                        err_data = r.json()
                        code = err_data.get("code", "")
                        if "attachment.not.ready" in code:
                            if attempt < max_retries - 1:
                                wait = 2 ** attempt  # 1, 2, 4, 8 сек
                                log.warning(
                                    "File not ready for %s (attempt %d/%d), retry in %ss",
                                    user_id, attempt + 1, max_retries, wait,
                                )
                                await asyncio.sleep(wait)
                                continue
                    except ValueError:
                        pass

                last_error = Exception(f"MAX API returned {r.status_code}: {r.text[:200]}")
                log.error("send_message_with_file to %s failed: %s", user_id, r.status_code)
                break

        except MaxUserBlocked:
            raise
        except (httpx.TimeoutException, httpx.ConnectError) as e:
            last_error = Exception(f"Network error: {e}")
            if attempt < max_retries - 1:
                await asyncio.sleep(1)
                continue
            break
        except Exception as e:
            last_error = e
            break

    if last_error:
        raise last_error
    raise Exception("Unknown error")


async def edit_message(message_id: str, text: str, buttons: list = None, fmt: str = None):
    """Редактирует сообщение."""
    headers = {
        "Authorization": config.MAX_BOT_TOKEN,
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
    }
    payload = {"text": text, "notify": False}
    if fmt:
        payload["format"] = fmt
    if buttons:
        payload["attachments"] = [{
            "type": "inline_keyboard",
            "payload": {"buttons": buttons},
        }]
    else:
        payload["attachments"] = []

    try:
        async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=30.0) as client:
            r = await client.put(
                config.MAX_API + "/messages",
                params={"message_id": message_id},
                json=payload,
                headers=headers,
            )
            log.info("Message edited: %s", r.status_code)
            return r.json() if 200 <= r.status_code < 300 else {}
    except Exception as e:
        log.warning("edit_message failed: %s", e)
        return {}

"""Фоновый воркер: напоминания + client-подтверждение + вечерняя сводка + рассылки + график."""
import asyncio
import logging
from datetime import datetime, date as _date, timedelta

import config
from core.channels.base import UserBlocked
from core.messaging import send_to_client_raw

from core.notify import notify_admins
from storage.db import (
    autocomplete_past_visits, cancel_stale_pending,
    get_upcoming_confirmed, mark_reminder_sent, increment_reminder_attempt,
    get_org_settings, get_request,
    get_pending_for_client_confirm, mark_client_asked, increment_client_ask_attempt,
    get_pending_timeout, set_client_answer,
    list_orgs, get_org, get_orgs_with_evening_summary,
    get_today_requests_for_summary,

    find_visits_for_review_request, mark_review_requested,
    db as _db,
)

log = logging.getLogger(__name__)

CHECK_INTERVAL = 5 * 60
MIN_DELAY_AFTER_BOOKING_HOURS = 2
QUIET_HOURS_START = 22
QUIET_HOURS_END = 9
LAST_CHANCE_MINUTES = 60

_last_summary_sent = {}
_last_horizon_extend = {}


def _is_phone_only(user_id) -> bool:
    return str(user_id or "").startswith("phone:")


def _parse_sched(sched_str):
    try:
        return datetime.strptime(sched_str, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")
    except Exception:
        return None


def _is_quiet_hours(now_local, start_hour=None, end_hour=None):
    """Проверка «тихих часов». Границы можно передать явно
    (из настроек организации), иначе используются константы по умолчанию."""
    if start_hour is None:
        start_hour = QUIET_HOURS_START
    if end_hour is None:
        end_hour = QUIET_HOURS_END

    h = now_local.hour
    if start_hour == end_hour:
        return False  # вырожденный случай — тихих часов нет
    if start_hour > end_hour:
        # переход через полночь: 22 → 9
        return h >= start_hour or h < end_hour
    # обычный интервал: 1 → 6
    return start_hour <= h < end_hour


# ==================== напоминания ====================

async def _send_reminder(request_id, kind, attempts_used, now_local):
    req = get_request(request_id)
    if not req:
        return
    rid = req["id"]
    org_id = req["org_id"]
    client_uid = req["user_id"]
    service_name = req["service_name"]
    scheduled_at = req["scheduled_at"]
    address = req["address"]
    doctor = req["doctor"]

    if not client_uid:
        return
    if _is_phone_only(client_uid):
        mark_reminder_sent(request_id, "2h" if kind == "last_chance" else kind)
        log.info("Reminder %s for #%s skipped: phone-only client", kind, request_id)
        return
    if attempts_used >= config.MAX_SEND_ATTEMPTS:
        mark_reminder_sent(request_id, "2h" if kind == "last_chance" else kind)
        log.warning("Reminder %s for #%s gave up after %d attempts",
                    kind, request_id, attempts_used)
        return

    if kind == "24h":
        header = "🔔 **Напоминание о записи**\n\nЗавтра у вас приём."
    elif kind == "2h":
        header = "🔔 **Напоминание о записи**\n\nЧерез 2 часа у вас приём."
    elif kind == "last_chance":
        header = "🔔 **Скоро приём**\n\nНапоминаем — приём уже скоро."
    else:
        header = "🔔 **Напоминание о записи**"

    text = f"{header}\n\n**{service_name}**\n📅 {scheduled_at}\n"
    if address:
        text += route_lines(address, org_id=org_id)
    if doctor:
        text += f"👨‍⚕️ {doctor}\n"

    buttons = [[
        {"type": "callback", "text": "✅ Подтверждаю", "payload": f"rem:yes:{rid}"},
        {"type": "callback", "text": "❌ Отменить", "payload": f"rem:no:{rid}"},
    ]]

    try:
        await send_to_client_raw(int(client_uid), text, buttons, fmt="markdown")
        mark_reminder_sent(request_id, "2h" if kind == "last_chance" else kind)
        log.info("Reminder %s sent for #%s", kind, request_id)
    except UserBlocked:
        mark_reminder_sent(request_id, "2h" if kind == "last_chance" else kind)
        log.info("Reminder %s skipped for #%s: user blocked bot", kind, request_id)
    except Exception as e:
        increment_reminder_attempt(request_id, "2h" if kind == "last_chance" else kind)
        log.warning("Reminder %s failed for #%s (attempt %d/%d): %s",
                    kind, request_id, attempts_used + 1, config.MAX_SEND_ATTEMPTS, e)


def _get_created_at(request_id):
    conn = _db()
    row = conn.execute("SELECT created_at FROM history WHERE id=?", (request_id,)).fetchone()
    conn.close()
    return row["created_at"] if row else None


async def _check_reminders():
    rows = get_upcoming_confirmed()
    for r in rows:
        rid = r["id"]
        org_id = r["org_id"]
        scheduled_at = r["scheduled_at"]
        rem24 = r["reminder_24_sent_at"]
        rem2 = r["reminder_2_sent_at"]
        att24 = r["reminder_24_attempts"] or 0
        att2 = r["reminder_2_attempts"] or 0

        now_local = now_for_org(org_id)
        sched_dt = _parse_sched(scheduled_at)
        if not sched_dt:
            continue
        delta = sched_dt - now_local
        seconds = delta.total_seconds()
        if seconds <= 0:
            continue

        created_at = _get_created_at(rid)
        if created_at:
            try:
                created_dt = datetime.fromisoformat(created_at)
                if (datetime.now() - created_dt).total_seconds() < MIN_DELAY_AFTER_BOOKING_HOURS * 3600 \
                        and seconds > 2 * 3600:
                    continue
            except Exception:
                pass

        settings = get_org_settings(org_id)
        want_24h = settings.get("reminder_24h", True)
        want_2h = settings.get("reminder_2h", True)
        quiet_start = int(settings.get("quiet_hours_start", QUIET_HOURS_START) or 0)
        quiet_end = int(settings.get("quiet_hours_end", QUIET_HOURS_END) or 0)
        quiet = _is_quiet_hours(now_local, quiet_start, quiet_end)

        if seconds <= LAST_CHANCE_MINUTES * 60 and not rem2:
            await _send_reminder(rid, "last_chance", att2, now_local)
            continue
        if quiet:
            continue
        if 0 < seconds <= 2 * 3600 and want_2h and not rem2:
            await _send_reminder(rid, "2h", att2, now_local)
            continue
        # 24h reminder не нужен, если по записи уже был client-confirm
        # (клиент уже получил запрос «Придёте?» и ответил/думает).
        client_asked_at = r["client_asked_at"]
        if (20 * 3600 < seconds <= 24 * 3600 and want_24h and not rem24
                and not client_asked_at):
            await _send_reminder(rid, "24h", att24, now_local)
            continue


# ==================== client confirm ====================

async def _ask_client_confirm(request_id, attempts_used):
    req = get_request(request_id)
    if not req:
        return
    rid = req["id"]
    org_id = req["org_id"]
    client_uid = req["user_id"]
    service_name = req["service_name"]
    scheduled_at = req["scheduled_at"]
    address = req["address"]
    doctor = req["doctor"]

    if not client_uid:
        return
    if _is_phone_only(client_uid):
        mark_client_asked(rid)
        log.info("Client confirm for #%s skipped: phone-only client", request_id)
        return
    if attempts_used >= config.MAX_SEND_ATTEMPTS:
        mark_client_asked(rid)
        log.warning("Client confirm for #%s gave up after %d attempts",
                    request_id, attempts_used)
        return

    text = (
        f"❓ **Подтверждение записи**\n\n"
        f"Вы записаны на **{service_name}**\n"
        f"📅 {scheduled_at}\n"
    )
    if address:
        text += route_lines(address, org_id=org_id)
    if doctor:
        text += f"👨‍⚕️ {doctor}\n"
    text += "\nПридёте?"

    buttons = [[
        {"type": "callback", "text": "✅ Приду", "payload": f"cc:yes:{rid}"},
        {"type": "callback", "text": "❌ Не смогу", "payload": f"cc:no:{rid}"},
    ]]

    try:
        await send_to_client_raw(int(client_uid), text, buttons, fmt="markdown")
        mark_client_asked(rid)
        log.info("Client confirm asked for #%s", request_id)
    except UserBlocked:
        mark_client_asked(rid)
        log.info("Client confirm skipped for #%s: user blocked bot", request_id)
    except Exception as e:
        increment_client_ask_attempt(rid)
        log.warning("Failed to ask client for #%s (attempt %d/%d): %s",
                    request_id, attempts_used + 1, config.MAX_SEND_ATTEMPTS, e)


async def _check_client_confirm():
    rows = get_pending_for_client_confirm()
    for r in rows:
        rid = r["id"]
        org_id = r["org_id"]
        scheduled_at = r["scheduled_at"]
        created_at = r["created_at"]
        attempts = r["client_ask_attempts"] or 0

        settings = get_org_settings(org_id)
        if settings.get("confirmation_mode") != "client":
            continue
        delay_min = int(settings.get("client_confirm_delay_min", 60))

        now_local = now_for_org(org_id)
        try:
            created_dt = datetime.fromisoformat(created_at)
            sched_dt = _parse_sched(scheduled_at)
        except Exception:
            continue
        if not sched_dt:
            continue

        # Тихие часы: не дёргаем клиента ночью, КРОМЕ случая,
        # когда приём наступит раньше, чем закончатся тихие часы
        # (иначе клиент вообще не получит запрос на подтверждение).
        quiet_start = int(settings.get("quiet_hours_start", QUIET_HOURS_START) or 0)
        quiet_end = int(settings.get("quiet_hours_end", QUIET_HOURS_END) or 0)
        if _is_quiet_hours(now_local, quiet_start, quiet_end):
            quiet_end_dt = now_local.replace(
                hour=quiet_end, minute=0, second=0, microsecond=0
            )
            if quiet_end_dt <= now_local:
                quiet_end_dt += timedelta(days=1)
            if sched_dt > quiet_end_dt:
                continue

        minutes_to_appt = (sched_dt - now_local).total_seconds() / 60
        if minutes_to_appt <= 0:
            continue

        effective_delay = delay_min
        if minutes_to_appt < delay_min:
            effective_delay = min(2, max(1, minutes_to_appt - 1))

        delta_since_created_min = (datetime.now() - created_dt).total_seconds() / 60
        if delta_since_created_min < effective_delay:
            continue
        await _ask_client_confirm(rid, attempts)


async def _check_client_timeout():
    rows = get_pending_timeout()
    for r in rows:
        rid = r["id"]
        org_id = r["org_id"]
        service_name = r["service_name"]
        scheduled_at = r["scheduled_at"]
        phone = r["phone"]
        client_asked_at = r["client_asked_at"]
        settings = get_org_settings(org_id)
        if settings.get("confirmation_mode") != "client":
            continue
        timeout_min = int(settings.get("client_confirm_timeout_min", 120))
        try:
            asked_dt = datetime.fromisoformat(client_asked_at)
        except Exception:
            continue
        delta_since_asked_min = (datetime.now() - asked_dt).total_seconds() / 60
        if delta_since_asked_min < timeout_min:
            continue
        set_client_answer(rid, "timeout")
        await notify_admins(
            f"⏰ **Клиент не ответил на подтверждение**\n\n"
            f"**{service_name}**\n📅 {scheduled_at}\n"
            f"Телефон: {phone or '—'}\n\n"
            f"Заявка остаётся в статусе «ожидает». Подтвердите вручную или позвоните клиенту.",
            org_id=org_id,
        )
        log.info("Client timeout for #%s, admin notified", rid)


# ==================== запросы на отзыв ====================

async def _check_review_requests():
    """Отправляет запрос на отзыв клиентам через N часов после done-визита.

    Один запрос на клиента: если у клиента несколько done-визитов без отзыва —
    берём самый свежий (find_visits_for_review_request уже это делает).
    """
    for org in list_orgs():
        oid = org["id"]
        try:
            settings = get_org_settings(oid)
        except Exception:
            continue
        if not settings.get("review_request_enabled"):
            continue
        delay_h = int(settings.get("review_request_delay_hours", 2) or 2)

        try:
            visits = find_visits_for_review_request(oid, delay_h)
        except Exception as e:
            log.error("review_request: query failed for org %s: %s", oid, e)
            continue

        for v in visits:
            rid = v["request_id"]
            uid = v["user_id"]
            if not uid or str(uid).startswith("phone:"):
                continue

            name = (v["first_name"] or "").strip() or "друг"
            service_name = v["service_name"] or ""
            text = (
                f"🙏 **{name}**, спасибо, что были у нас!\n\n"
            )
            if service_name:
                text += f"**{service_name}**\n\n"
            text += "Оцените, пожалуйста, визит от 1 до 5 звёзд — это займёт 1 секунду и очень поможет нам стать лучше."

            buttons = [[
                {"type": "callback", "text": "1 ⭐", "payload": f"rv:rate:{rid}:1"},
                {"type": "callback", "text": "2 ⭐", "payload": f"rv:rate:{rid}:2"},
                {"type": "callback", "text": "3 ⭐", "payload": f"rv:rate:{rid}:3"},
                {"type": "callback", "text": "4 ⭐", "payload": f"rv:rate:{rid}:4"},
                {"type": "callback", "text": "5 ⭐", "payload": f"rv:rate:{rid}:5"},
            ]]

            try:
                await send_to_client_raw(int(uid), text, buttons, fmt="markdown")
                mark_review_requested(rid)
                log.info("review_request sent: org=%s uid=%s req=%s", oid, uid, rid)
                await asyncio.sleep(0.5)
            except UserBlocked:
                mark_review_requested(rid)
                log.info("review_request skipped: uid=%s blocked bot (marked)", uid)
            except Exception as e:
                log.warning("review_request send failed uid=%s: %s", uid, e)


# ==================== вечерняя сводка ====================

def _evening_summary_buttons(org_id, today_str):
    return [
        [
            {"type": "callback", "text": "📊 День (PDF)",
             "payload": f"rep:day_pdf:{org_id}:{today_str}"},
            {"type": "callback", "text": "📊 Неделя (XLSX)",
             "payload": f"rep:week_xlsx:{org_id}:{today_str}"},
        ],
        [
            {"type": "callback", "text": "📄 Сводка (CSV)",
             "payload": f"rep:day_csv:{org_id}:{today_str}"},
        ],
    ]


async def _send_evening_summary(org_id, today_str):
    try:
        org = get_org(org_id)
        if not org:
            log.warning("Evening summary: org %s not found", org_id)
            return
        org_name = org["name"]
        rows = get_today_requests_for_summary(org_id, today_str)

        if not rows:
            text = (
                f"🌙 **Итоги дня · {today_str}**\n\n"
                f"🏢 {org_name}\n\n"
                f"📭 Записей на сегодня не было."
            )
            buttons = _evening_summary_buttons(org_id, today_str)
            await notify_admins(text, org_id=org_id, buttons=buttons)
            log.info("Evening summary (empty day) sent for org %s (%s)",
                     org_id, today_str)
            return

        total = len(rows)
        done = 0
        no_show = 0
        pending = 0
        confirmed = 0
        cancelled = 0
        revenue = 0
        for r in rows:
            st = r["status"]
            if st == "done":
                done += 1
                if r["actual_amount"]:
                    revenue += int(r["actual_amount"])
            elif st == "no_show":
                no_show += 1
            elif st == "pending":
                pending += 1
            elif st == "confirmed":
                confirmed += 1
            elif st == "cancelled":
                cancelled += 1

        from datetime import date as _d, timedelta as _td
        tomorrow = (_d.fromisoformat(today_str) + _td(days=1)).isoformat()
        conn = _db()
        tomorrow_count = conn.execute(
            "SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM history "
            "WHERE org_id=? AND date(scheduled_at)=date(?) "
            "AND status IN ('pending','confirmed')",
            (org_id, tomorrow),
        ).fetchone()["n"]
        conn.close()

        text = (
            f"🌙 **Итоги дня · {today_str}**\n\n"
            f"🏢 {org_name}\n"
            f"Всего записей: {total}\n"
            f"✅ Пришли: {done}\n"
            f"🚫 Не пришли: {no_show}\n"
            f"🟡 Ожидают: {pending}\n"
            f"🔵 Подтверждены: {confirmed}\n"
            f"❌ Отменены: {cancelled}\n"
        )
        if revenue > 0:
            text += f"\n💰 Выручка: **{revenue} ₽**\n"
        text += f"\n📅 На завтра записано: {tomorrow_count}"

        buttons = _evening_summary_buttons(org_id, today_str)
        await notify_admins(text, org_id=org_id, buttons=buttons)
        log.info("Evening summary sent for org %s (%s)", org_id, today_str)
    except Exception as e:
        log.error("Evening summary failed for org %s: %s", org_id, e)


async def _check_evening_summaries():
    for org_id, summary_hour in get_orgs_with_evening_summary():
        now_local = now_for_org(org_id)
        if now_local.hour != summary_hour:
            continue
        today_str = now_local.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
        if _last_summary_sent.get(org_id) == today_str:
            continue
        log.info("Evening summary due for org %s (hour=%d, date=%s)",
                 org_id, summary_hour, today_str)
        await _send_evening_summary(org_id, today_str)
        _last_summary_sent[org_id] = today_str


# ==================== автопродление горизонта графиков ====================

async def _extend_schedules_horizon():
    """Раз в сутки продлевает горизонт автогенерированных слотов для всех организаций.
    Тяжёлая синхронная работа вынесена в отдельный поток через asyncio.to_thread,
    чтобы не блокировать event loop (иначе бот перестаёт отвечать на webhook).
    """
    today_local = _date.today()
    for org in list_orgs():
        oid = org["id"]
        if _last_horizon_extend.get(oid) == today_local:
            continue
        try:
            r = await asyncio.to_thread(regenerate_all_slots_for_org, oid)
            if r["doctors"] > 0:
                log.info(
                    "Schedule horizon extended for org %s: doctors=%d created=%d deleted=%d skipped_booked=%d",
                    oid, r["doctors"], r["created"], r["deleted"], r["skipped_booked"],
                )
            _last_horizon_extend[oid] = today_local
        except Exception as e:
            log.error("Schedule horizon extend failed for org %s: %s", oid, e)


# ==================== housekeeping ====================

async def _cleanup_temp_exports():
    """Удаляет временные файлы экспорта (csv/xlsx/pdf):
    1) старше 1 часа — независимо от того, что в БД;
    2) файлы на диске без записи в uploaded_images (orphans).
    Не трогает изображения (картинки рассылок, фото клиентов/специалистов).
    """
    import os as _os
    import config as _config
    from storage.db import (
        list_temp_exports_older_than, list_orphan_uploaded_files,
        delete_uploaded_image_file, list_orgs,
    )
    from pathlib import Path as _Path

    deleted = 0

    # 1. Временные экспорты старше 1 часа
    try:
        stale = list_temp_exports_older_than(60)
        for row in stale:
            try:
                delete_uploaded_image_file(row["id"])
                deleted += 1
            except Exception as e:
                log.warning("Cleanup temp export id=%s failed: %s", row["id"], e)
    except Exception as e:
        log.error("Cleanup temp exports error: %s", e)

    # 2. Orphan-файлы на диске (нет записи в БД)
    try:
        for org in list_orgs():
            oid = org["id"]
            orphans = list_orphan_uploaded_files(oid, ["csv", "xlsx", "pdf"])
            for rel_path in orphans:
                try:
                    abs_path = _Path(_config.UPLOADS_DIR) / rel_path
                    if abs_path.exists():
                        abs_path.unlink()
                        deleted += 1
                except Exception as e:
                    log.warning("Cleanup orphan file %s failed: %s", rel_path, e)
    except Exception as e:
        log.error("Cleanup orphan files error: %s", e)

    if deleted:
        log.info("Cleanup temp exports: deleted %d file(s)", deleted)


async def _daily_housekeeping():
    """Ежедневные задачи по каждой организации:
    - автозавершение прошедших confirmed → done (с суммой по прайсу, done_auto=1)
    - отмена зависших pending (pending_timeout_min) с освобождением слотов

    Раньше функция вызывалась в воркере, но потерялась при рефакторинге —
    при этом импорты autocomplete_past_visits/cancel_stale_pending остались.
    Восстанавливаем.
    """
    for org in list_orgs():
        oid = org["id"]
        try:
            settings = get_org_settings(oid)
        except Exception as e:
            log.warning("Housekeeping: get_org_settings failed for org %s: %s", oid, e)
            continue

        autocomplete_hours = int(settings.get("autocomplete_after_hours", 3) or 0)
        pending_timeout = int(settings.get("pending_timeout_min", 0) or 0)

        if autocomplete_hours > 0:
            try:
                n = await asyncio.to_thread(
                    autocomplete_past_visits, autocomplete_hours, oid,
                )
                if n:
                    log.info("Autocompleted %d visits for org %s", n, oid)
            except Exception as e:
                log.error("Autocomplete failed for org %s: %s", oid, e)

        if pending_timeout > 0:
            try:
                n = await asyncio.to_thread(
                    cancel_stale_pending, pending_timeout, oid,
                )
                if n:
                    log.info("Cancelled %d stale pending for org %s", n, oid)
            except Exception as e:
                log.error("Cancel stale pending failed for org %s: %s", oid, e)


async def run_reminder_worker():
    log.info("Reminder worker started")

    await asyncio.sleep(60)
    while True:
        try:
            await _daily_housekeeping()
        except Exception as e:
            log.error("Housekeeping cycle error: %s", e)

        try:
            await _cleanup_temp_exports()
        except Exception as e:
            log.error("Cleanup temp exports cycle error: %s", e)

        try:
            await _extend_schedules_horizon()
        except Exception as e:
            log.error("Schedule horizon cycle error: %s", e)

        try:
            await _check_reminders()
        except Exception as e:
            log.error("Reminders cycle error: %s", e)

        try:
            await _check_client_confirm()
        except Exception as e:
            log.error("Client confirm cycle error: %s", e)

        try:
            await _check_client_timeout()
        except Exception as e:
            log.error("Client timeout cycle error: %s", e)

        try:
            await _check_review_requests()
        except Exception as e:
            log.error("Review requests cycle error: %s", e)

        try:
            await _check_evening_summaries()
        except Exception as e:
            log.error("Evening summary cycle error: %s", e)

        await asyncio.sleep(CHECK_INTERVAL)


# ==================== Супервизор воркеров ====================

async def run_supervised(name: str, worker_fn):
    """Обёртка для фоновых воркеров: перезапускает при падении.

    Если воркер бросил исключение (кроме CancelledError) — логируем
    и перезапускаем через 30 секунд. Так один упавший воркер не убивает
    остальные и сам восстанавливается до рестарта бота.
    """
    while True:
        try:
            await worker_fn()
        except asyncio.CancelledError:
            log.info("%s worker cancelled", name)
            raise
        except Exception as e:
            log.exception("%s worker crashed: %s. Restart in 30s", name, e)
            await asyncio.sleep(30)

ФАЙЛ: core/dispatcher.py  (4219 байт)

"""Маршрутизация входящих Update → handlers.

Платформонезависимо: приходит Update (см. core/updates.py),
дальше просто матчинг по .type и вызовы handlers. Специфика
канала — в webhook_adapters/<platform>.py.
"""
import logging

from core.messaging import send_to_client_raw
from core.updates import Update
from core.webhook_adapters import max as max_adapter
from handlers import start, booking, admin
from handlers import superadmin_callbacks as sa_cb
from handlers import request_callbacks as req_cb
from handlers import reminder_callbacks as rem_cb
from handlers import client_confirm_callbacks as cc_cb
from handlers import visit_callbacks as vis_cb
from handlers import unsub_callbacks as unsub_cb
from handlers import report_callbacks as rep_cb
from handlers import review_callbacks as rv_cb
from core import waitlist as wl_core
import config

log = logging.getLogger(__name__)


async def route(update: Update):
    """Маршрутизация одного Update. Не зависит от платформы."""
    try:
        uid = int(update.user_id) if update.user_id.isdigit() else update.user_id
    except (AttributeError, ValueError):
        log.warning("Update without valid user_id, skip: %r", update.user_id)
        return

    if update.type == "message_created":
        text = update.text or ""
        if not text:
            return
        await _handle_message(uid, text, update.platform)
        return

    if update.type == "message_callback":
        payload = update.payload or ""
        if not payload:
            return
        await _handle_callback(uid, payload, update.message_id, update.platform)
        return

    if update.type == "bot_started":
        if uid:
            await start.cmd_start(uid, platform=update.platform)
        return


async def _handle_message(uid, text, platform="max"):
    low = text.lower()

    if await sa_cb.handle_text(uid, text):
        return

    if await admin.try_handle(uid, text):
        return

    if low in ("/start", "start", "начать", "привет"):
        await start.cmd_start(uid, platform=platform)
        return

    if low == "/myid":
        await send_to_client_raw(uid, f"Ваш ID: {uid}")
        return

    if low == "/help":
        await send_to_client_raw(
            uid,
            "Доступные команды:\n"
            "/start — начать запись\n"
            "/myid — узнать свой ID\n"
            "/iam — подать заявку на роль администратора\n"
            "/help — справка",
        )
        return

    if low in ("/today", "/сегодня"):
        await vis_cb.send_today(uid)
        return

    if low == "/cancel":
        await start.cmd_start(uid)
        return

    if not text.startswith("/"):
        await booking.handle_input(uid, text)


async def _handle_callback(uid, payload, message_id, platform="max"):
    if await unsub_cb.handle(uid, payload, message_id):
        return
    if await wl_core.handle_callback(uid, payload, message_id):
        return
    if await sa_cb.handle(uid, payload, message_id):
        return
    if await req_cb.handle(uid, payload, message_id):
        return
    if await rem_cb.handle(uid, payload, message_id):
        return
    if await cc_cb.handle(uid, payload, message_id):
        return
    if await vis_cb.handle(uid, payload, message_id):
        return
    if await rep_cb.handle(uid, payload, message_id):
        return
    if await rv_cb.handle(uid, payload, message_id):
        return
    await booking.handle_callback(uid, payload, message_id)


async def route_update(data: dict):
    """Совместимая обёртка: сырой dict → parse → route.

    Оставлена для случаев, если где-то ещё зовут route_update(data).
    В routers/webhook.py переключаемся на parse+route напрямую.
    """
    update = max_adapter.parse(data)
    if not update:
        log.debug("Unparseable update: %r", (data or {}).get("update_type"))
        return
    await route(update)

ФАЙЛ: core/client_exports.py  (30486 байт)
