"""Сборка файлов экспорта карточки клиента: CSV / XLSX / PDF.

Вызывается из routers.admin_requests (admin_client_export_file).
Все зависимости (openpyxl, reportlab) импортируются локально
внутри функций — чтобы модуль быстро грузился.
"""
from datetime import datetime
from io import BytesIO

from storage.db import get_service  # noqa: F401 — на будущее, может понадобиться


def build_client_export_csv(data, client):
    from io import StringIO
    import csv as _csv
    buf = StringIO()
    buf.write("\ufeff")
    w = _csv.writer(buf, delimiter=";", lineterminator="\n")
    w.writerow(["Тип", "ID", "Дата и время", "Услуга", "Специалист", "Статус",
                "Сумма, ₽", "Способ оплаты", "Слотов", "Авто"])
    status_map = {
        "pending": "ожидает", "confirmed": "подтверждена",
        "cancelled": "отменена", "done": "пришёл", "no_show": "не пришёл",
    }
    for r in (data.get("upcoming") or []):
        w.writerow([
            "предстоящий", r["id"], r["scheduled_at"], r["service_name"] or "",
            r["doctor"] or "", status_map.get(r["status"], r["status"]),
            "", "", r["slots_count"] or 1, "",
        ])
    for r in data["history"]:
        w.writerow([
            "история", r["id"], r["scheduled_at"], r["service_name"] or "",
            r["doctor"] or "", status_map.get(r["status"], r["status"]),
            r["actual_amount"] if r["actual_amount"] is not None else "",
            r["payment_method"] or "",
            r["slots_count"] or 1,
            "да" if r["done_auto"] else "",
        ])
    return buf.getvalue().encode("utf-8")


def build_client_export_xlsx(data, client, for_client=False):
    from openpyxl import Workbook
    from openpyxl.styles import Font, PatternFill, Alignment, Border, Side
    from openpyxl.worksheet.page import PageMargins
    from openpyxl.worksheet.properties import PageSetupProperties, Outline
    from openpyxl.utils import get_column_letter

    wb = Workbook()

    title_font = Font(name="Calibri", bold=True, size=16, color="2E5F8A")
    name_font = Font(name="Calibri", bold=True, size=14, color="1F2D3A")
    label_font = Font(name="Calibri", bold=True, size=10)
    value_font = Font(name="Calibri", size=10)
    section_font = Font(name="Calibri", bold=True, size=12, color="2E5F8A")
    group_font = Font(name="Calibri", bold=True, size=10, color="2E5F8A")
    total_font = Font(name="Calibri", bold=True, size=11)

    title_fill = PatternFill("solid", fgColor="E3F0FB")
    group_fill = PatternFill("solid", fgColor="E3F0FB")
    upcoming_fill = PatternFill("solid", fgColor="FFF4D9")
    total_fill = PatternFill("solid", fgColor="FFF4D9")
    zebra_fill = PatternFill("solid", fgColor="F7FAFD")

    thin = Side(border_style="thin", color="D9E6F2")
    thick = Side(border_style="medium", color="2E5F8A")
    border_thin = Border(left=thin, right=thin, top=thin, bottom=thin)
    border_upcoming = Border(
        left=Side(border_style="thin", color="F0DFA3"),
        right=Side(border_style="thin", color="F0DFA3"),
        top=Side(border_style="thin", color="F0DFA3"),
        bottom=Side(border_style="thin", color="F0DFA3"),
    )

    fio = " ".join(p for p in [client["last_name"], client["first_name"], client["middle_name"]] if p).strip() or str(client["user_id"])
    org_name = data.get("org_name") or ""
    gender_label = "—"
    if client["gender"] == "male":
        gender_label = "Мужской"
    elif client["gender"] == "female":
        gender_label = "Женский"

    _agg = data.get("aggregates")
    agg = dict(_agg) if _agg else {}
    visits_done = agg.get("visits_done") or 0
    visits_no_show = agg.get("visits_no_show") or 0
    total_revenue = agg.get("total_revenue") or 0
    last_done = agg.get("last_done_at") or "—"

    status_map = {
        "pending": "ожидает", "confirmed": "подтверждена",
        "cancelled": "отменена", "done": "пришёл", "no_show": "не пришёл",
    }

    ws = wb.active
    ws.title = "Карточка"

    header_title = "Ваши визиты" if for_client else "Карточка клиента"
    header_subtitle = org_name if for_client else fio

    ws.merge_cells("A1:F1")
    c = ws["A1"]
    c.value = header_title
    c.font = title_font
    c.fill = title_fill
    c.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="left", vertical="center")
    ws.row_dimensions[1].height = 26

    ws.merge_cells("A2:F2")
    c = ws["A2"]
    c.value = header_subtitle
    c.font = name_font
    c.fill = title_fill
    c.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="left", vertical="center")
    ws.row_dimensions[2].height = 22

    if for_client:
        profile = [
            ("ФИО", fio),
            ("Телефон", client["phone"] or "—"),
            ("Дата рождения", client["birth_date"] or "—"),
            ("Пол", gender_label),
            ("Любимый специалист", data.get("favorite_doctor_name") or "—"),
            ("Последний визит", str(last_done)),
            ("Всего визитов", str(visits_done)),
            ("Общая выручка", f"{total_revenue} ₽"),
        ]
    else:
        consent = "не дано"
        if client["consent_152fz"]:
            consent = f"да ({client['consent_given_at'] or ''})"
        profile = [
            ("Телефон", client["phone"] or "—"),
            ("Дата рождения", client["birth_date"] or "—"),
            ("Пол", gender_label),
            ("Любимый специалист", data.get("favorite_doctor_name") or "—"),
            ("Последний визит", str(last_done)),
            ("Согласие 152-ФЗ", consent),
            ("Всего визитов", str(visits_done)),
            ("Неявок", str(visits_no_show)),
            ("Общая выручка", f"{total_revenue} ₽"),
        ]

    row = 4
    for label, value in profile:
        lc = ws.cell(row=row, column=1, value=label)
        lc.font = label_font
        lc.fill = PatternFill("solid", fgColor="F5F9FC")
        lc.alignment = Alignment(vertical="center")
        vc = ws.cell(row=row, column=2, value=value)
        vc.font = value_font
        ws.merge_cells(start_row=row, start_column=2, end_row=row, end_column=6)
        row += 1

    upcoming = data.get("upcoming") or []
    if upcoming:
        row += 1
        ws.merge_cells(start_row=row, start_column=1, end_row=row, end_column=6)
        uc = ws.cell(row=row, column=1, value="📅 Предстоящие визиты")
        uc.font = section_font
        uc.fill = upcoming_fill
        uc.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="left", vertical="center")
        row += 1

        up_headers = ["Дата и время", "Услуга", "Специалист", "Статус", "Слотов", ""]
        for col, h in enumerate(up_headers, start=1):
            cc = ws.cell(row=row, column=col, value=h)
            cc.font = group_font
            cc.fill = upcoming_fill
            cc.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center", vertical="center")
            cc.border = border_upcoming
        row += 1
        for v in upcoming:
            vals = [
                str(v["scheduled_at"] or ""),
                str(v["service_name"] or ""),
                str(v["doctor"] or "—"),
                status_map.get(v["status"], v["status"]),
                v["slots_count"] or 1,
                "",
            ]
            for col, val in enumerate(vals, start=1):
                cc = ws.cell(row=row, column=col, value=val)
                cc.font = value_font
                cc.border = border_upcoming
                if col in (4, 5):
                    cc.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center")
            row += 1

    if data["history"]:
        row += 1
        ws.merge_cells(start_row=row, start_column=1, end_row=row, end_column=6)
        hc = ws.cell(row=row, column=1, value="📋 История визитов")
        hc.font = section_font
        hc.fill = title_fill
        hc.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="left", vertical="center")
        row += 1

        by_service = {}
        for r in data["history"]:
            sname = r["service_name"] or "—"
            by_service.setdefault(sname, []).append(r)

        for sname, visits in by_service.items():
            service_amount = sum((v["actual_amount"] or 0) for v in visits if v["status"] == "done")
            ws.merge_cells(start_row=row, start_column=1, end_row=row, end_column=5)
            gc = ws.cell(row=row, column=1, value=f"📂 {sname} · {len(visits)} визит(ов)")
            gc.font = group_font
            gc.fill = group_fill
            gc.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="left", vertical="center")
            sa = ws.cell(row=row, column=6, value=service_amount if service_amount else None)
            sa.font = group_font
            sa.fill = group_fill
            sa.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="right")
            sa.number_format = '#,##0 "₽"'
            for col in range(1, 7):
                ws.cell(row=row, column=col).border = border_thin
            row += 1

            visit_headers = ["Дата и время", "Услуга", "Специалист", "Статус", "Сумма", "Оплата"]
            for col, h in enumerate(visit_headers, start=1):
                cc = ws.cell(row=row, column=col, value=h)
                cc.font = Font(name="Calibri", bold=True, size=9, color="2E5F8A")
                cc.fill = PatternFill("solid", fgColor="F5F9FC")
                cc.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center", vertical="center")
                cc.border = border_thin
            row += 1

            for i, v in enumerate(visits):
                amt = v["actual_amount"]
                vals = [
                    str(v["scheduled_at"] or ""),
                    str(v["service_name"] or ""),
                    str(v["doctor"] or "—"),
                    status_map.get(v["status"], v["status"]),
                    int(amt) if amt is not None else None,
                    str(v["payment_method"] or ""),
                ]
                for col, val in enumerate(vals, start=1):
                    cc = ws.cell(row=row, column=col, value=val)
                    cc.font = value_font
                    cc.border = border_thin
                    if i % 2 == 1:
                        cc.fill = zebra_fill
                    if col == 4:
                        cc.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center")
                    if col == 5:
                        cc.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="right")
                        cc.number_format = '#,##0 "₽"'
                row += 1

        row += 1
        ws.merge_cells(start_row=row, start_column=1, end_row=row, end_column=5)
        total_cell = ws.cell(row=row, column=1, value="Итого выручка (по завершённым визитам)")
        total_cell.font = total_font
        total_cell.fill = total_fill
        total_cell.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="right", vertical="center")
        total_amt = ws.cell(row=row, column=6, value=total_revenue)
        total_amt.font = total_font
        total_amt.fill = total_fill
        total_amt.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="right")
        total_amt.number_format = '#,##0 "₽"'
        for col in range(1, 7):
            ws.cell(row=row, column=col).border = Border(
                left=thick, right=thick, top=thick, bottom=thick,
            )

    ws.column_dimensions["A"].width = 22
    ws.column_dimensions["B"].width = 26
    ws.column_dimensions["C"].width = 22
    ws.column_dimensions["D"].width = 15
    ws.column_dimensions["E"].width = 12
    ws.column_dimensions["F"].width = 14
    ws.print_area = f"A1:F{row}"
    ws.page_setup.orientation = "portrait"
    ws.page_setup.fitToWidth = 1
    ws.page_setup.fitToHeight = 0
    ws.sheet_properties.pageSetUpPr = PageSetupProperties(fitToPage=True)
    ws.page_margins = PageMargins(left=0.4, right=0.4, top=0.5, bottom=0.5)
    ws.oddHeader.center.text = header_title
    ws.oddHeader.center.size = 10
    ws.oddHeader.center.font = "Calibri,Bold"
    ws.oddFooter.center.text = "Стр. &P из &N"
    ws.oddFooter.center.size = 8

    ws2 = wb.create_sheet("История визитов")
    ws2.sheet_properties.outlinePr = Outline(summaryBelow=False, summaryRight=False)

    ws2.merge_cells("A1:I1")
    c = ws2["A1"]
    c.value = f"История визитов · {fio}"
    c.font = title_font
    c.fill = title_fill
    c.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="left", vertical="center")
    ws2.row_dimensions[1].height = 22

    headers = ["ID", "Дата и время", "Услуга", "Специалист", "Статус",
               "Сумма, ₽", "Способ оплаты", "Слотов", "Авто"]
    header_fill = PatternFill("solid", fgColor="2E5F8A")
    header_font = Font(name="Calibri", bold=True, size=10, color="FFFFFF")
    header_border = Border(left=thin, right=thin, top=thick, bottom=thick)
    for col, h in enumerate(headers, start=1):
        c = ws2.cell(row=2, column=col, value=h)
        c.font = header_font
        c.fill = header_fill
        c.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center", vertical="center")
        c.border = header_border

    tree_service = {}
    for r in data["history"]:
        sname = r["service_name"] or "—"
        dname = r["doctor"] or "—"
        st = status_map.get(r["status"], r["status"])
        tree_service.setdefault(sname, {}).setdefault(dname, {}).setdefault(st, []).append(r)

    def _group_amount(rows):
        return sum((v["actual_amount"] or 0) for v in rows if v["status"] == "done")

    def _write_group_header(row_idx, level, title, total_amount):
        ws2.merge_cells(start_row=row_idx, start_column=1, end_row=row_idx, end_column=8)
        hc = ws2.cell(row=row_idx, column=1, value=title)
        hc.font = group_font
        hc.fill = group_fill if level == 0 else (PatternFill("solid", fgColor="EEF6FC") if level == 1 else PatternFill("solid", fgColor="F7FAFD"))
        hc.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="left", vertical="center", indent=level * 2)
        amt = ws2.cell(row=row_idx, column=9, value=(total_amount if total_amount else None))
        amt.font = group_font
        amt.fill = group_fill if level == 0 else (PatternFill("solid", fgColor="EEF6FC") if level == 1 else PatternFill("solid", fgColor="F7FAFD"))
        amt.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="right", vertical="center")
        amt.number_format = '#,##0 "₽"'
        for col in range(1, 10):
            ws2.cell(row=row_idx, column=col).border = border_thin
        if level > 0:
            ws2.row_dimensions[row_idx].outlineLevel = level
        ws2.row_dimensions[row_idx].hidden = False

    def _write_visit_row(row_idx, r, i, indent_level=3):
        ws2.cell(row=row_idx, column=1, value=r["id"])
        ws2.cell(row=row_idx, column=2, value=str(r["scheduled_at"] or ""))
        ws2.cell(row=row_idx, column=3, value=str(r["service_name"] or ""))
        ws2.cell(row=row_idx, column=4, value=str(r["doctor"] or "—"))
        ws2.cell(row=row_idx, column=5, value=status_map.get(r["status"], r["status"]))
        amt = r["actual_amount"]
        ws2.cell(row=row_idx, column=6, value=int(amt) if amt is not None else None)
        ws2.cell(row=row_idx, column=7, value=str(r["payment_method"] or ""))
        ws2.cell(row=row_idx, column=8, value=r["slots_count"] or 1)
        ws2.cell(row=row_idx, column=9, value="да" if r["done_auto"] else "")
        for col in range(1, 10):
            cc = ws2.cell(row=row_idx, column=col)
            cc.font = value_font
            cc.border = border_thin
            if i % 2 == 1:
                cc.fill = zebra_fill
        ws2.cell(row=row_idx, column=6).alignment = Alignment(horizontal="right")
        ws2.cell(row=row_idx, column=1).alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center")
        ws2.cell(row=row_idx, column=8).alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center")
        ws2.row_dimensions[row_idx].outlineLevel = indent_level
        ws2.row_dimensions[row_idx].hidden = False

    row = 3
    visit_counter = 0
    grand_total = 0

    for sname in sorted(tree_service.keys(), key=lambda s: (-len(tree_service[s]), s)):
        by_spec = tree_service[sname]
        all_visits = [v for sp in by_spec.values() for st in sp.values() for v in st]
        service_amount = _group_amount(all_visits)
        service_count = len(all_visits)
        grand_total += service_amount
        _write_group_header(row, 0, f"📂 {sname} · {service_count} визит(ов)", service_amount)
        row += 1

        for dname in sorted(by_spec.keys(), key=lambda d: (-len(by_spec[d]), d)):
            by_status = by_spec[dname]
            spec_visits = [v for st in by_status.values() for v in st]
            spec_amount = _group_amount(spec_visits)
            spec_count = len(spec_visits)
            _write_group_header(row, 1, f"👤 {dname} · {spec_count} визит(ов)", spec_amount)
            row += 1

            for st in sorted(by_status.keys()):
                visits = by_status[st]
                st_amount = _group_amount(visits)
                st_count = len(visits)
                _write_group_header(row, 2, f"● {st} · {st_count}", st_amount)
                row += 1

                for v in visits:
                    _write_visit_row(row, v, visit_counter, indent_level=3)
                    visit_counter += 1
                    row += 1

    if data["history"]:
        sum_row = row
        ws2.merge_cells(start_row=sum_row, start_column=1, end_row=sum_row, end_column=8)
        total_cell = ws2.cell(row=sum_row, column=1, value="Итого выручка (по завершённым визитам)")
        total_cell.font = total_font
        total_cell.fill = total_fill
        total_cell.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="right", vertical="center")
        total_amt = ws2.cell(row=sum_row, column=9, value=grand_total)
        total_amt.font = total_font
        total_amt.fill = total_fill
        total_amt.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="right")
        total_amt.number_format = '#,##0 "₽"'
        for col in range(1, 10):
            ws2.cell(row=sum_row, column=col).border = Border(
                left=thick, right=thick, top=thick, bottom=thick,
            )

    col_widths = [6, 20, 30, 22, 15, 14, 15, 8, 6]
    for i, w in enumerate(col_widths, start=1):
        ws2.column_dimensions[get_column_letter(i)].width = w

    last_row = row
    ws2.print_area = f"A1:I{last_row}"
    ws2.page_setup.orientation = "landscape"
    ws2.page_setup.fitToWidth = 1
    ws2.page_setup.fitToHeight = 0
    ws2.sheet_properties.pageSetUpPr = PageSetupProperties(fitToPage=True)
    ws2.page_margins = PageMargins(left=0.3, right=0.3, top=0.5, bottom=0.5)
    ws2.print_title_rows = "2:2"
    ws2.oddHeader.center.text = f"История визитов · {fio}"
    ws2.oddHeader.center.size = 10
    ws2.oddHeader.center.font = "Calibri,Bold"
    ws2.oddFooter.center.text = "Стр. &P из &N"
    ws2.oddFooter.center.size = 8

    out = BytesIO()
    wb.save(out)
    return out.getvalue()


def build_client_export_pdf(data, client, for_client=False):
    import os
    from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import A4
    from reportlab.lib import colors
    from reportlab.lib.styles import ParagraphStyle
    from reportlab.lib.units import mm
    from reportlab.pdfbase import pdfmetrics
    from reportlab.pdfbase.ttfonts import TTFont
    from reportlab.platypus import SimpleDocTemplate, Table, TableStyle, Paragraph, Spacer

    font_name = "Helvetica"
    bold_name = "Helvetica-Bold"
    for reg, bold, p_reg, p_bold in (
        ("CustomFont", "CustomFont-Bold",
         "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf",
         "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf"),
        ("CustomFont", "CustomFont-Bold",
         "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/liberation/LiberationSans-Regular.ttf",
         "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/liberation/LiberationSans-Bold.ttf"),
    ):
        if os.path.exists(p_reg):
            try:
                pdfmetrics.registerFont(TTFont(reg, p_reg))
                font_name = reg
                if os.path.exists(p_bold):
                    pdfmetrics.registerFont(TTFont(bold, p_bold))
                    bold_name = bold
                    try:
                        pdfmetrics.registerFontFamily(
                            reg, normal=reg, bold=bold, italic=reg, boldItalic=bold,
                        )
                    except Exception:
                        pass
                break
            except Exception:
                pass

    buf = BytesIO()
    doc = SimpleDocTemplate(buf, pagesize=A4, leftMargin=15*mm, rightMargin=15*mm,
                            topMargin=15*mm, bottomMargin=15*mm,
                            title="Ваши визиты" if for_client else "Карточка клиента")

    title_style = ParagraphStyle("title", fontName=bold_name, fontSize=18, leading=22,
                                 textColor=colors.HexColor("#2E5F8A"))
    name_style = ParagraphStyle("name", fontName=bold_name, fontSize=14, leading=18,
                                 textColor=colors.HexColor("#1F2D3A"))
    section_style = ParagraphStyle("section", fontName=bold_name, fontSize=12, leading=15,
                                   textColor=colors.HexColor("#2E5F8A"), spaceBefore=10, spaceAfter=6)
    normal = ParagraphStyle("n", fontName=font_name, fontSize=9.5, leading=12)
    small = ParagraphStyle("s", fontName=font_name, fontSize=8.5, leading=11,
                          textColor=colors.HexColor("#555555"))
    bold_small = ParagraphStyle("bs", fontName=bold_name, fontSize=8.5, leading=11)
    bold_normal = ParagraphStyle("bn", fontName=bold_name, fontSize=9.5, leading=12)

    fio = " ".join(p for p in [client["last_name"], client["first_name"], client["middle_name"]] if p).strip() or str(client["user_id"])
    org_name = data.get("org_name") or ""

    elements = []

    if for_client:
        header_title = "Ваши визиты"
        header_subtitle = org_name
    else:
        header_title = "Карточка клиента"
        header_subtitle = fio

    header_table = Table(
        [[Paragraph(header_title, title_style)],
         [Paragraph(header_subtitle, name_style) if header_subtitle else Paragraph("&nbsp;", normal)]],
        colWidths=[180*mm],
    )
    header_table.setStyle(TableStyle([
        ("BACKGROUND", (0, 0), (-1, -1), colors.HexColor("#E3F0FB")),
        ("LEFTPADDING", (0, 0), (-1, -1), 12),
        ("RIGHTPADDING", (0, 0), (-1, -1), 12),
        ("TOPPADDING", (0, 0), (0, 0), 10),
        ("BOTTOMPADDING", (0, 0), (0, 0), 2),
        ("TOPPADDING", (0, 1), (-1, 1), 2),
        ("BOTTOMPADDING", (0, 1), (-1, 1), 10),
        ("LINEBELOW", (0, 1), (-1, 1), 0.8, colors.HexColor("#B8D4EF")),
    ]))
    elements.append(header_table)
    elements.append(Spacer(1, 10))

    gender_label = "—"
    if client["gender"] == "male":
        gender_label = "Мужской"
    elif client["gender"] == "female":
        gender_label = "Женский"

    _agg = data.get("aggregates")
    agg = dict(_agg) if _agg else {}
    visits_done = agg.get("visits_done") or 0
    visits_no_show = agg.get("visits_no_show") or 0
    total_revenue = agg.get("total_revenue") or 0
    last_done = agg.get("last_done_at") or "—"

    if for_client:
        profile_rows = [
            [Paragraph("ФИО:", bold_normal), Paragraph(fio, normal),
             Paragraph("Телефон:", bold_normal), Paragraph(client["phone"] or "—", normal)],
            [Paragraph("Дата рождения:", bold_normal), Paragraph(client["birth_date"] or "—", normal),
             Paragraph("Пол:", bold_normal), Paragraph(gender_label, normal)],
            [Paragraph("Любимый специалист:", bold_normal), Paragraph(data.get("favorite_doctor_name") or "—", normal),
             Paragraph("Последний визит:", bold_normal), Paragraph(str(last_done), normal)],
            [Paragraph("Всего визитов:", bold_normal), Paragraph(str(visits_done), normal),
             Paragraph("Общая выручка:", bold_normal), Paragraph(f"{total_revenue} ₽", normal)],
        ]
    else:
        consent = "не дано"
        if client["consent_152fz"]:
            consent = f"да ({client['consent_given_at'] or ''})"
        profile_rows = [
            [Paragraph("Телефон:", bold_normal), Paragraph(client["phone"] or "—", normal),
             Paragraph("Дата рождения:", bold_normal), Paragraph(client["birth_date"] or "—", normal)],

"""Отправка уведомлений администраторам организации или суперадмину.

Идёт через core.messaging.send_to_client — единую точку отправки.
После E4 будет работать и с VK, если админ там.
"""
import logging

from core.messaging import send_to_client
from storage.db import list_admins, admins_of_org
import config

log = logging.getLogger(__name__)


async def notify_admins(text: str, org_id=None, buttons=None):
    """Если org_id задан — шлём админам этой организации.
    Если нет — всем админам + суперадмину.
    buttons — inline-кнопки (список рядов), прикрепляются к сообщению.
    """
    recipients = set()
    if org_id is not None:
        recipients.update(admins_of_org(org_id))
    else:
        for r in list_admins():
            recipients.add(r["user_id"])
    if config.SUPERADMIN_ID:
        recipients.add(str(config.SUPERADMIN_ID))

    for r in recipients:
        status, err = await send_to_client(r, text, buttons=buttons, fmt=None)
        if status not in ("sent", "no_max"):
            log.warning("notify_admins failed for %s: status=%s err=%s", r, status, err)

"""Отправка подтверждений записи с .ics-вложением (файл для календаря)."""
import logging

from core.channels.base import UserBlocked
from core.messaging import (
    send_to_client_with_file_raw, send_to_client_raw, upload_file_for_client,
)
from core.ics import build_ics
from storage.db import get_service

log = logging.getLogger(__name__)


async def send_confirmation_with_ics(
    user_id, text, request_id, org_id, service_id,
    service_name, scheduled_at, address="", doctor="", prep="",
):
    """Отправляет сообщение с .ics-вложением.
    Возвращает (status, error), где status: "sent" | "blocked" | "error" | "no_max".
    При ошибке .ics — fallback на обычный текст.
    """
    if not user_id or str(user_id).startswith("phone:"):
        return "no_max", None

    try:
        duration_min = 30
        svc = get_service(service_id) if service_id else None
        if svc:
            try:
                duration_min = svc["duration_min"] or 30
            except (IndexError, KeyError):
                duration_min = 30
            try:
                if not prep:
                    prep = svc["prep"] or ""
            except (IndexError, KeyError):
                pass

        ics_text = build_ics(
            request_id=request_id, org_id=org_id, service_name=service_name,
            scheduled_at=scheduled_at, duration_min=duration_min,
            address=address or "", doctor=doctor or "", prep=prep or "",
        )
        log.info("Sending ics for #%s to %s", request_id, user_id)
        file_token = await upload_file_for_client(
            user_id, ics_text, filename=f"booking-{request_id}.ics",
            mime="text/calendar",
        )
        await send_to_client_with_file_raw(int(user_id), text, file_token, fmt="markdown")
        log.info("ICS sent for #%s", request_id)
        return "sent", None
    except UserBlocked:
        log.info("User %s blocked bot (#%s)", user_id, request_id)
        return "blocked", None
    except Exception as e:
        log.warning("Не удалось отправить .ics для #%s: %s, fallback на текст", request_id, e)

    try:
        await send_to_client_raw(int(user_id), text, fmt="markdown")
        return "sent", None
    except UserBlocked:
        return "blocked", None
    except Exception as e2:
        return "error", str(e2)[:200]

"""Единая точка отправки сообщений клиенту.

Сейчас работает через реестр core.channels (реализован только MAX).
После E4 будет работать и с VK — без изменений в вызывающем коде.

Два уровня API:
- send_to_client(user_id, ...) → (status, error) — не бросает, для «отправить и забыть».
  status: "sent" | "blocked" | "no_max" | "error".
  "no_max" исторически значит «у клиента нет канала» (phone-only клиент).
  Строку не меняем: на ней завязан фронт (CreateRequestModal, ClientMessageModal).

Дублирование: duplicate=True (или organizations.settings.channel_duplicate)
отправляет сообщение во ВСЕ каналы клиента, а не только в основной.

- send_to_client_raw(user_id, ...) → dict — бросает UserBlocked / ChannelError,
  для случаев, когда важен результат (рассылки, .ics, отчёты, retry).

Оба идут через get_channel_for_client — выбор канала по identity клиента.
"""
import logging

from core.channels.base import UserBlocked, ChannelError
from core.channels.registry import get_channel_for_client, get_channels_for_client

log = logging.getLogger(__name__)


def _should_duplicate(duplicate, org_id=None) -> bool:
    """Дублировать ли отправку во все каналы клиента.

    duplicate=None → берём organizations.settings.channel_duplicate.
    """
    if duplicate is not None:
        return bool(duplicate)
    if org_id is None:
        return False
    try:
        import storage.db as db

        return bool((db.get_org_settings(int(org_id)) or {}).get("channel_duplicate"))
    except Exception:
        return False


async def send_to_client(user_id, text, buttons=None, fmt="markdown",
                         org_id=None, duplicate=None):
    """Отправляет сообщение клиенту. Возвращает (status, error).

    status: "sent" | "blocked" | "no_max" | "error"
    Никогда не бросает.

    channel_duplicate=True (или настройка организации) — шлём во все каналы
    клиента. Статус "sent", если дошло хотя бы в один.
    """
    uid_str = str(user_id or "")
    if not uid_str or uid_str.startswith("phone:"):
        return "no_max", None

    if _should_duplicate(duplicate, org_id):
        targets = get_channels_for_client(uid_str, org_id)
        if not targets:
            return "no_max", None
        last_status, last_err = "error", "all channels failed"
        sent_any = False
        for channel, platform_uid, platform in targets:
            try:
                await channel.send_message(platform_uid, text, buttons=buttons, fmt=fmt)
                sent_any = True
            except UserBlocked:
                last_status, last_err = "blocked", None
            except ChannelError as e:
                last_status, last_err = "error", str(e)[:200]
            except Exception as e:
                last_status, last_err = "error", str(e)[:200]
            else:
                last_status, last_err = "sent", None
            if not sent_any and last_status == "error":
                log.warning("send_to_client (%s) failed for %s: %s",
                            platform, uid_str, last_err)
        return ("sent", None) if sent_any else (last_status, last_err)

    channel, platform_uid, _platform = get_channel_for_client(uid_str, org_id)
    if channel is None:
        return "no_max", None
    try:
        await channel.send_message(platform_uid, text, buttons=buttons, fmt=fmt)
        return "sent", None
    except UserBlocked:
        return "blocked", None
    except ChannelError as e:
        log.warning("send_to_client failed for %s: %s", uid_str, e)
        return "error", str(e)[:200]
    except Exception as e:
        log.warning("send_to_client unexpected error for %s: %s", uid_str, e)
        return "error", str(e)[:200]


async def send_to_client_raw(user_id, text, buttons=None, fmt="markdown"):
    """Отправляет сообщение клиенту. Возвращает dict (ответ API) или бросает.

    Бросает UserBlocked — клиент заблокировал бота.
    Бросает ChannelError — прочие ошибки.
    Используется там, где нужен результат / retry (рассылки, .ics, отчёты).
    """
    uid_str = str(user_id or "")
    if not uid_str or uid_str.startswith("phone:"):
        raise ChannelError("no channel for user")

    channel, platform_uid, _platform = get_channel_for_client(uid_str)
    if channel is None:
        raise ChannelError("no channel for user")
    return await channel.send_message(platform_uid, text, buttons=buttons, fmt=fmt)


async def send_to_client_with_image_raw(user_id, text, image_token, buttons=None, fmt="markdown"):
    """Сообщение с картинкой. Возвращает dict или бросает. Для рассылок."""
    uid_str = str(user_id or "")
    if not uid_str or uid_str.startswith("phone:"):
        raise ChannelError("no channel for user")
    channel, platform_uid, _platform = get_channel_for_client(uid_str)
    if channel is None:
        raise ChannelError("no channel for user")
    return await channel.send_with_image(platform_uid, text, image_token, buttons=buttons, fmt=fmt)


async def send_to_client_with_file_raw(user_id, text, file_token, buttons=None, fmt="markdown"):
    """Сообщение с файлом. Возвращает dict или бросает. Для .ics/экспортов."""
    uid_str = str(user_id or "")
    if not uid_str or uid_str.startswith("phone:"):
        raise ChannelError("no channel for user")
    channel, platform_uid, _platform = get_channel_for_client(uid_str)
    if channel is None:
        raise ChannelError("no channel for user")
    return await channel.send_with_file(platform_uid, text, file_token, buttons=buttons, fmt=fmt)


async def edit_message_for_client(user_id, message_id, text, buttons=None, fmt="markdown"):
    """Редактирует сообщение. Возвращает dict | None. Не бросает."""
    uid_str = str(user_id or "")
    if not uid_str:
        return None
    channel, platform_uid, _platform = get_channel_for_client(uid_str)
    if channel is None:
        return None
    try:
        return await channel.edit_message(platform_uid, message_id, text, buttons=buttons, fmt=fmt)
    except Exception as e:
        log.warning("edit_message_for_client failed for %s/%s: %s", uid_str, message_id, e)
        return None


async def delete_message_for_client(user_id, message_id):
    """Удаляет сообщение. Возвращает dict | None. Не бросает."""
    uid_str = str(user_id or "")
    if not uid_str:
        return None
    channel, platform_uid, _platform = get_channel_for_client(uid_str)
    if channel is None:
        return None
    try:
        return await channel.delete_message(platform_uid, message_id)
    except Exception as e:
        log.warning("delete_message_for_client failed for %s/%s: %s", uid_str, message_id, e)
        return None


async def upload_file_for_client(user_id, content, filename: str,
                                 mime: str = "text/calendar",
                                 upload_type: str = "file") -> str:
    """Загружает файл в канал клиента. Возвращает token или бросает ChannelError.

    Используется для .ics, экспортов, вложений. Канал выбирается по identity
    клиента — после E4 автоматически уйдёт в VK, если клиент там.
    """
    uid_str = str(user_id or "")
    if not uid_str or uid_str.startswith("phone:"):
        raise ChannelError("no channel for user")
    channel, _platform_uid, _platform = get_channel_for_client(uid_str)
    if channel is None:
        raise ChannelError("no channel for user")
    return await channel.upload_file(
        content, filename=filename, mime=mime, upload_type=upload_type,
    )

"""Шлюз расписания.

        raise NotImplementedError

    def get_slots(self, org_id, date):
        raise NotImplementedError

    def book(self, slot_id, request_id=None):
        raise NotImplementedError

    def release(self, slot_id):
        raise NotImplementedError

    def release(self, slot_id):
        return db.release_slot(slot_id)


def get_gateway() -> ScheduleGateway:
    import config
    # Заглушка: пока всегда SQLite. Позже — выбор по config.SCHEDULE_SOURCE.
    return SQLiteScheduleGateway()

"""Генерация .ics-файлов для добавления записи в календарь (RFC 5545)."""
from datetime import datetime, timezone, timedelta
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo

from storage.db import get_org_timezone


def _escape(value: str) -> str:
    """Экранирование строк по RFC 5545."""
    if not value:
        return ""
    return (
        str(value)
        .replace("\\", "\\\\")
        .replace(";", "\\;")
        .replace(",", "\\,")
        .replace("\r\n", "\\n")
        .replace("\n", "\\n")
        .replace("\r", "\\n")
    )


def _to_utc(date_str: str, time_str: str, tz_name: str):
    """local (naive) -> aware UTC."""
    try:
        local_dt = datetime.strptime(f"{date_str} {time_str}", "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")
    except Exception:
        return None
    try:
        tz = ZoneInfo(tz_name)
    except Exception:
        tz = timezone.utc
    return local_dt.replace(tzinfo=tz).astimezone(timezone.utc)


def _fmt_dt(dt: datetime) -> str:
    return dt.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")


def build_ics(
    request_id: int,
    org_id: int,
    service_name: str,
    scheduled_at: str,
    duration_min: int,
    address: str = "",
    doctor: str = "",
    prep: str = "",
    uid_domain: str = "boroda-bot.ru",
) -> str:
    """Возвращает текст .ics-файла для заявки.

    scheduled_at — в локальном времени организации, формат "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM".
    duration_min — длительность услуги в минутах (минимум 30).
    """
    if not scheduled_at or len(scheduled_at) < 16:
        raise ValueError("Некорректный scheduled_at")

    date_str = scheduled_at[:10]
    time_str = scheduled_at[11:16]

    tz_name = get_org_timezone(org_id)
    start_utc = _to_utc(date_str, time_str, tz_name)
    if start_utc is None:
        raise ValueError("Некорректная дата/время")

    if not duration_min or duration_min < 5:
        duration_min = 30
    end_utc = start_utc + timedelta(minutes=duration_min)

    dtstamp = datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")

    summary = service_name or "Приём"
    description_parts = []
    if doctor:
        description_parts.append(f"Специалист: {doctor}")
    if prep:
        description_parts.append(f"Подготовка: {prep}")
    description = "\n".join(description_parts)

    lines = [
        "BEGIN:VCALENDAR",
        "VERSION:2.0",
        "PRODID:-//MAX Booking Bot//RU",
        "CALSCALE:GREGORIAN",
        "METHOD:PUBLISH",
        "BEGIN:VEVENT",
        f"UID:booking-{request_id}@{uid_domain}",
        f"DTSTAMP:{dtstamp}",
        f"DTSTART:{_fmt_dt(start_utc)}",
        f"DTEND:{_fmt_dt(end_utc)}",
        f"SUMMARY:{_escape(summary)}",
    ]
    if address:
        lines.append(f"LOCATION:{_escape(address)}")
    if description:
        lines.append(f"DESCRIPTION:{_escape(description)}")
    lines.append("STATUS:CONFIRMED")
    lines.append("BEGIN:VALARM")
    lines.append("TRIGGER:-PT1H")
    lines.append("ACTION:DISPLAY")
    lines.append(f"DESCRIPTION:{_escape(summary)}")
    lines.append("END:VALARM")
    lines.append("END:VEVENT")
    lines.append("END:VCALENDAR")

    return "\r\n".join(lines) + "\r\n"

ФАЙЛ: core/uploads.py  (2412 байт)

"""Утилиты для загружаемых файлов: ресайз и компрессия изображений.

Вынесено из app.py, т.к. используется в нескольких местах
(фото клиентов, фото специалистов, вложения в сообщения, рассылки).
"""
from io import BytesIO

import config


def _process_upload_image(content: bytes, mime_type: str) -> tuple[bytes, str, str]:
    """Ресайз + компрессия. Возвращает (content, mime_type, ext).
    При ошибке — возвращает оригинал без изменений.

    - GIF — без изменений (не ломаем анимацию).
    - Если размер ≤ 1600 px и файл < 1.5 MB — без изменений.
    - Иначе ресайз до 1600 px. Прозрачность → PNG, всё остальное → JPEG q=85.
    """
    from PIL import Image, ImageOps

    if mime_type == "image/gif":
        return content, mime_type, "gif"

    try:
        img = Image.open(BytesIO(content))
        img = ImageOps.exif_transpose(img)
    except Exception:
        ext = "jpg"
        if mime_type == "image/png":
            ext = "png"
        elif mime_type == "image/webp":
            ext = "webp"
        return content, mime_type, ext

    max_dim = config.UPLOAD_MAX_DIMENSION
    quality = config.UPLOAD_JPEG_QUALITY
    original_size = len(content)

    need_resize = img.width > max_dim or img.height > max_dim
    need_process = need_resize or original_size > 1_500_000

    if not need_process:
        ext = "jpg"
        if mime_type == "image/png":
            ext = "png"
        elif mime_type == "image/webp":
            ext = "webp"
        return content, mime_type, ext

    if need_resize:
        img.thumbnail((max_dim, max_dim), Image.LANCZOS)

    has_alpha = img.mode in ("RGBA", "LA") or (
        img.mode == "P" and "transparency" in img.info
    )

    out = BytesIO()
    if has_alpha:
        if img.mode == "P":
            img = img.convert("RGBA")
        img.save(out, format="PNG", optimize=True)
        return out.getvalue(), "image/png", "png"
    else:
        if img.mode != "RGB":
            img = img.convert("RGB")
        img.save(out, format="JPEG", quality=quality, optimize=True)
        return out.getvalue(), "image/jpeg", "jpg"

# ==================== refresh image token ====================

async def refresh_image_token(upload_id, channel=None):
    """Перезагружает файл с диска в канал, обновляет token в БД.
    Возвращает новый token для канала или None, если файла нет.

    channel=None — легаси-ветка с MAX (когда канал клиента неизвестен).
    token в uploaded_images хранится в паспорте MAX, поэтому для VK
    вернём свежий token, но в БД его не пишем."""
    img = get_uploaded_image_by_id(upload_id)
    if not img:
        return None
    file_path = img["file_path"]
    if not file_path:
        log.warning("refresh_image_token: file_path is NULL for upload_id=%s", upload_id)
        return None
    abs_path = os.path.join(config.UPLOADS_DIR, file_path)
    if not os.path.exists(abs_path):
        log.warning("refresh_image_token: file not found at %s", abs_path)
        return None
    try:
        with open(abs_path, "rb") as f:
            content = f.read()
    except Exception as e:
        log.error("refresh_image_token: read error %s", e)
        return None
    filename = img["original_filename"] or "image.jpg"
    mime = img["mime_type"] or "image/jpeg"
    if channel is not None:
        try:
            new_token = await channel.upload_file(
                content, filename=filename, mime=mime, upload_type="image",
            )
            if getattr(channel, "platform", "") == "max":
                update_uploaded_image_token(upload_id, new_token)
            log.info("refresh_image_token: upload_id=%s platform=%s token=%s",
                     upload_id, getattr(channel, "platform", "?"), new_token[:12])
            return new_token
        except Exception as e:
            log.error("refresh_image_token: upload to %s failed %s",
                      getattr(channel, "platform", "?"), e)
            return None
    try:
        new_token = await mx.upload_file(
            content,
            filename=filename,
            mime=mime,
            upload_type="image",
        )
        update_uploaded_image_token(upload_id, new_token)
        log.info("refresh_image_token: upload_id=%s (max) new_token=%s",
                 upload_id, new_token[:12])
        return new_token
    except Exception as e:
        log.error("refresh_image_token: upload failed %s", e)
        return None


async def _send_with_refresh(user_id, text, image_id, buttons=None, fmt="markdown",
                            org_id=None):
    """Отправляет сообщение с картинкой через канал клиента (не MAX напрямую).

    Токен в uploaded_images принадлежит MAX, поэтому:
    - канал MAX → пробуем сохранённый token, при ошибке перезаливаем и сохраняем;
    - другой канал → сразу перезаливаем в него (токен платформо-зависим).

    Бросает UserBlocked — клиент заблокировал бота.
    Бросает ChannelError — отправить не удалось (в т.ч. у клиента нет канала).
    """
    uid_str = str(user_id or "")
    channel, platform_uid, platform = get_channel_for_client(uid_str, org_id)
    if channel is None:
        raise ChannelError("no channel for user")

    img = get_uploaded_image_by_id(image_id) if image_id else None
    token = img["token"] if img else None

    if token and platform == "max":
        try:
            await channel.send_with_image(platform_uid, text, token,
                                          buttons=buttons, fmt=fmt)
            return
        except UserBlocked:
            raise
        except Exception as e:
            log.warning("send_with_image failed (upload_id=%s, err=%s), refreshing…",
                        image_id, e)

    new_token = await refresh_image_token(image_id, channel) if image_id else None
    if not new_token:
        raise ChannelError(f"Cannot send image: upload_id={image_id} refresh failed")

    await channel.send_with_image(platform_uid, text, new_token,
                                  buttons=buttons, fmt=fmt)


# ==================== РУЧНЫЕ РАССЫЛКИ ====================

def get_clients_for_segment(org_id: int, segment: dict) -> list[str]:
    segment = segment or {}
    activity = segment.get("activity", "all")
    gender = segment.get("gender", "all")
    birthday_days = segment.get("birthday_within_days")

    service_ids = segment.get("service_ids")
    if not service_ids:
        single = segment.get("service_id")
        if single:
            service_ids = [single]
    service_ids = service_ids or []

    # Пороги «под риском / потерянные» — из настроек организации
    from storage.db import get_org_settings
    settings = get_org_settings(org_id)
    at_risk_days = int(settings.get("client_at_risk_days", 30) or 30)
    inactive_days = int(settings.get("client_inactive_days", 90) or 90)

    conn = db()
    cur = conn.cursor()

    base_q = (
        "SELECT DISTINCT c.user_id AS user_id FROM clients c "
        "LEFT JOIN history h ON h.user_id = c.user_id AND h.org_id = ? "
        "WHERE (c.org_id = ? OR h.id IS NOT NULL) "
        "  AND (c.marketing_opt_out IS NULL OR c.marketing_opt_out = 0) "
        # phone:... — клиент без канала (запись от админа по телефону).
        # Слать некуда, в рассылку не берём.
        "  AND c.user_id NOT LIKE 'phone:%' "
    )
    params = [org_id, org_id]

    now = datetime.now()
    if activity == "active_recent":
        cutoff = (now - timedelta(days=at_risk_days)).strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")
        base_q += "AND c.last_visit_at >= ? "
        params.append(cutoff)
    elif activity == "at_risk":
        cutoff_lost = (now - timedelta(days=inactive_days)).strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")
        cutoff_risk = (now - timedelta(days=at_risk_days)).strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")
        base_q += "AND c.last_visit_at >= ? AND c.last_visit_at < ? "
        params.append(cutoff_lost)
        params.append(cutoff_risk)
    elif activity == "lost":
        cutoff = (now - timedelta(days=inactive_days)).strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")
        base_q += "AND c.last_visit_at < ? "
        params.append(cutoff)
    elif activity == "never":
        base_q += "AND c.last_visit_at IS NULL "
    elif activity.startswith("active_"):
        days = int(activity.split("_")[1])
        cutoff = (now - timedelta(days=days)).strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")
        base_q += "AND c.last_visit_at >= ? "
        params.append(cutoff)
    elif activity.startswith("inactive_"):
        days = int(activity.split("_")[1])
        cutoff = (now - timedelta(days=days)).strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")
        base_q += "AND (c.last_visit_at IS NULL OR c.last_visit_at < ?) "
        params.append(cutoff)

    if gender in ("male", "female"):
        base_q += "AND c.gender = ? "
        params.append(gender)

    if service_ids:
        placeholders = ",".join("?" * len(service_ids))
        base_q += (
            f"AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM history h2 "
            f"WHERE h2.user_id = c.user_id AND h2.org_id = ? "
            f"AND (h2.service_id IN ({placeholders}) "
            f"OR h2.service_name IN (SELECT name FROM services WHERE id IN ({placeholders})))) "
        )
        params.append(org_id)
        params.extend(service_ids)
        params.extend(service_ids)

    cur.execute(base_q, params)
    all_rows = cur.fetchall()
    conn.close()

    user_ids = [r["user_id"] for r in all_rows]

    if birthday_days:
        conn = db()
        placeholders = ",".join("?" * len(user_ids)) if user_ids else "''"
        rows = conn.execute(
            f"SELECT user_id, birth_date FROM clients WHERE user_id IN ({placeholders})",
            user_ids,
        ).fetchall()
        conn.close()

        today = datetime.now().date()
        result = []
        for r in rows:
            uid = r["user_id"]
            bd = r["birth_date"]
            if not bd:
                continue
            try:
                bd_date = datetime.strptime(bd, "%Y-%m-%d").date()
            except Exception:
                continue
            bd_this_year = bd_date.replace(year=today.year)
            if bd_this_year < today:
                bd_this_year = bd_date.replace(year=today.year + 1)
            days_until = (bd_this_year - today).days
            if 0 <= days_until <= birthday_days:
                result.append(uid)
        user_ids = result

    return user_ids


def create_broadcast(org_id, text, segment, created_by=None,
                     image_id=None, scheduled_at=None, status="draft"):
    conn = db()
    cur = conn.execute(
        "INSERT INTO broadcasts "
        "(org_id, text, segment_json, status, image_id, scheduled_at, "
        " created_by, created_at) "
        "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
        (org_id, text, json.dumps(segment or {}, ensure_ascii=False),
         status, image_id, scheduled_at,
         str(created_by) if created_by else None,
         datetime.now().isoformat()),
    )
    bid = cur.lastrowid
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()
    return bid


def get_broadcast(bid):
    conn = db()
    row = conn.execute(
        "SELECT id, org_id, text, segment_json, status, total_recipients, "
        "       sent_count, failed_count, image_id, scheduled_at, created_by, "
        "       created_at, started_at, finished_at "
        "FROM broadcasts WHERE id=?",
        (bid,),
    ).fetchone()
    conn.close()
    return row


def list_broadcasts(org_id, limit=50):
    conn = db()
    rows = conn.execute(
        "SELECT id, text, status, total_recipients, sent_count, failed_count, "
        "       created_at, started_at, finished_at, image_id, scheduled_at "
        "FROM broadcasts WHERE org_id=? "
        "ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT ?",
        (org_id, limit),
    ).fetchall()
    conn.close()
    return rows


def start_broadcast(bid, total_recipients):
    conn = db()
    conn.execute(
        "UPDATE broadcasts SET status='sending', total_recipients=?, started_at=? "
        "WHERE id=? AND status IN ('draft', 'scheduled')",
        (total_recipients, datetime.now().isoformat(), bid),
    )
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()


def cancel_broadcast(bid):
    conn = db()
    conn.execute(
        "UPDATE broadcasts SET status='cancelled', finished_at=? "
        "WHERE id=? AND status IN ('draft', 'scheduled', 'sending')",
        (datetime.now().isoformat(), bid),
    )
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()


def delete_broadcast(bid):
    conn = db()
    conn.execute("DELETE FROM broadcast_sends WHERE broadcast_id=?", (bid,))
    conn.execute("DELETE FROM broadcasts WHERE id=?", (bid,))
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()


def get_pending_broadcasts():
    conn = db()
    rows = conn.execute(
        "SELECT id, org_id, text, segment_json, total_recipients, sent_count, "
        "       failed_count, image_id "
        "FROM broadcasts WHERE status='sending'"
    ).fetchall()
    conn.close()
    return rows


def get_next_pending_send(broadcast_id):
    conn = db()
    row = conn.execute(
        "SELECT id, user_id FROM broadcast_sends "
        "WHERE broadcast_id=? AND status='pending' "
        "ORDER BY id LIMIT 1",
        (broadcast_id,),
    ).fetchone()
    conn.close()
    return row


def mark_send(broadcast_id, user_id, status, error=None):
    conn = db()
    conn.execute(
        "UPDATE broadcast_sends SET status=?, error=?, sent_at=? "
        "WHERE broadcast_id=? AND user_id=?",
        (status, error, datetime.now().isoformat(), broadcast_id, user_id),
    )
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()

    conn = db()
    if status == "sent":
        conn.execute(
            "UPDATE broadcasts SET sent_count = sent_count + 1 WHERE id=?",
            (broadcast_id,),
        )
    elif status in ("failed", "skipped"):
        # skipped = у клиента нет живого канала. В прогресс он не идёт,
        # поэтому считаем его как недоставку — иначе полоса застынет на 99%.
        conn.execute(
            "UPDATE broadcasts SET failed_count = failed_count + 1 WHERE id=?",
            (broadcast_id,),
        )
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()


def finalize_broadcast_if_done(broadcast_id):
    conn = db()
    row = conn.execute(
        "SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM broadcast_sends "
        "WHERE broadcast_id=? AND status='pending'",
        (broadcast_id,),
    ).fetchone()
    if row and row["n"] == 0:
        conn.execute(
            "UPDATE broadcasts SET status='sent', finished_at=? WHERE id=?",
            (datetime.now().isoformat(), broadcast_id),
        )
        conn.commit()
        log.info("Broadcast #%s finished", broadcast_id)
    conn.close()


def prepare_broadcast_sends(bid, user_ids):
    conn = db()
    for uid in user_ids:
        conn.execute(
            "INSERT OR IGNORE INTO broadcast_sends (broadcast_id, user_id, status) "
            "VALUES (?, ?, 'pending')",
            (bid, str(uid)),
        )
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()


def get_broadcast_sends(bid, limit=200):
    conn = db()
    rows = conn.execute(
        "SELECT user_id, status, error, sent_at FROM broadcast_sends "
        "WHERE broadcast_id=? ORDER BY id LIMIT ?",
        (bid, limit),
    ).fetchall()
    conn.close()
    return rows


def update_broadcast_draft(bid, text, segment, image_id=None):
    conn = db()
    conn.execute(
        "UPDATE broadcasts SET text=?, segment_json=?, image_id=? "
        "WHERE id=? AND status IN ('draft', 'scheduled')",
        (text, json.dumps(segment or {}, ensure_ascii=False), image_id, bid),
    )
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()


def start_draft_broadcast(bid):
    b = get_broadcast(bid)
    if not b:
        return False, "not_found"
    if b["status"] not in ("draft", "scheduled"):
        return False, "not_a_draft"

    segment = json.loads(b["segment_json"] or "{}")
    user_ids = get_clients_for_segment(b["org_id"], segment)
    if not user_ids:
        return False, "empty"

    prepare_broadcast_sends(bid, user_ids)
    start_broadcast(bid, len(user_ids))
    return True, len(user_ids)


def duplicate_broadcast(bid, created_by=None):
    """Создаёт новый draft — копию с тем же текстом, сегментом, картинкой."""
    src = get_broadcast(bid)
    if not src:
        return None
    conn = db()
    cur = conn.execute(
        "INSERT INTO broadcasts "
        "(org_id, text, segment_json, status, image_id, created_by, created_at) "
        "VALUES (?, ?, ?, 'draft', ?, ?, ?)",
        (src["org_id"], src["text"], src["segment_json"], src["image_id"],
         str(created_by) if created_by else None, datetime.now().isoformat()),
    )
    nid = cur.lastrowid
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()
    return nid


# ==================== отправка ====================

async def _check_manual_broadcasts():
    pending = get_pending_broadcasts()
    for b in pending:
        bid = b["id"]
        text = b["text"]
        image_id = b["image_id"]

        while True:
            current = get_broadcast(bid)
            if not current or current["status"] != "sending":
                log.info("Broadcast #%s stopped (status changed)", bid)
                break

            row = get_next_pending_send(bid)
            if not row:
                finalize_broadcast_if_done(bid)
                break

            uid = str(row["user_id"])
            try:
                if image_id:
                    await _send_with_refresh(uid, text, image_id,
                                             buttons=UNSUB_BUTTONS, fmt="markdown",
                                             org_id=b["org_id"])
                else:
                    await send_to_client_raw(uid, text,
                                          buttons=UNSUB_BUTTONS, fmt="markdown")
                mark_send(bid, uid, "sent")
            except UserBlocked:
                mark_send(bid, uid, "sent", error="blocked")
                log.info("Broadcast #%s: user %s blocked bot", bid, uid)
            except ChannelError as e:
                # У клиента нет живого канала (phone-only, запись от админа):
                # это не сбой рассылки — помечаем пропуск, чтобы не копить pending.
                mark_send(bid, uid, "skipped", f"no channel: {str(e)[:150]}")
                log.info("Broadcast #%s: user %s has no channel, skipped", bid, uid)
            except Exception as e:
                mark_send(bid, uid, "failed", str(e)[:200])
                log.warning("Broadcast #%s send to %s failed: %s", bid, uid, e)

            await asyncio.sleep(SEND_DELAY)


async def _check_scheduled_broadcasts():
    """Раз в 60 сек проверяет запланированные рассылки (лёгкий SELECT)."""
    now_iso = datetime.now().isoformat()
    due = get_scheduled_broadcasts_due(now_iso)
    for b in due:
        bid = b["id"]
        ok, result = start_draft_broadcast(bid)
        if ok:
            log.info("Scheduled broadcast #%s started, %d recipients", bid, result)
        else:
            log.warning("Scheduled broadcast #%s failed: %s", bid, result)


# ==================== АВТОМАТИЧЕСКИЕ РАССЫЛКИ ====================

def format_auto_broadcast_text(template, user_id, org_id, request_id=None):
    """Подставляет переменные в текст сценария.

    Переменные:
      {name}         — имя клиента (clients.first_name, или «друг»)
      {service}      — название услуги (из указанной записи или последней done)
      {scheduled_at} — дата и время записи «YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM»
      {address}      — адрес филиала услуги
      {prep}         — подготовка к услуге (services.prep)
    """
    name = "друг"
    service = ""
    scheduled_at = ""
    address = ""
    prep = ""

    client = get_client(user_id)
    if client and client["first_name"]:
        first = (client["first_name"] or "").strip()
        if first:
            name = first

    req = None
    if request_id:
        req = get_request(request_id)
    else:
        conn = db()
        req = conn.execute(
            "SELECT id, service_id, service_name, scheduled_at, branch_id "
            "FROM history WHERE user_id=? AND org_id=? AND status='done' "
            "ORDER BY scheduled_at DESC LIMIT 1",
            (str(user_id), org_id),
        ).fetchone()
        conn.close()

    if req:
        service = req["service_name"] or ""
        scheduled_at = req["scheduled_at"] or ""
        if req["branch_id"]:
            br = get_branch(req["branch_id"])
            if br:
                address = br["address"] or ""
        if req["service_id"]:
            svc = get_service(req["service_id"])
            if svc:
                prep = svc["prep"] or ""

    # {last_visit} и {days_inactive} — из clients.last_visit_at,
    # fallback на дату последнего done-визита.
    last_visit = ""
    if client and client["last_visit_at"]:
        last_visit = client["last_visit_at"]
    elif req:
        last_visit = req["scheduled_at"] or ""

    days_inactive = "—"
    days_since_visit = "—"
    if last_visit:
        try:
            from datetime import datetime as _dt
            lv_date = _dt.strptime(last_visit[:10], "%Y-%m-%d")
            days = (_dt.now() - lv_date).days
            days_inactive = str(days)
            days_since_visit = str(days)
        except Exception:
            pass
    else:
        last_visit = "—"

    replacements = {
        "{name}": name,
        "{service}": service,
        "{scheduled_at}": scheduled_at,
        "{address}": address,
        "{prep}": prep,
        "{last_visit}": last_visit,
        "{days_inactive}": days_inactive,
        "{days_since_visit}": days_since_visit,
    }
    text = template or ""
    for k, v in replacements.items():
        text = text.replace(k, v)
    return text


async def _check_auto_broadcasts():
    conn = db()
    autos = conn.execute(
        "SELECT id, org_id, type, text, image_id, delay_value "
        "FROM auto_broadcasts WHERE active=1"
    ).fetchall()
    conn.close()

    _org_settings_cache = {}

    def _is_quiet(oid):
        if oid not in _org_settings_cache:
            s = get_org_settings(oid) or {}
            _org_settings_cache[oid] = (
                int(s.get('quiet_hours_start', 22) or 0),
                int(s.get('quiet_hours_end', 9) or 0),
            )
        start_h, end_h = _org_settings_cache[oid]
        return _is_quiet_hours(now_for_org(oid), start_h, end_h)

    for a in autos:
        aid = a["id"]
        org_id = a["org_id"]
        atype = a["type"]
        text = a["text"]
        image_id = a["image_id"]
        delay_value = a["delay_value"]

        if _is_quiet(org_id):
            log.debug("Auto broadcast %s skipped: quiet hours (org=%s)", atype, org_id)
            continue

        now = now_for_org(org_id)
        today_date = now.date()

        if atype == "birthday":
            target_date = today_date + timedelta(days=delay_value)
            target_md = target_date.strftime("-%m-%d")

            conn = db()
            clients = conn.execute(
                "SELECT user_id, first_name FROM clients "
                "WHERE org_id=? AND birth_date LIKE ? "
                "  AND (marketing_opt_out IS NULL OR marketing_opt_out = 0)",
                (org_id, f"%{target_md}")
            ).fetchall()
            conn.close()

            for c in clients:
                uid = str(c["user_id"])
                fname = c["first_name"]
                if not uid or uid.startswith("phone:"):
                    continue
                if check_auto_log_birthday(aid, uid):
                    continue

                msg = text.replace("{name}", fname or "друг")
                try:
                    if image_id:
                        await _send_with_refresh(uid, msg, image_id,
                                                 buttons=UNSUB_BUTTONS, fmt="markdown",
                                                 org_id=org_id)
                    else:
                        await send_to_client_raw(uid, msg,
                                              buttons=UNSUB_BUTTONS, fmt="markdown")
                    log_auto_broadcast(aid, uid)
                    log.info("Auto birthday sent to %s", uid)
                    await asyncio.sleep(SEND_DELAY)
                except UserBlocked:
                    log.info("Auto birthday: user %s blocked bot", uid)
                except ChannelError as e:
                    log.info("Auto birthday: user %s has no channel (%s)", uid, e)
                except Exception as e:
                    log.warning("Auto birthday failed for %s: %s", uid, e)

        elif atype == "inactive":
            cutoff = (today_date - timedelta(days=delay_value)).strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
            now_str = now.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")
            conn = db()
            clients = conn.execute(
                "SELECT c.user_id AS user_id, c.first_name AS first_name, "
                "       c.last_visit_at AS last_visit_at "
                "FROM clients c "
                "WHERE c.org_id=? AND (c.last_visit_at IS NULL OR c.last_visit_at < ?) "
                "AND (c.marketing_opt_out IS NULL OR c.marketing_opt_out = 0) "
                "AND NOT EXISTS ("
                "  SELECT 1 FROM history h "
                "  WHERE h.user_id = c.user_id AND h.org_id = ? "
                "  AND h.status IN ('pending', 'confirmed') "
                "  AND h.scheduled_at >= ?"
                ")",
                (org_id, cutoff, org_id, now_str)
            ).fetchall()
            conn.close()

            for c in clients:
                uid = str(c["user_id"])
                fname = c["first_name"]
                lvisit = c["last_visit_at"]
                if not uid or uid.startswith("phone:"):
                    continue
                if check_auto_log_inactive(aid, uid, lvisit):
                    continue

                msg = format_auto_broadcast_text(text, uid, org_id)
                try:
                    if image_id:
                        await _send_with_refresh(uid, msg, image_id,
                                                 buttons=UNSUB_BUTTONS, fmt="markdown",
                                                 org_id=org_id)
                    else:
                        await send_to_client_raw(uid, msg,
                                              buttons=UNSUB_BUTTONS, fmt="markdown")
                    log_auto_broadcast(aid, uid)
                    log.info("Auto inactive sent to %s", uid)
                    await asyncio.sleep(SEND_DELAY)
                except UserBlocked:
                    log.info("Auto inactive: user %s blocked bot", uid)
                except ChannelError as e:
                    log.info("Auto inactive: user %s has no channel (%s)", uid, e)
                except Exception as e:
                    log.warning("Auto inactive failed for %s: %s", uid, e)

        elif atype == "revisit_cycle":
            from datetime import datetime as _dt
            candidates = find_revisit_candidates(org_id)
            bot_username = (config.MINI_APP_BOT_USERNAME or "").strip()

            # Один клиент = максимум одно сообщение. Фильтруем cooldown,
            # берём самую просроченную услугу без недавней отправки.
            by_user = {}
            for c in candidates:
                uid = c["user_id"]
                if not uid or str(uid).startswith("phone:"):
                    continue
                if uid in by_user:
                    continue
                if check_auto_log_revisit(aid, uid, c["service_id"]):
                    continue
                by_user[uid] = c

            for uid, c in by_user.items():
                last_visit_str = (c["last_visit"] or "")[:16].replace("T", " ")
                days_since = c["days_since"] or 0
                svc_id = c["service_id"]
                req_id = c["last_request_id"]

                msg = format_auto_broadcast_text(
                    text, uid, org_id, request_id=req_id,
                )

                buttons = []
                if bot_username:
                    repeat_url = f"https://max.ru/{bot_username}?startapp=repeat_{req_id}"
                    buttons.append([{
                        "type": "link",
                        "text": "↩ Записаться снова",
                        "url": repeat_url,
                    }])
                buttons.extend(UNSUB_BUTTONS)

                try:
                    if image_id:
                        await _send_with_refresh(uid, msg, image_id,
                                                 buttons=buttons, fmt="markdown",
                                                 org_id=org_id)
                    else:
                        await send_to_client_raw(uid, msg,
                                              buttons=buttons, fmt="markdown")
                    log_auto_broadcast(aid, uid,
                                       event_ref=f"revisit:{svc_id}:{req_id}")
                    log.info(
                        "Auto revisit sent: uid=%s service=%s days=%s",
                        uid, svc_id, days_since,
                    )
                    await asyncio.sleep(SEND_DELAY)
                except UserBlocked:
                    log.info("Auto revisit: user %s blocked bot", uid)
                except ChannelError as e:
                    log.info("Auto revisit: user %s has no channel (%s)", uid, e)
                except Exception as e:
                    log.warning("Auto revisit failed for %s: %s", uid, e)

        elif atype == "after_visit":
            cutoff_time = (now - timedelta(hours=delay_value)).strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")
            lower_bound = (now - timedelta(hours=delay_value + 72)).strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")
            conn = db()
            visits = conn.execute(
                "SELECT h.id AS id, h.user_id AS user_id "
                "FROM history h "
                "LEFT JOIN clients c ON c.user_id = h.user_id AND c.org_id = h.org_id "
                "WHERE h.org_id=? AND h.status='done' "
                "AND h.scheduled_at < ? AND h.scheduled_at >= ? "
                "AND (c.marketing_opt_out IS NULL OR c.marketing_opt_out = 0)",
                (org_id, cutoff_time, lower_bound)
            ).fetchall()
            conn.close()

            bot_username = (config.MINI_APP_BOT_USERNAME or "").strip()

            for v in visits:
                v_id = v["id"]
                uid = str(v["user_id"])
                if not uid or uid.startswith("phone:"):
                    continue
                if check_auto_log_after_visit(aid, v_id):
                    continue

                msg = format_auto_broadcast_text(text, uid, org_id, request_id=v_id)

                buttons = []
                if bot_username:
                    repeat_url = f"https://max.ru/{bot_username}?startapp=repeat_{v_id}"
                    buttons.append([{
                        "type": "link",
                        "text": "↩ Записаться снова",
                        "url": repeat_url,
                    }])
                buttons.extend(UNSUB_BUTTONS)

                try:
                    if image_id:
                        await _send_with_refresh(uid, msg, image_id,
                                                 buttons=buttons, fmt="markdown",
                                                 org_id=org_id)
                    else:
                        await send_to_client_raw(uid, msg,
                                              buttons=buttons, fmt="markdown")
                    log_auto_broadcast(aid, uid, event_ref=str(v_id))
                    log.info("Auto after_visit sent to %s", uid)
                    await asyncio.sleep(SEND_DELAY)
                except UserBlocked:
                    log.info("Auto after_visit: user %s blocked bot", uid)
                except ChannelError as e:
                    log.info("Auto after_visit: user %s has no channel (%s)", uid, e)
                except Exception as e:
                    log.warning("Auto after_visit failed for %s: %s", uid, e)


async def run_broadcast_worker():
    log.info("Broadcast worker started")
    await asyncio.sleep(60)
    last_scheduled_check = 0.0
    last_auto_check_ts = 0.0
    AUTO_CHECK_INTERVAL = 300  # 5 минут

    while True:
        try:
            await _check_manual_broadcasts()
        except Exception as e:
            log.error("Manual broadcast cycle error: %s", e)

        # Раз в 60 секунд проверяем запланированные
        now_ts = asyncio.get_event_loop().time()
        if now_ts - last_scheduled_check >= SCHEDULED_CHECK_INTERVAL:
            try:
                await _check_scheduled_broadcasts()
            except Exception as e:
                log.error("Scheduled broadcast cycle error: %s", e)
            last_scheduled_check = now_ts

        now_ts2 = asyncio.get_event_loop().time()
        if now_ts2 - last_auto_check_ts >= AUTO_CHECK_INTERVAL:
            try:
                await _check_auto_broadcasts()
            except Exception as e:
                log.error("Auto broadcast cycle error: %s", e)
            last_auto_check_ts = now_ts2

        await asyncio.sleep(10)

"""Утилиты геолокации: ссылки на Яндекс.Карты и 2ГИС."""
from urllib.parse import quote

from config import MAP_PROVIDERS


_VALID_PROVIDERS = {p[0] for p in MAP_PROVIDERS}
DEFAULT_PROVIDER = "both"


def yandex_maps_link(address: str) -> str:
    """Ссылка на Яндекс.Карты по текстовому адресу."""
    if not address or not address.strip():
        return ""
    return "https://yandex.ru/maps/?text=" + quote(address.strip(), safe="")


def gis_maps_link(address: str) -> str:
    """Ссылка на 2ГИС по текстовому адресу."""
    if not address or not address.strip():
        return ""
    return "https://2gis.ru/search/" + quote(address.strip(), safe="")


def _resolve_provider(org_id, provider):
    if provider and provider in _VALID_PROVIDERS:
        return provider
    if org_id is not None:
        try:
            from storage.db import get_org_settings
            settings = get_org_settings(org_id)
            p = settings.get("map_provider", DEFAULT_PROVIDER)
            if p in _VALID_PROVIDERS:
                return p
        except Exception:
            pass
    return DEFAULT_PROVIDER


def route_lines(address: str, org_id=None, provider: str | None = None) -> str:
    """Markdown-фрагмент для сообщения бота:
       📍 <адрес>
       🗺 [Яндекс.Карты](<link>)        (если provider=yandex или both)
       🗺 [2ГИС](<link>)                (если provider=2gis или both)

    provider: явно переданный идентификатор ("yandex"/"2gis"/"both").
    Если не передан — берём из настроек организации по org_id.
    Если ничего не известно — "both".
    Пустой адрес → пустая строка.
    """
    if not address or not address.strip():
        return ""
    addr = address.strip()
    p = _resolve_provider(org_id, provider)

    lines = [f"📍 {addr}"]
    if p in ("yandex", "both"):
        link = yandex_maps_link(addr)
        if link:
            lines.append(f"🗺 [Яндекс.Карты]({link})")
    if p in ("2gis", "both"):
        link = gis_maps_link(addr)
        if link:
            lines.append(f"🗺 [2ГИС]({link})")
    return "\n".join(lines) + "\n"
