import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { adminApi } from './adminApi.js';

export default function DoctorServicesModal({ orgId, doctor, onClose }) {
  const [step, setStep] = useState('loading');
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [services, setServices] = useState([]);
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState(new Set());
  const [allServicesMode, setAllServicesMode] = useState(true);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [saveMsg, setSaveMsg] = useState('');

  async function load() {
    setStep('loading');
    try {
      const [svcData, docData] = await Promise.all([
        adminApi.getServices(orgId),
        adminApi.getDoctorServices(orgId, doctor.id),
      ]);
      const svcList = (svcData.services || []).filter((s) => s.active);
      setServices(svcList);
      const assigned = new Set(docData.service_ids || []);
      setSelected(assigned);
      setAllServicesMode(assigned.size === 0);
      setStep('ready');
    } catch (e) {
      setError(e.message);
      setStep('error');
    }
  }

  useEffect(() => { load(); /* eslint-disable-next-line */ }, [orgId, doctor.id]);

  function toggleService(sid) {
    setSelected((prev) => {
      const next = new Set(prev);
      if (next.has(sid)) next.delete(sid);
      else next.add(sid);
      return next;
    });
    setSaveMsg('');
  }

  function toggleAll(sidList) {
    if (selected.size === sidList.length) {
      setSelected(new Set());
    } else {
      setSelected(new Set(sidList));
    }
    setSaveMsg('');
  }

  function selectAll() {
    setAllServicesMode(true);
    setSelected(new Set());
    setSaveMsg('');
  }

  function selectSpecific() {
    setAllServicesMode(false);
    setSaveMsg('');
  }

  async function handleSave() {
    setSaving(true);
    setSaveMsg('');
    setError('');
    try {
      const ids = allServicesMode ? [] : Array.from(selected);
      await adminApi.setDoctorServices(orgId, doctor.id, ids);
      setSaveMsg('✅ Сохранено');
    } catch (e) {
      setError(e.message);
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  }

  if (step === 'loading') return (
    <div className="modal-backdrop" onClick={onClose}>
      <div className="modal" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
        <div className="loading">Загрузка…</div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );

  if (step === 'error') return (
    <div className="modal-backdrop" onClick={onClose}>
      <div className="modal" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
        <div className="error-box">Ошибка: {error}</div>
        <div className="actions" style={{ marginTop: 12 }}>
          <button className="btn-action reject" onClick={onClose}>Закрыть</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );

  // Группировка услуг по категориям для удобства
  const byCategory = new Map();
  for (const s of services) {
    const key = s.category_id ?? '__none__';
    if (!byCategory.has(key)) {
      byCategory.set(key, {
        id: s.category_id,
        name: s.category_name || 'Прочие услуги',
        sort_order: s.category_sort_order ?? 999999,
        items: [],
      });
    }
    byCategory.get(key).items.push(s);
  }
  const categories = Array.from(byCategory.values()).sort((a, b) => {
    if (a.sort_order !== b.sort_order) return a.sort_order - b.sort_order;
    return a.name.localeCompare(b.name, 'ru');
  });

  const allSelected = !allServicesMode
    && services.length > 0
    && selected.size === services.length;

  return (
    <div className="modal-backdrop" onClick={onClose}>
      <div className="modal" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()} style={{ maxWidth: 600 }}>
        <h2 className="card-title">💼 Услуги специалиста: {doctor.name}</h2>
        <p style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted)', fontSize: 13, marginTop: 0, marginBottom: 16 }}>
          Клиент увидит специалиста только для отмеченных услуг. Если не отметить
          ни одной — специалист показывается для всех услуг (по умолчанию).
        </p>

        <div
          style={{
            padding: 12,
            background: 'var(--bg)',
            borderRadius: 10,
            marginBottom: 16,
          }}
        >
          <label className="radio-row" style={{ paddingBottom: 8 }}>
            <input
              type="radio"
              name="services-mode"
              checked={allServicesMode}
              onChange={selectAll}
              disabled={saving}
            />
            <div>
              <div className="radio-label">Делает все услуги</div>
              <div className="radio-hint">
                Специалист показывается для любой услуги. Удобно для новых —
                потом можно сузить список.
              </div>
            </div>
          </label>
          <label className="radio-row" style={{ paddingBottom: 0 }}>
            <input
              type="radio"
              name="services-mode"
              checked={!allServicesMode}
              onChange={selectSpecific}
              disabled={saving}
            />
            <div>
              <div className="radio-label">Только выбранные услуги</div>
              <div className="radio-hint">
                Отметьте ниже, какие услуги делает специалист. Клиент увидит его
                только там.
              </div>
            </div>
          </label>
        </div>

        {!allServicesMode && (
          <>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: 8 }}>
              <span style={{ fontSize: 13, color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>
                Отмечено {selected.size} из {services.length}
              </span>
              {services.length > 0 && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  className="btn-link"
                  style={{ fontSize: 12, padding: 0 }}
                  onClick={() => toggleAll(services.map((s) => s.id))}
                  disabled={saving}
                >
                  {allSelected ? 'Снять выделение' : 'Выделить все'}
                </button>
              )}
            </div>

            <div
              className="service-checkbox-list"
              style={{ maxHeight: '50vh', marginBottom: 16 }}
            >
              {services.length === 0 && (
                <span style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted)', fontSize: 13 }}>
                  Услуг пока нет
                </span>
              )}
              {categories.map((cat) => (
                <div key={cat.id ?? '__none__'}>
                  <div
                    style={{
                      fontSize: 12,
                      fontWeight: 600,
                      color: 'var(--primary)',
                      padding: '6px 4px 2px',
                      borderBottom: '1px solid var(--border)',
                      marginBottom: 2,
                    }}
                  >
                    📂 {cat.name}
                  </div>
                  {cat.items.map((s) => (
                    <label key={s.id} className="checkbox-row" style={{ padding: '4px 0 4px 8px' }}>
                      <input
                        type="checkbox"
                        checked={selected.has(s.id)}
                        onChange={() => toggleService(s.id)}
                        disabled={saving}
                      />
                      <span>{s.name}</span>
                    </label>
                  ))}
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </>
        )}

        {error && <div className="form-error" style={{ marginBottom: 12 }}>{error}</div>}

        <div className="actions">
          <button
            className="btn-action confirm"
            onClick={handleSave}
            disabled={saving || (!allServicesMode && selected.size === 0 && services.length > 0)}
            title={!allServicesMode && selected.size === 0 && services.length > 0
              ? 'Выберите хотя бы одну услугу или переключитесь на «Делает все услуги»'
              : undefined}
          >
            {saving ? 'Сохранение…' : '💾 Сохранить'}
          </button>
          <button className="btn-action reject" onClick={onClose} disabled={saving}>
            Закрыть
          </button>
        </div>
        {saveMsg && (
          <div style={{ color: 'var(--accent)', fontSize: 13, marginTop: 12, textAlign: 'center' }}>
            {saveMsg}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { adminApi } from './adminApi.js';

function humanTs(iso) {
  if (!iso) return '';
  try {
    const d = new Date(iso);
    const p = (n) => (n < 10 ? '0' + n : n);
    return `${p(d.getDate())}.${p(d.getMonth() + 1)}.${d.getFullYear()} ${p(d.getHours())}:${p(d.getMinutes())}`;
  } catch {
    return iso;
  }
}

export default function BlockedUsersPage({ orgId }) {
  const [step, setStep] = useState('loading');
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [users, setUsers] = useState([]);
  const [busyId, setBusyId] = useState(null);

  async function load() {
    setStep('loading');
    setError('');
    try {
      const data = await adminApi.getBlockedUsers(orgId);
      setUsers(data.users || []);
      setStep('ready');
    } catch (e) {
      setError(e.message);
      setStep('error');
    }
  }

  useEffect(() => { load(); /* eslint-disable-next-line */ }, [orgId]);

  async function handleUnblock(userId) {
    if (!window.confirm('Разблокировать клиента? Он снова сможет записываться.')) return;
    setBusyId(userId);
    try {
      await adminApi.unblockClient(orgId, userId);
      await load();
    } catch (e) {
      alert('Ошибка: ' + e.message);
    } finally {
      setBusyId(null);
    }
  }

  if (step === 'loading') return <div className="loading">Загрузка…</div>;
  if (step === 'error') return <div className="error-box">Ошибка: {error}</div>;

  return (
    <div>
      <div
        style={{
          color: 'var(--text-muted)',
          fontSize: 13,
          marginBottom: 12,
          padding: '8px 12px',
          background: 'var(--primary-soft)',
          borderRadius: 8,
        }}
      >
        Заблокированные клиенты не могут создавать новые записи. Существующие
        активные записи остаются в силе — их можно отменить отдельно в разделе «Заявки».
        Разблокировка возвращает доступ.
      </div>

      {!users.length && (
        <div className="dash-empty">
          Заблокированных клиентов нет.
        </div>
      )}

      {users.map((u) => (
        <div key={u.user_id} className="dir-item">
          <div className="dir-main">
            <div className="dir-title">
              🚫 MAX ID: {u.user_id}
            </div>
            <div className="dir-meta">📞 {u.phone || '—'}</div>
            {u.reason && <div className="dir-meta">Причина: {u.reason}</div>}
            <div className="dir-meta" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>
              Заблокирован: {humanTs(u.blocked_at)}
              {u.blocked_by && ` · кем: ${u.blocked_by}`}
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="dir-actions">
            <button
              className="dir-btn"
              onClick={() => handleUnblock(u.user_id)}
              disabled={busyId === u.user_id}
              title="Разблокировать"
            >
              ↩
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

  { id: 'analytics',   label: '📊 Аналитика' },
  { id: 'reviews',     label: '⭐ Отзывы' },

export default function AdminApp({ orgId }) {
  const [tab, setTab] = useState('dashboard');
  const [menuOpen, setMenuOpen] = useState(false);
  const [step, setStep] = useState('loading');
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [me, setMe] = useState(null);
  const [orgs, setOrgs] = useState([]);
  const [currentOrgId, setCurrentOrgId] = useState(orgId || null);
  const [requestsPreset, setRequestsPreset] = useState(null);

  async function loadMe(currentOrg) {
    try {
      const meData = await adminApi.getMe(currentOrg);
      setMe(meData);

      if (meData.role === 'superadmin') {
        const orgsData = await adminApi.getOrgs();
        setOrgs(orgsData.orgs || []);
        if (!currentOrg && orgsData.orgs && orgsData.orgs.length) {
          const saved = localStorage.getItem(LS_ORG_KEY);
          const fromSaved = saved && orgsData.orgs.find((o) => String(o.id) === saved);
          const pick = fromSaved ? fromSaved.id : orgsData.orgs[0].id;
          setCurrentOrgId(pick);
          localStorage.setItem(LS_ORG_KEY, String(pick));
          return;
        }
      }
      setStep('ready');
    } catch (e) {
      setError(e.message);
      setStep('error');
    }
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    loadMe(currentOrgId);
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [currentOrgId]);

  function handleOrgChange(e) {
    const id = parseInt(e.target.value, 10);
    setCurrentOrgId(id);
    localStorage.setItem(LS_ORG_KEY, String(id));
  }

  function openTab(id) {
    if (id === 'requests') setRequestsPreset(null);
    setTab(id);
    setMenuOpen(false);
  }

  function handleDashboardOpen(status, datePreset) {
    setRequestsPreset({ status, datePreset });
    setTab('requests');
    setMenuOpen(false);
  }

  if (step === 'loading') {
    return (
      <div className="app">
        <div className="loading">Загрузка админки…</div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (step === 'error') {
    return (
      <div className="app">
        <div className="error-box">
          <strong>Ошибка доступа:</strong> {error}
          <p style={{ marginTop: 8, fontSize: 14 }}>
            Откройте админку через бота (кнопка «⚙️ Админ»).
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const isSuper = me.role === 'superadmin';
  const roleLabel = isSuper ? 'Суперадмин' : 'Админ';
  const isExtraTab = MENU_ITEMS.some((m) => m.id === tab);

  const requestsKey = requestsPreset
    ? `requests-${requestsPreset.status}-${requestsPreset.datePreset}`
    : 'requests-default';

  return (
    <div className="app">
      <div className="header">
        <h1>Админка</h1>
        {isSuper && orgs.length > 0 ? (
          <select
            className="org-select"
            value={currentOrgId || ''}
            onChange={handleOrgChange}
          >
            {orgs.map((o) => (
              <option key={o.id} value={o.id}>{o.name}</option>
            ))}
          </select>
        ) : (
          <p>{me.org_name || '—'}</p>
        )}
        <p className="role-line">{roleLabel}</p>
      </div>

      <div className="main-tabs">
        <button
          className={'main-tab' + (tab === 'dashboard' ? ' active' : '')}
          onClick={() => openTab('dashboard')}
        >
          🏠 Сегодня
        </button>
        <button
          className={'main-tab' + (tab === 'requests' ? ' active' : '')}
          onClick={() => openTab('requests')}
        >
          📋 Заявки
        </button>
        <button
          className={'main-tab' + (tab === 'schedule' ? ' active' : '')}
          onClick={() => openTab('schedule')}
        >
          📅 Расписание
        </button>
        <button
          className={'main-tab hamburger' + (isExtraTab ? ' active' : '')}
          onClick={() => setMenuOpen(true)}
        >
          ☰
        </button>
      </div>

      {menuOpen && (
        <>
          <div className="drawer-backdrop" onClick={() => setMenuOpen(false)} />
          <div className="drawer">
            <div className="drawer-header">
              <span>Меню</span>
              <button className="drawer-close" onClick={() => setMenuOpen(false)}>✕</button>
            </div>
            {MENU_ITEMS.map((item) => (
              <button
                key={item.id}
                className={'drawer-item' + (tab === item.id ? ' active' : '')}
                onClick={() => openTab(item.id)}

          />
        </div>
      )}

      {tab === 'schedule' && (
        <div className="card">
          <SchedulePage orgId={currentOrgId} />
        </div>
      )}

      {tab === 'broadcasts' && (
        <div className="card">
          <BroadcastsPage orgId={currentOrgId} />
        </div>
      )}

      {tab === 'directories' && (
        <div className="card">
          <DirectoriesPage orgId={currentOrgId} />
        </div>
      )}

      {tab === 'audit' && (
        <div className="card">
          <AuditLogPage orgId={currentOrgId} />
        </div>
      )}

      {tab === 'analytics' && (
        <div className="card">
          <AnalyticsPage orgId={currentOrgId} />
        </div>
      )}

      {tab === 'reviews' && (
        <div className="card">

      )}

      {tab === 'clients' && (

        </div>
      )}

      {tab === 'waitlist' && (
        <div className="card">
          <WaitlistPage orgId={currentOrgId} />
        </div>
      )}

      {tab === 'blocked' && (
        <div className="card">
          <BlockedUsersPage orgId={currentOrgId} />
        </div>
      )}

      {tab === 'channels' && (
        <div className="card">
          <ChannelsPage orgId={currentOrgId} />
        </div>
      )}

      {tab === 'settings' && (
        <SettingsPage
          orgId={currentOrgId}
          onOrgRenamed={() => loadMe(currentOrgId)}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';

  pending: 'ожидает',
  confirmed: 'подтверждена',
  cancelled: 'отменена',
  done: 'пришёл',
  no_show: 'не пришёл',
  new: 'новая',
};

const STATUS_FILTERS = [
  { id: 'all', label: 'Все' },
  { id: 'pending', label: 'Ожидают' },
  { id: 'confirmed', label: 'Подтверждены' },
  { id: 'cancelled', label: 'Отменены' },

const PER_PAGE = 20;

function isoDate(d) {
  const p = (n) => (n < 10 ? '0' + n : '' + n);
  return `${d.getFullYear()}-${p(d.getMonth() + 1)}-${p(d.getDate())}`;
}

function addDays(d, n) {
  const copy = new Date(d);
  copy.setDate(copy.getDate() + n);
  return copy;
}

function todayIso() { return isoDate(new Date()); }
function plusDaysIso(n) { return isoDate(addDays(new Date(), n)); }

const DATE_PRESETS = [
  { id: 'today', label: 'Сегодня', from: () => todayIso(), to: () => todayIso() },
  { id: 'yesterday', label: 'Вчера', from: () => plusDaysIso(-1), to: () => plusDaysIso(-1) },
  { id: 'tomorrow', label: 'Завтра', from: () => plusDaysIso(1), to: () => plusDaysIso(1) },
  { id: '7_back', label: 'Сегодня −7', from: () => plusDaysIso(-7), to: () => plusDaysIso(-1) },
  { id: '7', label: 'Сегодня +7', from: () => todayIso(), to: () => plusDaysIso(7) },
  { id: '30', label: 'Сегодня +30', from: () => todayIso(), to: () => plusDaysIso(30) },
  { id: 'all', label: 'Вся история', from: () => null, to: () => null },
];

export default function RequestsPage({
  orgId,
  initialStatus = 'all',
  initialDatePreset = '7',
}) {
  const [status, setStatus] = useState(initialStatus);
  const [datePreset, setDatePreset] = useState(initialDatePreset);
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);

  const [requests, setRequests] = useState([]);
  const [services, setServices] = useState([]);
  const [total, setTotal] = useState(0);
  const [totalPages, setTotalPages] = useState(1);
  const [step, setStep] = useState('loading');
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [expandedId, setExpandedId] = useState(null);
  const [busyId, setBusyId] = useState(null);
  const [createOpen, setCreateOpen] = useState(false);
  const [markingRequest, setMarkingRequest] = useState(null);
  const [clientCardUserId, setClientCardUserId] = useState(null);
  const [movingRequest, setMovingRequest] = useState(null);
  const [editingRequest, setEditingRequest] = useState(null);

  async function load() {
    setStep('loading');
    setError('');
    try {
      const preset = DATE_PRESETS.find((p) => p.id === datePreset);
      const from = preset ? preset.from() : null;
      const to = preset ? preset.to() : null;

      // Спецфильтр «Авто-пришли»: status=done + auto_done=1.
      const isAutoDone = status === 'auto_done';
      const realStatus = isAutoDone ? 'done' : status;

      const data = await adminApi.getRequests(orgId, {
        status: realStatus,
        auto_done: isAutoDone ? '1' : undefined,
        date_from: from,
        date_to: to,
        page,
        per_page: PER_PAGE,
      });
      setRequests(data.requests || []);
      setTotal(data.total || 0);
      setTotalPages(data.total_pages || 1);
      setStep('ready');
    } catch (e) {
      setError(e.message);
      setStep('error');
    }
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    load();
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [orgId, status, datePreset, page]);

  useEffect(() => {
    adminApi.getServices(orgId).then((d) => setServices(d.services || [])).catch(() => {});
  }, [orgId]);

  function priceByServiceId(serviceId) {
    const svc = services.find((s) => s.id === serviceId);
    return svc ? svc.price : null;
  }

  function changeStatus(newStatus) {
    setStatus(newStatus);
    setPage(1);
  }

  function changeDatePreset(id) {
    setDatePreset(id);
    setPage(1);
  }

  async function handleConfirm(id) {
    setBusyId(id);
    try {
      await adminApi.confirmRequest(orgId, id);
      await load();
    } catch (e) {
      alert('Ошибка: ' + e.message);
    } finally {
      setBusyId(null);
    }
  }

  async function handleReject(id, wasConfirmed) {
    const msg = wasConfirmed
      ? 'Отменить подтверждённую запись? Слот будет освобождён, клиент получит уведомление.'
      : 'Отклонить заявку? Слот будет освобождён.';
    if (!window.confirm(msg)) return;
    setBusyId(id);
    try {
      await adminApi.rejectRequest(orgId, id);
      await load();
    } catch (e) {
      alert('Ошибка: ' + e.message);
    } finally {
      setBusyId(null);
    }
  }

  async function handleMarkNoShow(id) {
    if (!window.confirm('Отметить, что клиент не пришёл? Клиент не получит «Спасибо за визит», а дата визита пересчитается.')) return;
    setBusyId(id);
    try {
      await adminApi.markNoShow(orgId, id);
      await load();
    } catch (e) {
      alert('Ошибка: ' + e.message);
    } finally {
      setBusyId(null);
    }
  }

  async function handleMarkDone(payload) {
    if (!markingRequest) return;
    const id = markingRequest.id;
    await adminApi.markDone(orgId, id, payload);
    setMarkingRequest(null);
    await load();
  }

  if (step === 'loading') return <div className="loading">Загрузка заявок…</div>;
  if (step === 'error') return <div className="error-box">Ошибка: {error}</div>;

  const activeDateLabel = (DATE_PRESETS.find((p) => p.id === datePreset) || {}).label || '—';

  return (
    <div>
      <button
        className="btn-generate"
        style={{ marginBottom: 12 }}
        onClick={() => setCreateOpen(true)}
      >
        ➕ Создать запись
      </button>

      <div className="filters-scroll">
        {STATUS_FILTERS.map((f) => (
          <button
            key={f.id}
            className={'filter-btn' + (status === f.id ? ' active' : '')}
            onClick={() => changeStatus(f.id)}
          >
            {f.label}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>

      <div className="filters-period-row">
        <span className="filters-period-label">📅 Период</span>
        <select
          className="filters-period-select"
          value={datePreset}
          onChange={(e) => changeDatePreset(e.target.value)}
          title="Период"
        >
          {DATE_PRESETS.map((p) => (
            <option key={p.id} value={p.id}>{p.label}</option>
          ))}
        </select>
      </div>

      {!requests.length && (
        <p style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted)', margin: '12px 0' }}>
          Заявок в этой категории нет.
        </p>
      )}

      {requests.map((r) => {
        const expanded = expandedId === r.id;
        const hasAmount = r.actual_amount != null;
        const optedOut = !!r.marketing_opt_out;
        const isBlocked = !!r.blocked;
        const isPhoneOnly = String(r.user_id || '').startsWith('phone:');
        return (
          <div key={r.id} className="request-item">
            <div
              className="request-head"
              onClick={() => setExpandedId(expanded ? null : r.id)}
            >
              <div>
                <div className="request-title">#{r.id} {r.service_name}</div>
                <div className="request-meta">
                  {r.scheduled_at} · {r.phone}
                  {hasAmount && ` · 💰 ${r.actual_amount} ₽${r.payment_method ? ` (${PAYMENT_LABELS[r.payment_method] || r.payment_method})` : ''}`}
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="request-head-right">
                {isBlocked && (
                  <span className="tag" style={{ background: '#fdecec', color: '#a83c3c' }}>
                    🚫 заблокирован
                  </span>
                )}
                {r.done_auto && (
                  <span
                    className="tag"
                    style={{ background: '#fff4d9', color: '#8b5a00' }}
                    title="Статус «пришёл» проставлен автоматически. Проверьте сумму."
                  >
                    ⚠️ авто
                  </span>
                )}
                <div className={`status status-${r.status}`}>
                  {STATUS_LABELS[r.status] || r.status}
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            {expanded && (
              <div className="request-body">
                <div className="row"><span>Услуга:</span> {r.service_name}</div>
                <div className="row">
                  <span>Дата:</span> {r.scheduled_at}
                  {r.slots_count > 1 && (
                    <span style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted)', marginLeft: 6, fontSize: 12 }}>
                      (занимает {r.slots_count} слота)
                    </span>
                  )}
                </div>
                <div className="row"><span>Телефон:</span> {r.phone}</div>
                {r.address && <div className="row"><span>Адрес:</span> {r.address}</div>}
                {r.doctor && <div className="row"><span>Специалист:</span> {r.doctor}</div>}
                <div className="row"><span>Создана:</span> {r.created_at}</div>
                {hasAmount && (
                  <div className="row">
                    <span>Оплата:</span>
                    {' '}{r.actual_amount} ₽
                    {r.payment_method ? ` · ${PAYMENT_LABELS[r.payment_method] || r.payment_method}` : ''}
                    {r.done_auto && (
                      <span style={{ color: '#8b5a00', marginLeft: 6, fontSize: 12 }}>
                        (авто, проверьте)
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </div>
                )}
                <div className="row" style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', alignItems: 'flex-start', gap: 4 }}>
                  {!isPhoneOnly && (
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      className="btn-link"
                      style={{ fontSize: 12, padding: 0 }}
                      onClick={() => setClientCardUserId(r.user_id)}
                    >
                      👤 Карточка клиента
                    </button>
                  )}
                  {(r.status === 'pending' || r.status === 'confirmed') && (
                    <>
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        className="btn-link"
                        style={{ fontSize: 12, padding: 0 }}
                        onClick={() => setMovingRequest(r)}
                      >
                        🔄 Перенести запись
                      </button>
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        className="btn-link"
                        style={{ fontSize: 12, padding: 0 }}
                        onClick={() => setEditingRequest(r)}
                      >
                        ✏️ Редактировать услугу / слоты
                      </button>
                    </>
                  )}
                </div>

                {r.status === 'pending' && (
                  <div className="actions">
                    <button
                      className="btn-action confirm"
                      disabled={busyId === r.id}
                      onClick={() => handleConfirm(r.id)}
                    >
                      ✅ Подтвердить
                    </button>
                    <button
                      className="btn-action reject"
                      disabled={busyId === r.id}
                      onClick={() => handleReject(r.id, false)}
                    >
                      ❌ Отклонить
                    </button>
                  </div>
                )}

                {r.status === 'confirmed' && (
                  <div className="actions">
                    <button
                      className="btn-action confirm"
                      disabled={busyId === r.id}
                      onClick={() => setMarkingRequest(r)}
                    >
                      ✅ Пришёл
                    </button>
                    <button
                      className="btn-action"
                      disabled={busyId === r.id}
                      onClick={() => handleMarkNoShow(r.id)}
                    >
                      🚫 Не пришёл
                    </button>
                    <button
                      className="btn-action reject"
                      disabled={busyId === r.id}
                      onClick={() => handleReject(r.id, true)}
                    >
                      ❌ Отменить запись
                    </button>
                  </div>
                )}

                {r.status === 'done' && (
                  <div className="actions">
                    <button
                      className="btn-action"
                      disabled={busyId === r.id}
                      onClick={() => setMarkingRequest(r)}
                      title="Изменить сумму или способ оплаты"
                    >
                      ✏️ Изменить сумму
                    </button>
                    <button
                      className="btn-action"
                      disabled={busyId === r.id}
                      onClick={() => handleMarkNoShow(r.id)}
                    >
                      🚫 Клиент не пришёл
                    </button>
                  </div>
                )}

                {r.status === 'no_show' && (
                  <div className="actions">
                    <button
                      className="btn-action confirm"
                      disabled={busyId === r.id}
                      onClick={() => setMarkingRequest(r)}
                    >
                      ✅ Клиент пришёл
                    </button>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        );
      })}

      {totalPages > 1 && (
        <div className="pagination">
          <button
            className="page-btn"
            disabled={page <= 1}
            onClick={() => setPage(page - 1)}
          >
            ←
          </button>
          <span className="page-info">{page} из {totalPages}</span>
          <button
            className="page-btn"
            disabled={page >= totalPages}
            onClick={() => setPage(page + 1)}
          >
            →
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      <p style={{ textAlign: 'center', color: 'var(--text-muted)', fontSize: 13, marginTop: 12 }}>
        Всего заявок: {total} · {activeDateLabel}
      </p>

      {createOpen && (
        <CreateRequestModal
          orgId={orgId}
          onClose={() => setCreateOpen(false)}
          onCreated={async () => { await load(); }}
        />
      )}

      {markingRequest && (
        <MarkVisitModal
          request={markingRequest}
          defaultPrice={priceByServiceId(markingRequest.service_id)}
          onCancel={() => setMarkingRequest(null)}
          onConfirm={handleMarkDone}
        />
      )}

      {clientCardUserId && (
        <ClientCardModal
          orgId={orgId}
          userId={clientCardUserId}
          onClose={() => setClientCardUserId(null)}
          onChanged={async () => { await load(); }}
        />
      )}

      {movingRequest && (
        <MoveRequestModal
          orgId={orgId}
          request={movingRequest}
          onClose={() => setMovingRequest(null)}
          onMoved={async () => { await load(); }}
        />
      )}

      {editingRequest && (
        <EditRequestModal
          orgId={orgId}
          request={editingRequest}
          onClose={() => setEditingRequest(null)}
          onSaved={async () => { await load(); }}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { adminApi } from './adminApi.js';
import ClientCardModal from './ClientCardModal.jsx';

function humanTs(iso) {
  if (!iso) return '—';
  try {
    const d = new Date(iso.replace(' ', 'T'));
    const p = (n) => (n < 10 ? '0' + n : n);
    return `${p(d.getDate())}.${p(d.getMonth() + 1)}.${d.getFullYear()}`;
  } catch { return iso; }
}

export default function ClientsPage({ orgId }) {
  const [query, setQuery] = useState('');
  const [results, setResults] = useState([]);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [openedUserId, setOpenedUserId] = useState(null);

  async function load(q) {
    setBusy(true);
    setError('');
    try {
      const data = await adminApi.searchClients(orgId, q || '');
      setResults(data.clients || []);
    } catch (e) {
      setError(e.message);
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  useEffect(() => { load(''); /* eslint-disable-next-line */ }, [orgId]);

  function handleSearch(e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    load(query);
  }

  return (
    <div>
      <form onSubmit={handleSearch} style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8, marginBottom: 12 }}>
        <input
          className="form-input"
          type="text"
          value={query}
          onChange={(e) => setQuery(e.target.value)}
          placeholder="ФИО или телефон"
          style={{ flex: 1 }}
        />
        <button type="submit" className="btn-action confirm" style={{ flex: '0 0 auto', padding: '10px 16px' }} disabled={busy}>
          {busy ? '…' : '🔍 Найти'}
        </button>
      </form>

      <div style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted)', fontSize: 13, marginBottom: 12, padding: '8px 12px', background: 'var(--primary-soft)', borderRadius: 8 }}>
        Введите ФИО или телефон. Пустой запрос — показать последних обновлённых клиентов.
      </div>

      {error && <div className="error-box" style={{ marginBottom: 12 }}>{error}</div>}

      {busy && <div className="loading">Поиск…</div>}

      {!busy && !results.length && (
        <div className="create-req-empty">Ничего не найдено.</div>
      )}

      {results.map((c) => {
        const fio = [c.last_name, c.first_name, c.middle_name].filter(Boolean).join(' ') || '—';
        return (
          <div
            key={c.user_id}
            className="dir-item visit-clickable"
            onClick={() => setOpenedUserId(c.user_id)}
          >
            <div className="dir-main">
              <div className="dir-title">
                {fio}
                {!c.has_max && (
                  <span className="tag tag-muted" style={{ marginLeft: 8 }}>нет MAX</span>
                )}
              </div>
              <div className="dir-meta">
                {c.phone || '—'}
                {c.last_visit_at && ` · последний визит ${humanTs(c.last_visit_at)}`}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        );
      })}

      {openedUserId && (
        <ClientCardModal
          orgId={orgId}
          userId={openedUserId}
          onClose={() => setOpenedUserId(null)}
          onChanged={() => load(query)}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { adminApi } from './adminApi.js';

const STATUS_LABELS = {
  active: '🟢 Активна',
  fulfilled: '✅ Выполнена',
  cancelled: '❌ Отменена',
  expired: '⏳ Истекла',
};

const STATUS_CLASS = {
  active: 'pending',
  fulfilled: 'confirmed',
  cancelled: 'cancelled',
  expired: 'cancelled',
};

const PREFERRED_LABELS = {
  morning: '🌅 Утро',
  afternoon: '☀️ День',
  evening: '🌇 Вечер',
  any: '🕐 Любое',
};

const STATUS_FILTERS = [
  { id: 'active', label: 'Активные' },
  { id: '', label: 'Все' },
  { id: 'fulfilled', label: '✅ Выполнены' },
  { id: 'cancelled', label: '❌ Отменены' },
  { id: 'expired', label: '⏳ Истекли' },
];

function humanDate(iso) {
  if (!iso) return '';
  const [y, m, d] = iso.split('-').map(Number);
  const months = ['янв','фев','мар','апр','мая','июн','июл','авг','сен','окт','ноя','дек'];
  return `${d} ${months[m - 1]}`;
}

function humanTs(iso) {
  if (!iso) return '—';
  try {
    const d = new Date(iso.replace(' ', 'T'));
    const p = (n) => (n < 10 ? '0' + n : n);
    return `${p(d.getDate())}.${p(d.getMonth()+1)} ${p(d.getHours())}:${p(d.getMinutes())}`;
  } catch { return iso; }
}

export default function WaitlistPage({ orgId }) {
  const [step, setStep] = useState('loading');
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [entries, setEntries] = useState([]);
  const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState('active');
  const [services, setServices] = useState([]);
  const [busyId, setBusyId] = useState(null);
  const [creating, setCreating] = useState(false);
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState(null);

  async function load() {
    setStep('loading');
    setError('');
    try {
      const data = await adminApi.getWaitlist(orgId, {
        status: statusFilter || undefined,
        limit: 200,
      });
      setEntries(data.entries || []);
      setStep('ready');
    } catch (e) {
      setError(e.message);
      setStep('error');
    }
  }

  async function loadServices() {
    try {
      const d = await adminApi.getServices(orgId);
      setServices((d.services || []).filter((s) => s.active));
    } catch (e) {}
  }

  useEffect(() => { load(); /* eslint-disable-next-line */ }, [orgId, statusFilter]);
  useEffect(() => { loadServices(); /* eslint-disable-next-line */ }, [orgId]);

  async function handleNotify(wid) {
    setBusyId('notify_' + wid);
    try {
      await adminApi.notifyWaitlist(orgId, wid);
      await load();
    } catch (e) {
      alert('Не удалось уведомить: ' + e.message);
    } finally {
      setBusyId(null);
    }
  }

  async function handleFulfill(wid) {
    if (!window.confirm('Пометить заявку как выполненную?')) return;
    setBusyId('fulfill_' + wid);
    try {
      await adminApi.fulfillWaitlist(orgId, wid);
      await load();
    } catch (e) {
      alert('Ошибка: ' + e.message);
    } finally {
      setBusyId(null);
    }
  }

  async function handleCancel(wid) {
    if (!window.confirm('Удалить заявку из листа?')) return;
    setBusyId('cancel_' + wid);
    try {
      await adminApi.cancelWaitlist(orgId, wid);
      await load();
    } catch (e) {
      alert('Ошибка: ' + e.message);
    } finally {
      setBusyId(null);
    }
  }

  if (step === 'loading') return <div className="loading">Загрузка…</div>;
  if (step === 'error') return <div className="error-box">Ошибка: {error}</div>;

  return (
    <div>
      <button
        className="btn-generate"
        style={{ marginBottom: 12 }}
        onClick={() => setCreating(true)}
      >
        ➕ Добавить в лист
      </button>

      <div className="filters-scroll">
        {STATUS_FILTERS.map((f) => (
          <button
            key={f.id || 'all'}
            className={'filter-btn' + (statusFilter === f.id ? ' active' : '')}
            onClick={() => setStatusFilter(f.id)}
          >
            {f.label}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>

      {!entries.length && (
        <div className="dash-empty">
          Заявок нет.
        </div>
      )}

      {entries.map((e) => {
        const fio = [e.client_last_name, e.client_first_name, e.client_middle_name]
          .filter(Boolean).join(' ') || '—';
        const isActive = e.status === 'active';
        return (
          <div
            key={e.id}
            className="dir-item"
            style={{ flexDirection: 'column', alignItems: 'stretch' }}
          >
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'flex-start', gap: 12 }}>
              <div className="dir-main">
                <div className="dir-title">
                  {e.service_name}
                  <span
                    className={`status status-${STATUS_CLASS[e.status] || 'pending'}`}
                    style={{ marginLeft: 8 }}
                  >
                    {STATUS_LABELS[e.status] || e.status}
                  </span>
                </div>
                <div className="dir-meta">
                  📅 {humanDate(e.date_from)} — {humanDate(e.date_to)}
                  {e.preferred_time && ` · ${PREFERRED_LABELS[e.preferred_time] || e.preferred_time}`}
                </div>
                {e.doctor_name && <div className="dir-meta">👤 {e.doctor_name}</div>}
                {e.branch_name && <div className="dir-meta">🏢 {e.branch_name}</div>}
                <div className="dir-meta">
                  Клиент: <b>{fio}</b>
                  {e.client_phone && ` · ${e.client_phone}`}
                  {!e.has_max && <span className="tag tag-muted" style={{ marginLeft: 6 }}>нет MAX</span>}
                </div>
                {e.notes && <div className="dir-meta" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>📝 {e.notes}</div>}
                {e.notified_count > 0 && (
                  <div className="dir-meta" style={{ fontSize: 12, color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>
                    Уведомляли {e.notified_count} раз
                    {e.notified_at && `, последний — ${humanTs(e.notified_at)}`}
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>

            {isActive && (
              <div className="actions" style={{ marginTop: 8, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
                <button
                  className="btn-action"
                  onClick={() => handleNotify(e.id)}
                  disabled={busyId === 'notify_' + e.id || !e.has_max}
                  title={!e.has_max ? 'У клиента нет MAX' : 'Найти ближайший свободный слот и отправить уведомление'}
                  style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 110 }}
                >
                  {busyId === 'notify_' + e.id ? '…' : '🔔 Уведомить'}
                </button>
                <button
                  className="btn-action confirm"
                  onClick={() => handleFulfill(e.id)}
                  disabled={busyId === 'fulfill_' + e.id}
                  style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 110 }}
                >
                  {busyId === 'fulfill_' + e.id ? '…' : '✅ Выполнено'}
                </button>
                <button
                  className="btn-action"
                  onClick={() => setEditing(e)}
                  style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 80 }}
                  title="Редактировать"
                >
                  ✏️
                </button>
                <button
                  className="btn-action reject"
                  onClick={() => handleCancel(e.id)}
                  disabled={busyId === 'cancel_' + e.id}
                  style={{ flex: '0 0 60px' }}
                  title="Удалить"
                >
                  {busyId === 'cancel_' + e.id ? '…' : '🗑'}
                </button>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        );
      })}

      {creating && (
        <WaitlistEditModal
          orgId={orgId}
          services={services}
          onClose={() => setCreating(false)}
          onSaved={async () => { setCreating(false); await load(); }}
        />
      )}

      {editing && (
        <WaitlistEditModal
          orgId={orgId}
          services={services}
          initial={editing}
          onClose={() => setEditing(null)}
          onSaved={async () => { setEditing(null); await load(); }}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function WaitlistEditModal({ orgId, services, initial, onClose, onSaved }) {
  const isEdit = !!initial;

  const [query, setQuery] = useState('');
  const [searchResults, setSearchResults] = useState([]);
  const [searchBusy, setSearchBusy] = useState(false);
  const [selectedClient, setSelectedClient] = useState(null);

  const [phone, setPhone] = useState(initial?.client_phone || '');
  const [firstName, setFirstName] = useState(initial?.client_first_name || '');
  const [lastName, setLastName] = useState(initial?.client_last_name || '');
  const [middleName, setMiddleName] = useState(initial?.client_middle_name || '');

  const [serviceId, setServiceId] = useState(initial?.service_id || '');
  const [doctorId, setDoctorId] = useState(initial?.doctor_id ? String(initial.doctor_id) : '');
  const [dateFrom, setDateFrom] = useState(initial?.date_from || '');
  const [dateTo, setDateTo] = useState(initial?.date_to || '');
  const [preferred, setPreferred] = useState(initial?.preferred_time || 'any');
  const [notes, setNotes] = useState(initial?.notes || '');

  const [doctors, setDoctors] = useState([]);

  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');

  useEffect(() => {
    adminApi.getDoctorsByOrg(orgId)
      .then((d) => setDoctors(d.doctors || []))
      .catch(() => {});
  }, [orgId]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isEdit || selectedClient) return;
    const trimmed = query.trim();
    if (trimmed.length < 2) { setSearchResults([]); return; }
    const t = setTimeout(() => {
      setSearchBusy(true);
      adminApi.searchClients(orgId, trimmed)
        .then((d) => setSearchResults(d.clients || []))
        .catch(() => setSearchResults([]))
        .finally(() => setSearchBusy(false));
    }, 300);
    return () => clearTimeout(t);
  }, [query, orgId, isEdit, selectedClient]);

  function pickClient(c) {
    setSelectedClient(c);
    setPhone(c.phone || '');
    setFirstName(c.first_name || '');
    setLastName(c.last_name || '');
    setMiddleName(c.middle_name || '');
    setSearchResults([]);
    setQuery('');
  }

  function clearClient() {
    setSelectedClient(null);
  }

  async function submit() {
    setError('');
    if (!serviceId && !doctorId) {
      setError('Укажите услугу и/или специалиста');
      return;
    }
    if (!dateFrom || !dateTo) { setError('Укажите период'); return; }
    if (dateTo < dateFrom) { setError('«По дату» не может быть раньше «С даты»'); return; }
    if (!isEdit && !selectedClient && !phone.trim()) {
      setError('Выберите клиента или укажите телефон');
      return;
    }
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      const payload = {
        service_id: serviceId,
        doctor_id: doctorId ? parseInt(doctorId, 10) : null,
        date_from: dateFrom,
        date_to: dateTo,
        preferred_time: preferred === 'any' ? null : preferred,
        notes,
      };
      if (!isEdit) {
        if (selectedClient) {
          payload.user_id = selectedClient.user_id;
        } else {
          payload.phone = phone.trim();
          payload.first_name = firstName.trim();
          payload.last_name = lastName.trim();
          payload.middle_name = middleName.trim();
        }
        await adminApi.createWaitlist(orgId, payload);
      } else {
        await adminApi.updateWaitlist(orgId, initial.id, payload);
      }
      onSaved();
    } catch (e) {
      setError(e.message);
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="modal-backdrop" onClick={() => !busy && onClose()}>
      <div className="modal" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()} style={{ maxWidth: 540 }}>
        <h2 className="card-title">
          {isEdit ? `Редактировать заявку #${initial.id}` : 'Новая заявка в лист'}
        </h2>

        {!isEdit && (
          <>
            <div className="form-group">
              <label className="form-label">🔍 Найти клиента (ФИО или телефон)</label>
              <input
                className="form-input"
                type="text"
                placeholder="Иванов / 89123456789 / 4567"
                value={query}
                onChange={(e) => setQuery(e.target.value)}
                disabled={busy || !!selectedClient}
              />
              {searchBusy && <div className="create-req-search-hint">Поиск…</div>}
              {!searchBusy && query.trim().length >= 2 && searchResults.length === 0 && (
                <div className="create-req-search-hint">
                  Никого не нашли — заполните поля ниже, создадим нового клиента.
                </div>
              )}
              {!selectedClient && searchResults.length > 0 && (
                <div className="create-req-search-results">
                  {searchResults.slice(0, 6).map((c) => (
                    <button
                      key={c.user_id}
                      type="button"
                      className="create-req-search-item"
                      onClick={() => pickClient(c)}
                    >
                      <div>
                        <b>{c.last_name} {c.first_name} {c.middle_name}</b>
                        {!c.has_max && <span className="create-req-tag">нет MAX</span>}
                      </div>
                      <div className="create-req-search-phone">{c.phone}</div>
                    </button>
                  ))}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>

            {selectedClient && (
              <div className="create-req-selected">
                ✅ Выбран: <b>{selectedClient.last_name} {selectedClient.first_name}</b>
                {!selectedClient.has_max && ' (нет MAX)'}
                <button type="button" className="create-req-clear" onClick={clearClient}>✕</button>
              </div>
            )}

            {!selectedClient && (
              <>
                <div className="form-group">
                  <label className="form-label">Телефон</label>
                  <input
                    className="form-input"
                    type="tel"
                    value={phone}
                    onChange={(e) => setPhone(e.target.value)}
                    disabled={busy}
                    placeholder="+7 999 123-45-67"
                  />
                </div>
                <div className="form-row-2">
                  <div className="form-group">
                    <label className="form-label">Фамилия</label>
                    <input
                      className="form-input"
                      value={lastName}
                      onChange={(e) => setLastName(e.target.value)}
                      disabled={busy}
                    />
                  </div>
                  <div className="form-group">
                    <label className="form-label">Имя</label>
                    <input
                      className="form-input"
                      value={firstName}
                      onChange={(e) => setFirstName(e.target.value)}
                      disabled={busy}
                    />
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div className="form-group">
                  <label className="form-label">Отчество (если есть)</label>
                  <input
                    className="form-input"
                    value={middleName}
                    onChange={(e) => setMiddleName(e.target.value)}
                    disabled={busy}
                  />
                </div>
              </>
            )}
          </>
        )}

        <div className="form-group">
          <label className="form-label">Услуга (опционально)</label>
          <select
            className="form-input"
            value={serviceId}
            onChange={(e) => setServiceId(e.target.value)}
            disabled={busy}
          >
            <option value="">— Не важно / любая —</option>
            {services.map((s) => (
              <option key={s.id} value={s.id}>{s.name}</option>
            ))}
          </select>
          <div style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted)', fontSize: 12, marginTop: 4 }}>
            Если не выбрана, а выбран специалист — уведомим, когда у него освободится
            любой слот.
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="form-group">
          <label className="form-label">Специалист (опционально)</label>
          <select
            className="form-input"
            value={doctorId}
            onChange={(e) => setDoctorId(e.target.value)}
            disabled={busy || !doctors.length}
          >
            <option value="">— Любой, кто оказывает услугу —</option>
            {doctors.map((d) => (
              <option key={d.id} value={d.id}>{d.name}</option>
            ))}
          </select>
          <div style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted)', fontSize: 12, marginTop: 4 }}>
            Если выбрать специалиста — уведомления будут только по его слотам.
            Если оставить «Любой» — предложим любого, кто оказывает услугу.
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="form-row-2">
          <div className="form-group">
            <label className="form-label">С даты</label>
            <input
              className="form-input"
              type="date"
              value={dateFrom}
              onChange={(e) => setDateFrom(e.target.value)}
              disabled={busy}
            />
          </div>
          <div className="form-group">
            <label className="form-label">По дату</label>
            <input
              className="form-input"
              type="date"
              value={dateTo}
              onChange={(e) => setDateTo(e.target.value)}
              disabled={busy}
            />
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="form-group">
          <label className="form-label">Удобное время</label>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 6, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
            {[
              { id: 'any', label: 'Любое' },
              { id: 'morning', label: 'Утро' },
              { id: 'afternoon', label: 'День' },
              { id: 'evening', label: 'Вечер' },
            ].map((p) => (
              <button
                key={p.id}
                type="button"
                className={'filter-btn' + (preferred === p.id ? ' active' : '')}
                onClick={() => setPreferred(p.id)}
                disabled={busy}
              >
                {p.label}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="form-group">
          <label className="form-label">Заметка (для админа)</label>
          <textarea
            className="form-input"
            rows={2}
            value={notes}
            onChange={(e) => setNotes(e.target.value)}
            disabled={busy}
            maxLength={500}
            placeholder="Например: клиент готов приехать даже утром в субботу"
          />
        </div>

        {error && <div className="form-error">{error}</div>}

        <div className="actions" style={{ marginTop: 16 }}>
          <button className="btn-action confirm" onClick={submit} disabled={busy}>
            {busy ? 'Сохранение…' : '✅ Сохранить'}
          </button>
          <button className="btn-action reject" onClick={onClose} disabled={busy}>
            Отмена
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
